entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers (row 1) include "Part No" and "Required Qty"; GRN headers include "Part No" and "Received Qty"; column order does not matter
# ASSUME: a part can appear on several GRN rows; its received quantities are added
# ASSUME: the Shortages sheet already exists; it is cleared and rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: a blank or non-numeric Received Qty is ignored; a part with no valid GRN rows counts as 0 received
# ASSUME: a blank or non-numeric Required Qty is listed as "Required qty missing" instead of being skipped
GOAL     List every BOM part whose total received quantity from the GRN sheet is below the required quantity, with the amount short.
PROC     BuildShortageList
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMaterials
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, grn As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      received As Dictionary
VAR      bomPart As Long
VAR      bomReq As Long
VAR      grnPart As Long
VAR      grnQty As Long
VAR      partNo As String
VAR      got As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(bomPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(bomReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(grnPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(grnQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Part No", "Required", "Received", "Shortage", "Remark")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, grnPart) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, grnPart)) AND IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, grnQty)) THEN DICT_ADD(received, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, grnPart)), CELL($grn, r, grnQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, bomPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, bomPart))
OP         LET(partNo, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, bomPart)))
OP         LET(got, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(received, partNo) THEN DICT_GET(received, partNo, into=got)
OP         IF NOT IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, r, bomReq))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 1), partNo)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 3), got)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 5), "Required qty missing")
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF got < CELL($bom, r, bomReq)
OP             WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, partNo, CELL($bom, r, bomReq), got, CELL($bom, r, bomReq) - got)
OP             IF got = 0 THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 5), "Not received")
OP             IF got > 0 THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 5), "Short")
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  bom_grn_01.xlsx sheet=BOM cols=A:Part No,B:Description,C:Required Qty rows=40 data=A:seq(1001,1)+blank(2);B:text(12);C:int(1,50)+boundary(30,7)+blank(3)
FIXTURE  bom_grn_01.xlsx sheet=GRN cols=A:Part No,B:Received Qty rows=35 data=A:seq(1001,1)+boundary(1001,1002)+dupes(4);B:int(1,50)+boundary(1,7)+blank(4)
FIXTURE  bom_grn_01.xlsx sheet=Shortages cols=A:Part No,B:Required,C:Received,D:Shortage,E:Remark rows=0 stale=40
TEST     fixture=bom_grn_01.xlsx call=BuildShortageList(BOM, GRN, Shortages) runs=2 assert=RESULT >= 5 AND COUNTA(Shortages![Part No]) = RESULT + 1 AND COUNTIF(Shortages![Part No], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTIF(Shortages![Shortage], "<0") = 0 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=bom_grn_01.xlsx call=BuildShortageList(BOM, GRN, Shortages) assert=COUNTIF(Shortages![Remark], "Required qty missing") = 3 AND COUNTIFS(Shortages![Part No], 1001, Shortages![Remark], "Short") = 1 AND COUNTIF(Shortages![Part No], 1002) = 0
TEST     fixture=bom_grn_01.xlsx call=BuildShortageList(BOM, GRN, Shortages) assert=SUM(BOM![Required Qty]) = PRE_SUM(BOM![Required Qty]) AND SUM(GRN![Received Qty]) = PRE_SUM(GRN![Received Qty])
TEST     fixture=bom_grn_01.xlsx call=BuildShortageList(Shortages, GRN, Shortages) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(Shortages![Part No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Shortages![Part No])

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Traceability headers (row 1) include "Part No", "Plate/Heat No" and "MTC No"; column order does not matter
# ASSUME: rows with a blank Part No are skipped
# ASSUME: the macro owns the fill colour of listed rows: it clears the fill first, so fixed rows lose their red
# ASSUME: the whole row is highlighted, from column A to the last header column
GOAL     Highlight in red every material traceability row that has a part number but no plate or heat number, or no MTC number.
PROC     FlagMissingTraceability
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMaterials
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Part No") > 0; COL($ws, "Plate/Heat No") > 0; COL($ws, "MTC No") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cPart, COL($ws, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($ws, "Plate/Heat No"))
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($ws, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       LET(flagged, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cPart))
OP         FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cHeat)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cMtc))
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=#FF0000)
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  traceability_01.xlsx sheet=Traceability cols=A:Part No,B:Plate/Heat No,C:MTC No,D:Remarks rows=40 stale=6 data=A:seq(1,1)+blank(2);B:text(8)+boundary("")+blank(4);C:text(10)+blank(3);D:text(10)+boundary("")
FIXTURE  traceability_01.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=3 data=A:text(20)
TEST     fixture=traceability_01.xlsx call=FlagMissingTraceability(Traceability) runs=2 assert=RESULT >= 5 AND RESULT <= 8 AND FILL_COUNT(Traceability![Part No], #FF0000) = RESULT + 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Traceability![Part No]2, #FF0000) = 1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=traceability_01.xlsx call=FlagMissingTraceability(Traceability) assert=COUNTA(Traceability![Plate/Heat No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Traceability![Plate/Heat No]) AND COUNTA(Traceability![MTC No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Traceability![MTC No])
TEST     fixture=traceability_01.xlsx call=FlagMissingTraceability(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Notes![Note], #FF0000) = 0

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers (row 1) include "Weld Seam No", "Welder ID" and "Result" (Accepted / Repair); one row per seam
# ASSUME: rows with a blank Welder ID or a blank Result are skipped; a blank Result means not inspected yet
# ASSUME: "Repair" is matched ignoring case and extra spaces
# ASSUME: repair rate = repaired seams / inspected seams per welder; Welder Performance is rebuilt every run, highest rate first
GOAL     Rebuild a Welder Performance sheet with each welder's inspected seams, repaired seams and repair rate, highest rate first.
PROC     BuildWelderRepairRate
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      total As Dictionary
VAR      repairs As Dictionary
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      welderId As String
VAR      inspected As Long
VAR      repaired As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($nde, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Seams Inspected", "Repairs", "Repair Rate")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cSeam) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cWelder)) AND NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cResult))
OP           LET(welderId, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cWelder)))
OP           DICT_ADD(total, welderId, 1, mode=count)
OP           IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "REPAIR") THEN DICT_ADD(repairs, welderId, 1, mode=count)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(total)
OP         DICT_GET(total, k, into=inspected)
OP         LET(repaired, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(repairs, k) THEN DICT_GET(repairs, k, into=repaired)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, inspected, repaired)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 4), repaired / inspected)
OP         FORMAT(CELL($out, outRow, 4), numfmt="0.0%")
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=4, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  nde_repair_01.xlsx sheet=NDE cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Welder ID,C:Result rows=60 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("W-01"x20,"W-02"x19,"W-03"x15,"W-04"x1,""x5)+boundary("W-01","W-04");C:values("Accepted"x48,"Repair"x8,""x4)+boundary("Repair","Accepted")
FIXTURE  nde_repair_01.xlsx sheet=WelderPerf cols=A:Welder ID,B:Seams Inspected,C:Repairs,D:Repair Rate rows=0 stale=10
TEST     fixture=nde_repair_01.xlsx call=BuildWelderRepairRate(NDE, WelderPerf) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 4 AND COUNTA(WelderPerf![Welder ID]) = RESULT + 1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=nde_repair_01.xlsx call=BuildWelderRepairRate(NDE, WelderPerf) assert=SUM(WelderPerf![Repairs]) = PRE_COUNTIFS(NDE![Result], "Repair", NDE![Welder ID], "<>") AND SUM(WelderPerf![Seams Inspected]) = PRE_COUNTIFS(NDE![Result], "<>", NDE![Welder ID], "<>") - 1 AND COUNTIFS(WelderPerf![Welder ID], "W-04", WelderPerf![Repairs], 0) = 1 AND VALUE(WelderPerf![Repair Rate]2) >= VALUE(WelderPerf![Repair Rate]3)
TEST     fixture=nde_repair_01.xlsx call=BuildWelderRepairRate(NDE, WelderPerf) assert=COUNTA(NDE![Welder ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(NDE![Welder ID]) AND COUNTA(NDE![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(NDE![Result])
TEST     fixture=nde_repair_01.xlsx call=BuildWelderRepairRate(WelderPerf, WelderPerf) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(WelderPerf![Welder ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(WelderPerf![Welder ID])

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the RT, UT, MPT and DPT sheets each have headers "Weld Seam No" and "Result" in row 1
# ASSUME: seam numbers are compared as trimmed text, ignoring case
# ASSUME: if a seam appears more than once in a sheet (re-shoot), the lowest row is the latest result
# ASSUME: Summary has one row per seam found in any of the four sheets; it is rebuilt every run, sorted by seam
GOAL     Rebuild a Summary sheet with one row for each weld seam and its latest result from the RT, UT, MPT and DPT sheets, sorted by seam number.
PROC     BuildNdeSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     rt As Worksheet, ut As Worksheet, mpt As Worksheet, dpt As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      seams As Dictionary
VAR      rtResults As Dictionary
VAR      utResults As Dictionary
VAR      mptResults As Dictionary
VAR      dptResults As Dictionary
VAR      cRtSeam As Long
VAR      cRtRes As Long
VAR      cUtSeam As Long
VAR      cUtRes As Long
VAR      cMptSeam As Long
VAR      cMptRes As Long
VAR      cDptSeam As Long
VAR      cDptRes As Long
VAR      v As Variant
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($rt, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($rt, "Result") > 0; COL($ut, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ut, "Result") > 0; COL($mpt, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($mpt, "Result") > 0; COL($dpt, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($dpt, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cRtSeam, COL($rt, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cRtRes, COL($rt, "Result"))
OP       LET(cUtSeam, COL($ut, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cUtRes, COL($ut, "Result"))
OP       LET(cMptSeam, COL($mpt, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cMptRes, COL($mpt, "Result"))
OP       LET(cDptSeam, COL($dpt, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cDptRes, COL($dpt, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Weld Seam No", "RT", "UT", "MPT", "DPT")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($rt, cRtSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($rt, r, cRtSeam))
OP         DICT_ADD(seams, TRIM(CELL($rt, r, cRtSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         DICT_ADD(rtResults, TRIM(CELL($rt, r, cRtSeam)), CELL($rt, r, cRtRes), mode=overwrite)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ut, cUtSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ut, r, cUtSeam))
OP         DICT_ADD(seams, TRIM(CELL($ut, r, cUtSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         DICT_ADD(utResults, TRIM(CELL($ut, r, cUtSeam)), CELL($ut, r, cUtRes), mode=overwrite)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($mpt, cMptSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($mpt, r, cMptSeam))
OP         DICT_ADD(seams, TRIM(CELL($mpt, r, cMptSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         DICT_ADD(mptResults, TRIM(CELL($mpt, r, cMptSeam)), CELL($mpt, r, cMptRes), mode=overwrite)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($dpt, cDptSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($dpt, r, cDptSeam))
OP         DICT_ADD(seams, TRIM(CELL($dpt, r, cDptSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         DICT_ADD(dptResults, TRIM(CELL($dpt, r, cDptSeam)), CELL($dpt, r, cDptRes), mode=overwrite)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=s in=KEYS(seams)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 1), s)
OP         LET(v, "")
OP         IF EXISTS(rtResults, s) THEN DICT_GET(rtResults, s, into=v)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(v) THEN LET(v, "Pending")
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 2), v)
OP         LET(v, "")
OP         IF EXISTS(utResults, s) THEN DICT_GET(utResults, s, into=v)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(v) THEN LET(v, "Pending")
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 3), v)
OP         LET(v, "")
OP         IF EXISTS(mptResults, s) THEN DICT_GET(mptResults, s, into=v)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(v) THEN LET(v, "Pending")
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 4), v)
OP         LET(v, "")
OP         IF EXISTS(dptResults, s) THEN DICT_GET(dptResults, s, into=v)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(v) THEN LET(v, "Pending")
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, 5), v)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  nde_summary_01.xlsx sheet=RT cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Result rows=30 data=A:seq(33,-1)+boundary(101,111,111)+blank(2);B:values("Accepted"x25,"Repair"x2,""x3)+boundary("Accepted","Accepted","Repair")
FIXTURE  nde_summary_01.xlsx sheet=UT cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Result rows=20 data=A:seq(1,1)+boundary(102,112,112)+blank(2);B:values("Accepted"x17,"Repair"x1,""x2)+boundary("Accepted","Repair","Accepted")
FIXTURE  nde_summary_01.xlsx sheet=MPT cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Result rows=25 data=A:seq(6,1)+boundary(103,113,113)+blank(2);B:values("Accepted"x22,"Repair"x1,""x2)+boundary("Accepted","Accepted","Repair")
FIXTURE  nde_summary_01.xlsx sheet=DPT cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Result rows=10 data=A:seq(1,1)+boundary(104,114,114)+blank(1);B:values("Accepted"x9,"Repair"x1)+boundary("Accepted","Repair","Accepted")
FIXTURE  nde_summary_01.xlsx sheet=Summary cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:RT,C:UT,D:MPT,E:DPT rows=0 stale=40
TEST     fixture=nde_summary_01.xlsx call=BuildNdeSummary(RT, UT, MPT, DPT, Summary) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 35 AND COUNTA(Summary![Weld Seam No]) = 36 AND COUNTIF(Summary![RT], "stale") = 0 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=nde_summary_01.xlsx call=BuildNdeSummary(RT, UT, MPT, DPT, Summary) assert=COUNTIF(Summary![RT], "Pending") = 11 AND COUNTIF(Summary![UT], "Pending") = 20 AND COUNTIF(Summary![MPT], "Pending") = 15 AND COUNTIF(Summary![DPT], "Pending") = 27 AND COUNTIFS(Summary![Weld Seam No], 111, Summary![RT], "Repair") = 1 AND COUNTIFS(Summary![Weld Seam No], 112, Summary![UT], "Accepted") = 1 AND COUNTIFS(Summary![Weld Seam No], 113, Summary![MPT], "Repair") = 1 AND COUNTIFS(Summary![Weld Seam No], 114, Summary![DPT], "Accepted") = 1
TEST     fixture=nde_summary_01.xlsx call=BuildNdeSummary(RT, UT, MPT, DPT, Summary) assert=COUNTA(RT![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(RT![Result]) AND COUNTA(UT![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(UT![Result]) AND COUNTA(MPT![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(MPT![Result]) AND COUNTA(DPT![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(DPT![Result])
TEST     fixture=nde_summary_01.xlsx call=BuildNdeSummary(RT, Summary, MPT, DPT, Summary) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(Summary![Weld Seam No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Summary![Weld Seam No])

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Weld Log headers (row 1) include "Weld Seam No", "Fit-up" and "Visual"; column order does not matter
# ASSUME: rows are NOT deleted; seams not yet accepted are copied to the Weld Log Exceptions sheet instead
# ASSUME: a seam is an exception when Fit-up or Visual is blank or anything other than "Accepted" (case and spaces ignored)
# ASSUME: the Weld Log Exceptions sheet is rebuilt every run with the Weld Log's header row
GOAL     Copy each weld log row whose fit-up or visual result is not Accepted to a Weld Log Exceptions sheet without removing anything from the log.
PROC     ListWeldLogExceptions
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelding
ARGS     weldLog As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cFit As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weldLog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weldLog, "Fit-up") > 0; COL($weldLog, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weldLog, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cFit, COL($weldLog, "Fit-up"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($weldLog, "Visual"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($weldLog, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($weldLog, 1, $out, 1, cols=lastCol)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weldLog, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weldLog, r, cSeam))
OP         IF NOT SAME(CELL($weldLog, r, cFit), "ACCEPTED") OR NOT SAME(CELL($weldLog, r, cVisual), "ACCEPTED")
OP           COPY_ROW($weldLog, r, $out, outRow, cols=lastCol)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  weld_log_01.xlsx sheet=WeldLog cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Welder ID,C:Fit-up,D:Visual,E:Weld Date rows=50 data=A:seq(1,1)+boundary(1,"")+blank(2);B:values("W-01"x25,"W-02"x25);C:values("Accepted"x44,"Rejected"x2,""x4)+boundary("Rejected","Rejected");D:values("Accepted"x43,"Hold"x3,""x4);E:dates(2026-01-01,2026-09-30)+boundary("")
FIXTURE  weld_log_01.xlsx sheet=Exceptions cols=A:Weld Seam No rows=0 stale=10
TEST     fixture=weld_log_01.xlsx call=ListWeldLogExceptions(WeldLog, Exceptions) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 12 AND COUNTA(Exceptions![Weld Seam No]) = 13 AND COUNTIF(Exceptions![Weld Seam No], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTA(Exceptions![Weld Date]) = 12 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=weld_log_01.xlsx call=ListWeldLogExceptions(WeldLog, Exceptions) assert=COUNTA(WeldLog![Weld Seam No]) = PRE_COUNTA(WeldLog![Weld Seam No]) AND COUNTA(WeldLog![Fit-up]) = PRE_COUNTA(WeldLog![Fit-up])

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Welder Qualification headers (row 1) include "Welder ID" and "Expiry Date"; one row per welder
# ASSUME: Weld Log headers include "Weld Seam No" and "Welder ID"; the Weld Log row is the one highlighted

# ASSUME: the macro owns the fill colour of Weld Log rows: it clears the fill first, so fixed rows lose their red
GOAL     Highlight in red every weld log row whose welder is missing from the qualification list or has no valid or an expired expiry date.
PROC     FlagExpiredWelderQualifications
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelding
ARGS     weldLog As Worksheet, qual As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      expiry As Dictionary
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cQualId As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      flagged As Long
VAR      welderId As String
VAR      expDate As Variant
VAR      bad As Boolean
PRE      COL($weldLog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weldLog, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($qual, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($qual, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $weldLog fills
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weldLog, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($weldLog, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cQualId, COL($qual, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($qual, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($qual, cQualId) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($qual, r, cQualId)) THEN DICT_ADD(expiry, TRIM(CELL($qual, r, cQualId)), CELL($qual, r, cExpiry), mode=overwrite)
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($weldLog, 1))
OP       LET(flagged, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weldLog, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weldLog, r, cSeam))
OP         FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($weldLog, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP         LET(bad, FALSE)
OP         LET(expDate, "")
OP         LET(welderId, TRIM(CELL($weldLog, r, cWelder)))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(welderId) THEN LET(bad, TRUE)
OP         IF EXISTS(expiry, welderId) THEN DICT_GET(expiry, welderId, into=expDate)
OP         IF NOT IS_DATE(expDate) THEN LET(bad, TRUE)
OP         IF IS_DATE(expDate)
OP           IF expDate < TODAY THEN LET(bad, TRUE)
OP         IF bad
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($weldLog, r, 1, lastCol), fill=#FF0000)
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  welder_qual_01.xlsx sheet=WelderQual cols=A:Welder ID,B:Name,C:Expiry Date rows=7 data=A:values("W-01"x2,"W-02"x1,"W-03"x1,"W-04"x1,"W-05"x1,"W-06"x1)+boundary("W-02","W-01","W-03","W-01","W-04");B:text(10);C:reldates(-400,800)+boundary(0,-1,1,30,"")

TEST     fixture=welder_qual_01.xlsx call=FlagExpiredWelderQualifications(WeldLog, WelderQual) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 15 AND FILL_COUNT(WeldLog![Weld Seam No], #FF0000) = 15 AND FILL_COUNT(WeldLog![Visual], #FF0000) = 15 AND FILL_COUNT(WeldLog![Welder ID]2, #FF0000) = 1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=welder_qual_01.xlsx call=FlagExpiredWelderQualifications(WeldLog, WelderQual) assert=COUNTA(WeldLog![Welder ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(WeldLog![Welder ID]) AND COUNTA(WelderQual![Expiry Date]) = PRE_COUNTA(WelderQual![Expiry Date])

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: ITP Tracker headers (row 1) include "Point Type" (Hold / Witness / Review) and "Inspection Status"
# ASSUME: a row is copied when Inspection Status is "Ready" and Point Type is "Hold" or "Witness" (case and spaces ignored)

# ASSUME: the Call Notice sheet is rebuilt every run with the ITP Tracker's header row
GOAL     Rebuild a Call Notice sheet with every ITP point of type Hold or Witness whose inspection status is Ready.
PROC     BuildCallNoticeList
KIND     Function
MODULE   modQuality
ARGS     itp As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cType As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      pointType As String
VAR      status As String
PRE      COL($itp, "Point Type") > 0; COL($itp, "Inspection Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cType, COL($itp, "Point Type"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($itp, "Inspection Status"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($itp, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($itp, 1, $out, 1, cols=lastCol)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($itp, cStatus) var=r
OP         LET(status, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($itp, r, cStatus))))
OP         LET(pointType, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($itp, r, cType))))
OP         IF status = "READY"
OP           IF pointType = "HOLD" OR pointType = "WITNESS"
OP             COPY_ROW($itp, r, $out, outRow, cols=lastCol)
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  itp_01.xlsx sheet=ITP cols=A:Activity,B:Point Type,C:Inspection Status,D:Planned Date rows=40 data=A:text(15);B:values("Hold"x12,"Witness"x14,"Review"x10,""x4)+boundary("Hold");C:values("Ready"x10,"Done"x18,"Pending"x8,""x4)+boundary("Ready");D:dates(2026-10-01,2026-12-31)+boundary("")
FIXTURE  itp_01.xlsx sheet=CallNotice cols=A:Activity rows=0 stale=10
TEST     fixture=itp_01.xlsx call=BuildCallNoticeList(ITP, CallNotice) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 8 AND RESULT = PRE_COUNTIFS(ITP![Inspection Status], "Ready", ITP![Point Type], "Hold") + PRE_COUNTIFS(ITP![Inspection Status], "Ready", ITP![Point Type], "Witness") AND COUNTA(CallNotice![Activity]) = 9 AND COUNTIF(CallNotice![Activity], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTA(CallNotice![Planned Date]) = 8 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=itp_01.xlsx call=BuildCallNoticeList(ITP, CallNotice) assert=COUNTIF(CallNotice![Inspection Status], "Ready") = RESULT AND COUNTIF(CallNotice![Point Type], "Review") = 0
TEST     fixture=itp_01.xlsx call=BuildCallNoticeList(ITP, CallNotice) assert=COUNTA(ITP![Inspection Status]) = PRE_COUNTA(ITP![Inspection Status]) AND COUNTA(ITP![Activity]) = PRE_COUNTA(ITP![Activity])
TEST     fixture=itp_01.xlsx call=BuildCallNoticeList(CallNotice, CallNotice) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(CallNotice![Activity]) = PRE_COUNTA(CallNotice![Activity])

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Consumable Issue headers (row 1) include "Batch No" and "Qty Issued"
# ASSUME: Inventory headers include "Batch No", "Opening Stock", "Issued to Date", "Balance" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: Issued to Date, Balance and Remark are owned by this macro and recalculated from the whole issue log on every run, so running it twice never double-counts
# ASSUME: issue rows with a blank or non-numeric Qty Issued, or a blank Batch No, are ignored
# ASSUME: the function returns how many issue rows use a batch number that is not in Inventory
GOAL     Recalculate each inventory batch's issued-to-date, balance and remark from the whole consumable issue log and count issue lines for unknown batches.
PROC     ReconcileConsumableStock
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelding
ARGS     issues As Worksheet, inv As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      known As Dictionary
VAR      issued As Dictionary
VAR      iBatch As Long
VAR      iQty As Long
VAR      vBatch As Long
VAR      vOpen As Long
VAR      vIssued As Long
VAR      vBal As Long
VAR      vRemark As Long
VAR      batch As String
VAR      used As Double
VAR      unknown As Long
PRE      COL($issues, "Batch No") > 0; COL($issues, "Qty Issued") > 0; COL($inv, "Batch No") > 0; COL($inv, "Opening Stock") > 0; COL($inv, "Issued to Date") > 0; COL($inv, "Balance") > 0; COL($inv, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $inv["Issued to Date", "Remark", "Balance"]
OP       LET(iBatch, COL($issues, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(iQty, COL($issues, "Qty Issued"))
OP       LET(vBatch, COL($inv, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(vOpen, COL($inv, "Opening Stock"))
OP       LET(vIssued, COL($inv, "Issued to Date"))
OP       LET(vBal, COL($inv, "Balance"))
OP       LET(vRemark, COL($inv, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($inv, vBatch) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($inv, r, vBatch)) THEN DICT_ADD(known, TRIM(CELL($inv, r, vBatch)), r, mode=keep)
OP       LET(unknown, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($issues, iBatch) var=r
OP         LET(batch, TRIM(CELL($issues, r, iBatch)))
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(batch) AND IS_NUMBER(CELL($issues, r, iQty))
OP           IF EXISTS(known, batch) THEN DICT_ADD(issued, batch, CELL($issues, r, iQty), mode=sum)
OP           IF NOT EXISTS(known, batch) THEN LET(unknown, unknown + 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($inv, vBatch) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($inv, r, vBatch))
OP         LET(batch, TRIM(CELL($inv, r, vBatch)))
OP         LET(used, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(issued, batch) THEN DICT_GET(issued, batch, into=used)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($inv, r, vIssued), used)
OP         CLEAR(CELL($inv, r, vRemark), what=contents)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($inv, r, vOpen))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($inv, r, vBal), CELL($inv, r, vOpen) - used)
OP           IF CELL($inv, r, vOpen) - used < 0 THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($inv, r, vRemark), "Negative balance")
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($inv, r, vBal), what=contents)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($inv, r, vRemark), "Opening stock missing")
OP       RETURN(unknown)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  consumables_01.xlsx sheet=Inventory cols=A:Batch No,B:Opening Stock,C:Issued to Date,D:Balance,E:Remark rows=9 data=A:values("B-101"x1,"B-102"x1,"B-103"x1,"B-104"x1,"B-105"x1,"B-106"x1,"B-107"x1,"B-108"x1,""x1)+boundary("B-101","B-106");B:int(200,500)+boundary(1,0)+blank(1);D:int(1,99);E:values("Old remark"x5,""x4)
FIXTURE  consumables_01.xlsx sheet=Issues cols=A:Issue Date,B:Batch No,C:Qty Issued rows=60 data=A:dates(2026-06-01,2026-09-30);B:values("B-101"x10,"B-102"x10,"B-103"x10,"B-104"x10,"B-105"x10,"B-109"x5,""x5);C:int(1,20)+blank(6)
TEST     fixture=consumables_01.xlsx call=ReconcileConsumableStock(Issues, Inventory) runs=2 assert=RESULT = PRE_COUNTIFS(Issues![Batch No], "B-109", Issues![Qty Issued], "<>") AND SUM(Inventory![Issued to Date]) = PRE_SUMIFS(Issues![Qty Issued], Issues![Batch No], "<>B-109", Issues![Batch No], "<>") AND ERROR_COUNT = 0
TEST     fixture=consumables_01.xlsx call=ReconcileConsumableStock(Issues, Inventory) assert=COUNTIF(Inventory![Remark], "Opening stock missing") = 1 AND COUNTIF(Inventory![Remark], "Negative balance") = 1 AND COUNTIF(Inventory![Remark], "Old remark") = 1 AND VALUE(Inventory![Balance]3) = 0 AND COUNTA(Inventory![Balance]) = 9
TEST     fixture=consumables_01.xlsx call=ReconcileConsumableStock(Issues, Inventory) assert=SUM(Inventory![Opening Stock]) = PRE_SUM(Inventory![Opening Stock]) AND SUM(Issues![Qty Issued]) = PRE_SUM(Issues![Qty Issued])
TEST     fixture=consumables_01.xlsx call=ReconcileConsumableStock(Inventory, Inventory) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(Inventory![Balance]) = PRE_COUNTA(Inventory![Balance])

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NCR Register headers (row 1) include "NCR No", "Issue Date" and "Status"
# ASSUME: a row is copied when Status is "Open" (case and spaces ignored); blank Status rows are ignored
# ASSUME: the Summary sheet is rebuilt every run with the register's header row plus a Days Open column, oldest first
# ASSUME: rows with a missing or invalid Issue Date are still copied, marked "Issue date missing", and sort to the bottom
GOAL     Rebuild a Summary sheet listing every open NCR with its days open, oldest first, and mark rows with a missing issue date.
PROC     BuildOpenNcrSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modQuality
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNcr As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNcr, COL($ncr, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ncr, "Issue Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ncr, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($ncr, 1, $out, 1, cols=lastCol)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($out, 1, lastCol + 1), "Days Open")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cNcr) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "OPEN")
OP           COPY_ROW($ncr, r, $out, outRow, cols=lastCol)
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ncr, r, cDate)) THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, lastCol + 1), TODAY - CELL($ncr, r, cDate))
OP           IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($ncr, r, cDate)) THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, lastCol + 1), "Issue date missing")
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=cDate, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers (row 1) include "Instrument ID" and "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: an instrument is listed when its due date is blank or invalid, already passed, or within the next 15 days
# ASSUME: the Overdue sheet is rebuilt every run with the tracker's header row plus a Status column, soonest due first
# ASSUME: rows with a blank Instrument ID are skipped
GOAL     Rebuild an Overdue sheet listing every instrument that is overdue, due within 15 days or has no valid due date, soonest first.
PROC     BuildCalibrationDueList
KIND     Function
MODULE   modQuality
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      status As String
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($cal, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($cal, 1, $out, 1, cols=lastCol)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($out, 1, lastCol + 1), "Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($cal, r, cId))
OP         LET(status, "")
OP         IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue)) THEN LET(status, "Due date missing")
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) < TODAY THEN LET(status, "Overdue")
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) >= TODAY AND CELL($cal, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 15 THEN LET(status, "Due within 15 days")
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(status)
OP           COPY_ROW($cal, r, $out, outRow, cols=lastCol)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($out, outRow, lastCol + 1), status)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=cDue, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

GOAL     Highlight in red every weld log row with a seam number whose visual result is not Accepted, clearing old highlights first.
PROC     HighlightRejectedWelds
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldCheck
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      lastRow As Long
VAR      n As Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ws, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($ws, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($ws, "Visual"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       LET(lastRow, 1)
OP       LOOP_COLS dir=right from=1 to=lastCol var=c
OP         LET(n, LASTROW($ws, c))
OP         IF n > lastRow THEN LET(lastRow, n)
OP       LET(flagged, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=lastRow var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cSeam))
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cVisual), "Accepted")
OP             FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP           ELSE
OP             FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=red)
OP             LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Tracker headers are in row 1 and include "Job ID", "Report File" and "Status"; column order does not matter
# ASSUME: $dump is the folder the test reports arrive in, and $jobs holds one folder per job; both must exist (sandbox folders only until March 2027)

# ASSUME: the result counts the rows whose report is now in its job's folder (Copied or Already there), so a re-run gives the same result
GOAL     Copy each job's test report from the dump folder into that job's own folder and write the outcome of each copy in the Status column.
PROC     RouteJobPacks
KIND     Function
MODULE   modRouter
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, dump As String, jobs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cFile As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      status As String
VAR      routed As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Job ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Report File") > 0; COL($tracker, "Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($dump); FOLDER_EXISTS($jobs)
MODIFIES $tracker["Status"]
MODIFIES $jobs files
OP       LET(cJob, COL($tracker, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cFile, COL($tracker, "Report File"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($tracker, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cJob))
OP         IF SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cJob)) = "" OR SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cFile)) = ""
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Bad name")
OP         ELSE
OP           MAKE_FOLDER(PATH_JOIN($jobs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cJob))), into=status)
OP           IF status = "Created" OR status = "Exists"
OP             COPY_FILE(PATH_JOIN($dump, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cFile))), PATH_JOIN($jobs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cJob)), SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cFile))), into=status)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), status)
OP           IF status = "Copied" OR status = "Already there" THEN LET(routed, routed + 1)
OP       RETURN(routed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Dispatch headers in row 1 include "Dispatch No", "Planned Date", "Actual Date" and "Status"
# ASSUME: no Actual Date means the cell is empty or only spaces
# ASSUME: Late needs a real Planned Date before today; On time needs real Actual and Planned Dates
# ASSUME: a row delivered after its Planned Date, or without real dates, keeps its Status
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Dispatch No is skipped
GOAL     Mark each undelivered dispatch past its planned date as Late and each dispatch delivered by its planned date as On time, and return how many are Late.
PROC     MarkDispatchStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cPlanned As Long
VAR      cActual As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      late As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Status"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ws, "Dispatch No"))
OP       LET(cPlanned, COL($ws, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cActual, COL($ws, "Actual Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cNo))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cActual))
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cPlanned))
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cPlanned) < TODAY
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Late")
OP               LET(late, late + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cActual))
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cPlanned))
OP               IF CELL($ws, r, cActual) <= CELL($ws, r, cPlanned)
OP                 SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "On time")
OP       RETURN(late)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK

# ASSUME: still Open means Status is Open, ignoring case and extra spaces
# ASSUME: more than 30 days ago means an Issue Date before TODAY - 30; a missing or non-date Issue Date is not counted
# ASSUME: the NCR No cells carry no fills but these highlights, so each run clears every NCR No fill first
# ASSUME: a row with a blank NCR No is skipped
GOAL     Highlight in yellow the NCR No of every Open NCR issued more than 30 days ago, clearing old highlights first, and return how many were highlighted.
PROC     HighlightOverdueNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcr
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cIssue As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ws, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ws, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cIssue, COL($ws, "Issue Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNo) var=r
OP         FORMAT(CELL($ws, r, cNo), fill=none)
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cNo))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cIssue))
OP           IF CELL($ws, r, cIssue) < TODAY - 30
OP             FORMAT(CELL($ws, r, cNo), fill=yellow)
OP             LET(marked, marked + 1)
OP       RETURN(marked)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Consumable Stock headers in row 1 include "Batch No", "Qty On Hand", "Reorder Level" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: the Remark column is used only for this flag, so a Remark is cleared whenever Qty On Hand is above Reorder Level
# ASSUME: a row where Qty On Hand or Reorder Level is not a number keeps its Remark
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Batch No is skipped
GOAL     Put Reorder in Remark for each batch at or below its reorder level, clear the Remark of each batch above it, and return how many batches need reordering.
PROC     FlagBatchesToReorder
KIND     Function
MODULE   modStock
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cLevel As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      due As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Batch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($ws, "Reorder Level") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($ws, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($ws, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cLevel, COL($ws, "Reorder Level"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cBatch) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cBatch))
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, r, cQty))
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, r, cLevel))
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cQty) <= CELL($ws, r, cLevel)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Reorder")
OP               LET(due, due + 1)
OP             ELSE
OP               CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(due)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Weld log headers in row 1 include "Welder ID" and "Visual"
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "Weld Log" and "Welds Per Welder"; the TESTs use WeldLog and PerWelder
# ASSUME: Welds Per Welder already exists and is rebuilt on every run, with the headers Welder ID, Welds and Rejected
# ASSUME: Welder ID is trimmed and matched ignoring case; a row with a blank Welder ID is not counted
# ASSUME: a weld is Rejected when Visual says Rejected, ignoring case and extra spaces
# ASSUME: welders with the same number of welds may appear in either order
GOAL     Count each welder's welds and rejected welds from the weld log and list them on the Welds Per Welder sheet, most welds first.
PROC     CountWeldsPerWelder
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelds
ARGS     weldLog As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      welds As Dictionary
VAR      rejects As Dictionary
VAR      wCount As Long
VAR      rCount As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weldLog, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($weldLog, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($weldLog, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($weldLog, "Visual"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Welds", "Rejected")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weldLog, cWelder) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weldLog, r, cWelder))
OP         DICT_ADD(welds, TRIM(CELL($weldLog, r, cWelder)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(rejects, TRIM(CELL($weldLog, r, cWelder)), IIF(SAME(CELL($weldLog, r, cVisual), "Rejected"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(welds)
OP         DICT_GET(welds, k, into=wCount)
OP         DICT_GET(rejects, k, into=rCount)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, wCount, rCount)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(welds))
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Method" and "Result"
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "NDE Report" and "Method Summary"; the TESTs use Nde and MethodSummary
# ASSUME: Method Summary already exists and is rebuilt on every run, with the headers Method, Accepted, Repair and No Result
# ASSUME: each row is one seam tested by one method, so rows are counted; Method is trimmed and matched ignoring case
# ASSUME: a blank Result means no result yet; Accepted and Repair are matched ignoring case and extra spaces
# ASSUME: any other Result (such as Rejected) is not counted in any column; a row with a blank Method is skipped
# ASSUME: methods are listed in the order they first appear in the report
GOAL     Count, for each NDE method, the seams that are Accepted, the seams that need Repair and the seams with no result yet, and write them on the Method Summary sheet.
PROC     SummariseNdeByMethod
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cMethod As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      accepted As Dictionary
VAR      repair As Dictionary
VAR      pending As Dictionary
VAR      aCount As Long
VAR      rCount As Long
VAR      pCount As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cMethod, COL($nde, "Method"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Method", "Accepted", "Repair", "No Result")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cMethod) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))
OP         DICT_ADD(accepted, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Accepted"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(repair, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Repair"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(pending, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cResult)), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(accepted)
OP         DICT_GET(accepted, k, into=aCount)
OP         DICT_GET(repair, k, into=rCount)
OP         DICT_GET(pending, k, into=pCount)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, aCount, rCount, pCount)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(accepted))

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers in row 1 include "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "Calibration Tracker" and "Calibration Summary"; the TESTs use CalTracker and CalSummary
# ASSUME: Calibration Summary already exists and is rebuilt on every run: a header row Category and Count, then three labelled rows
# ASSUME: overdue means due before today; due soon means due from today up to 30 days from today; fine means due later than that
# ASSUME: due dates are whole days; each row with a real date is one instrument
# ASSUME: a blank or non-date Next Calibration Due is not counted in any of the three
GOAL     Count the calibration instruments that are overdue, due within 30 days and fine, and write the three counts with labels on the Calibration Summary sheet.
PROC     SummariseCalibrationDue
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      overdue As Long
VAR      soon As Long
VAR      fine As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cDue, COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cDue) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP         IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP           LET(overdue, overdue + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 30
OP             LET(soon, soon + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             LET(fine, fine + 1)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Category", "Count")
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 2, "Overdue", overdue)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 3, "Due in 30 days", soon)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 4, "Fine", fine)
OP       RETURN(overdue + soon + fine)
ERR      standard

GOAL     Add an NCR Flag column to the ITP Tracker if it is missing, mark with Open NCR every point whose ITP has an open NCR, and tell how many points are flagged.
PROC     FlagItpPointsWithOpenNcr
KIND     Function
MODULE   modItp
ARGS     itp As Worksheet, ncr As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cItp As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long
VAR      cNcrItp As Long
VAR      cNcrStatus As Long
VAR      openNcr As Dictionary
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($itp, "ITP No") > 0; COL($ncr, "ITP No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $itp
OP       LET(cItp, COL($itp, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(cFlag, COL($itp, "NCR Flag"))
OP       LET(cNcrItp, COL($ncr, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(cNcrStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       IF cFlag = 0
OP         LET(cFlag, LASTCOL($itp, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, 1, cFlag), "NCR Flag")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cNcrItp) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, r, cNcrItp))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cNcrStatus), "Open")
OP           DICT_ADD(openNcr, TRIM(CELL($ncr, r, cNcrItp)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($itp, cItp) var=p
OP         IF EXISTS(openNcr, TRIM(CELL($itp, p, cItp)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, p, cFlag), "Open NCR")
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($itp, p, cFlag), what=contents)
OP       MSG("ITP points flagged: " & flagged)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

PROC     ListMissingCerts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReconcile
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cGrnNo As Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cCert As Long
VAR      known As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0; COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cGrnNo, COL($grn, "GRN No"))
OP       LET(cPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cCert, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cCert) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cCert))
OP         DICT_ADD(known, TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cCert)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "GRN No", "Part No", "Heat No")

OP           WRITE_ROW($out, n + 1, CELL($grn, r, cGrnNo), CELL($grn, r, cPart), CELL($grn, r, cHeat))

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers (row 1) include "Part No"
# ASSUME: Part No is matched after trimming both ends and ignoring case; the first row of each part stays, with its Part No as typed
# ASSUME: DEDUPE is not used because it does not trim its keys; duplicates are found with a dictionary of trimmed Part Nos instead
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Part No is never a duplicate and is never removed
GOAL     Remove duplicate rows from the BOM sheet by Part No, keeping the first, and return how many duplicate rows were removed.
PROC     RemoveDuplicateParts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCleanup
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      seen As Dictionary
VAR      copies As Long
VAR      removed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Part No") > 0
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(cPart, COL($ws, "Part No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cPart))
OP         DICT_ADD(seen, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cPart)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=up from=LASTROW($ws, cPart) to=2 var=r
OP         IF EXISTS(seen, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cPart)))
OP           DICT_GET(seen, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cPart)), into=copies)
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(copies)
OP             IF copies > 1
OP               DICT_ADD(seen, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cPart)), -1, mode=sum)
OP               DELETE_ROW($ws, r)
OP               LET(removed, removed + 1)
OP       RETURN(removed)

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Job Tracker headers in row 1 include "Job ID", "Customer", "Due Date" and "Status"
# ASSUME: Late Jobs is an existing sheet; it is rebuilt from scratch on every run, headings included
# ASSUME: a job is late when its Due Date is a real date before today; a job due today is not late
# ASSUME: any Status other than Closed (ignoring case and spaces) counts as not Closed, a blank Status too
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Job ID is not a job and is skipped; a row without a real Due Date is not listed
# ASSUME: jobs with the same Due Date may appear in any order
GOAL     List every job that is not closed and is past its due date on the Late Jobs sheet, oldest due date first.
PROC     ListLateJobs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modLateJobs
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, late As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cCust As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Job ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Customer") > 0; COL($tracker, "Due Date") > 0; COL($tracker, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $late
OP       LET(cId, COL($tracker, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cCust, COL($tracker, "Customer"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($tracker, "Due Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($tracker, "Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($late), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($late, 1, "Job ID", "Customer", "Due Date", "Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cId))
OP         IF NOT SAME(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP             IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP               LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP               WRITE_ROW($late, outRow, CELL($tracker, r, cId), CELL($tracker, r, cCust), CELL($tracker, r, cDue), CELL($tracker, r, cStatus))
OP       IF outRow > 2 THEN SORT(USED_RANGE($late), key=3, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 1)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

GOAL     Make a folder inside the Jobs folder for every Job ID in the Job Tracker and write what happened for each row in the Folder Status column.
PROC     MakeJobFolders
KIND     Function
MODULE   modJobFolders
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, jobs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      status As String
VAR      made As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Job ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Folder Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($jobs)
MODIFIES $tracker["Folder Status"]
MODIFIES $jobs files
OP       LET(cId, COL($tracker, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($tracker, "Folder Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cId))
OP         IF SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cId)) = ""
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Bad name")
OP         ELSE
OP           MAKE_FOLDER(PATH_JOIN($jobs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cId))), into=status)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), status)
OP           IF status = "Created" THEN LET(made, made + 1)
OP       RETURN(made)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

# ASSUME: every row from row 2 down that has a Batch No gets the formula; a row with a blank Batch No is left as it is
# ASSUME: the old content of Balance is replaced by the formula, and Balance is not formatted as Text
# ASSUME: Opening Stock and Issued are numbers typed by hand; a bad value shows as an Excel error in Balance and is not hidden
GOAL     Put the formula Opening Stock minus Issued into the Balance cell of every data row of the Consumable Issue sheet.
PROC     FillBalanceFormulas
KIND     Function
MODULE   modConsumables
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cBalance As Long
VAR      filled As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Batch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Opening Stock") = 2; COL($ws, "Issued") = 3; COL($ws, "Balance") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Balance"]
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($ws, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cBalance, COL($ws, "Balance"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cBatch) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cBatch))
OP         SET_FORMULA(CELL($ws, r, cBalance), "=RC2-RC3", style=r1c1)
OP         LET(filled, filled + 1)
OP       RETURN(filled)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=issue_01.xlsx call=FillBalanceFormulas(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(Notes![Note]) = PRE_COUNTA(Notes![Note])

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
BUILD
# ASSUME: NCR Register headers (row 1) include "NCR No", "Issue Date" and "Status"; Calibration Tracker headers include "Instrument ID" and "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "NCR Register", "Calibration Tracker", "Overdue NCRs", "Calibration Due" and "Weekly Summary" and all five exist; the TESTs call them NCR, Calib, OverdueNcr, CalDue and Summary
# ASSUME: an NCR is listed when its Status is Open (ignoring case and spaces) and its Issue Date is more than 30 days before today; a row with no real date is not listed
# ASSUME: an instrument is listed when its Next Calibration Due is today, in the past, or at most 15 days ahead; a row with no real date is not listed
# ASSUME: the three output sheets are cleared and rebuilt on every run; the summary has the labels "Overdue NCRs" and "Calibration due" in column A and the counts in column B
GOAL     Rebuild the Overdue NCRs and Calibration Due lists and a Weekly Summary sheet with the count of each, all from the NCR Register and the Calibration Tracker.
NAME     WeeklyQuality
TARGET   xlsm
ENTRY    modMain.Run
MODULE   modMain
MODULE   modSteps
SIG      modMain.Run()
SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(ncr As Worksheet, cal As Worksheet, ncrOut As Worksheet, calOut As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.ListOverdueNcrs(ncr As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, limit As Long) As Long
SIG      modSteps.ListCalibrationDue(cal As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, window As Long) As Long
SIG      modSteps.WriteWeeklySummary(summary As Worksheet, ncrCount As Long, calCount As Long)
FLOW     modMain.Run -> modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.ListOverdueNcrs
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.ListCalibrationDue
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.WriteWeeklySummary
FIXTURE  weekly_01.xlsx sheet=NCR cols=A:NCR No,B:Issue Date,C:Status rows=8 data=A:seq(101,1);B:reldates(-120,-1)+boundary(-31,-30,-29,-45,-60,"",-100,-31);C:values("Open"x4," open "x1,"OPEN"x1,"Closed"x2)+boundary("Open","Open","Open"," open ","Closed","Open","OPEN","Closed")
FIXTURE  weekly_01.xlsx sheet=Calib cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Next Calibration Due rows=8 data=A:seq(501,1);B:reldates(-30,90)+boundary(-5,0,14,15,16,90,"",-1)
FIXTURE  weekly_01.xlsx sheet=OverdueNcr cols=A:NCR No,B:Issue Date,C:Status rows=0 stale=2
FIXTURE  weekly_01.xlsx sheet=CalDue cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Next Calibration Due rows=0 stale=2
FIXTURE  weekly_01.xlsx sheet=Summary cols=A:Measure,B:Count rows=0 stale=2
TEST     fixture=weekly_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(NCR, Calib, OverdueNcr, CalDue, Summary) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 8 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTA(OverdueNcr![NCR No]) = 4 AND COUNTA(CalDue![Instrument ID]) = 6 AND COUNTA(Summary![Measure]) = 3 AND VALUE(Summary![Count]2) = 3 AND VALUE(Summary![Count]3) = 5 AND COUNTIF(OverdueNcr![NCR No], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTIF(CalDue![Instrument ID], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTIF(Summary![Measure], "stale") = 0
TEST     fixture=weekly_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(NCR, Calib, OverdueNcr, CalDue, Summary) assert=RESULT = 8 AND COUNTA(NCR![NCR No]) = PRE_COUNTA(NCR![NCR No]) AND COUNTIF(NCR![Status], "Open") = PRE_COUNTIF(NCR![Status], "Open") AND COUNTA(Calib![Instrument ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Calib![Instrument ID]) AND VALUE(OverdueNcr![NCR No]2) = 101 AND VALUE(OverdueNcr![NCR No]3) = 104 AND VALUE(OverdueNcr![NCR No]4) = 107 AND VALUE(OverdueNcr![Status]3) = " open " AND VALUE(CalDue![Instrument ID]2) = 501 AND VALUE(CalDue![Instrument ID]5) = 504 AND VALUE(CalDue![Instrument ID]6) = 508 AND VALUE(Summary![Measure]2) = "Overdue NCRs" AND VALUE(Summary![Measure]3) = "Calibration due"
TEST     fixture=weekly_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Summary, Calib, OverdueNcr, CalDue, NCR) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND COUNTA(Summary![Measure]) = PRE_COUNTA(Summary![Measure])

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the weekly quality tool on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many NCRs and instruments were listed.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "NCR Register"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Calibration Tracker"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Overdue NCRs"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Calibration Due"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Weekly Summary"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Items listed this week: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the whole weekly quality tool on the five sheets it is given and return how many NCRs and instruments were listed in total.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, cal As Worksheet, ncrOut As Worksheet, calOut As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nNcr As Long
VAR      nCal As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $ncrOut
MODIFIES $calOut
MODIFIES $summary
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListOverdueNcrs, $ncr, $ncrOut, 30, into=nNcr)
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListCalibrationDue, $cal, $calOut, 15, into=nCal)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteWeeklySummary, $summary, nNcr, nCal)
OP       RETURN(nNcr + nCal)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Overdue NCRs sheet with every Open NCR whose issue date is more than the limit of days ago, and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListOverdueNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, limit As Long
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ncr, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ncr, "Issue Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "NCR No", "Issue Date", "Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cNo) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ncr, r, cDate))
OP             IF CELL($ncr, r, cDate) < TODAY - $limit
OP               WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($ncr, r, cNo), CELL($ncr, r, cDate), CELL($ncr, r, cStatus))
OP               LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Calibration Due sheet with every instrument due within the window of days or already overdue, and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListCalibrationDue
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, window As Long
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Instrument ID", "Next Calibration Due")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) <= TODAY + $window
OP             WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($cal, r, cId), CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Weekly Summary sheet with a label and a count for the NCRs and for the instruments that were listed.
PROC     WriteWeeklySummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     summary As Worksheet, ncrCount As Long, calCount As Long
MODIFIES $summary
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($summary), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, 1, "Measure", "Count")
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, 2, "Overdue NCRs", $ncrCount)
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, 3, "Calibration due", $calCount)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
BUILD
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "Weld Log", "Weld Exceptions" and "Welder Exceptions" and all three exist; the TESTs call them Log, Exc and ByWelder
# ASSUME: Weld Log headers (row 1) include "Weld Seam No", "Welder ID" and "Visual"; the row-1 headings of Weld Exceptions are copied from the log
# ASSUME: a row with a Weld Seam No is an exception when its Visual is not Accepted (ignoring case and spaces); a blank Visual counts as an exception, not as accepted
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Weld Seam No is not a weld and is never an exception
# ASSUME: this tool owns the red fill on the log: every run removes the fill of rows that are not exceptions and fills the exception rows red
# ASSUME: an exception row with a blank Welder ID is copied but not counted for any welder; Welder IDs are trimmed and matched ignoring case; welders with equal counts come in no fixed order
# ASSUME: Weld Exceptions and Welder Exceptions are cleared and rebuilt on every run
GOAL     Highlight the weld log rows that are not Accepted, copy them to Weld Exceptions and count the exceptions of each welder, most first.
NAME     WeldFollowUp
TARGET   xlsm
ENTRY    modMain.Run
MODULE   modMain
MODULE   modSteps
SIG      modMain.Run()
SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(log As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet, byWelder As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.HighlightExceptions(log As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.CopyExceptions(log As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet)
SIG      modSteps.CountByWelder(log As Worksheet, out As Worksheet)
FLOW     modMain.Run -> modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.HighlightExceptions
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.CopyExceptions
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.CountByWelder
FIXTURE  weld_01.xlsx sheet=Log cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Welder ID,C:Visual rows=10 stale=4 data=A:text(6)+boundary("S-01","S-02","","S-04","S-05","S-06","S-07","S-08","S-09","S-10");B:text(4)+boundary("W-3","W-2","W-1","W-1"," w-1 ","W-3","","W-1","W-2","W-2");C:text(8)+boundary("Rejected","Repair","Rejected","Rejected","rejected"," accepted ","Rejected","","Accepted","Rejected")
FIXTURE  weld_01.xlsx sheet=Exc cols=A:Weld Seam No,B:Welder ID,C:Visual rows=0 stale=2
FIXTURE  weld_01.xlsx sheet=ByWelder cols=A:Welder ID,B:Exceptions rows=0 stale=2
TEST     fixture=weld_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Log, Exc, ByWelder) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 7 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(Log![Weld Seam No], #FF0000) = 7 AND FILL_COUNT(Log![Visual], #FF0000) = 7 AND COUNTA(Exc![Weld Seam No]) = 8 AND COUNTIF(Exc![Weld Seam No], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTA(ByWelder![Welder ID]) = 4 AND COUNTIF(ByWelder![Welder ID], "stale") = 0
TEST     fixture=weld_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Log, Exc, ByWelder) assert=RESULT = 7 AND COUNTA(Log![Weld Seam No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Log![Weld Seam No]) AND COUNTA(Log![Welder ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Log![Welder ID]) AND COUNTA(Log![Visual]) = PRE_COUNTA(Log![Visual]) AND VALUE(Exc![Weld Seam No]2) = "S-01" AND VALUE(Exc![Visual]2) = "Rejected" AND VALUE(Exc![Weld Seam No]8) = "S-10" AND ROWS_USED(Exc) = 8 AND ROWS_USED(ByWelder) = 4 AND VALUE(ByWelder![Welder ID]2) = "W-1" AND VALUE(ByWelder![Exceptions]2) = 3 AND VALUE(ByWelder![Welder ID]3) = "W-2" AND VALUE(ByWelder![Exceptions]3) = 2 AND VALUE(ByWelder![Welder ID]4) = "W-3" AND VALUE(ByWelder![Exceptions]4) = 1
TEST     fixture=weld_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(ByWelder, Exc, Log) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Log![Visual], #FF0000) = PRE_FILL_COUNT(Log![Visual], #FF0000)

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the weld follow-up tool on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many weld rows are exceptions.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Weld Log"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Weld Exceptions"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Exceptions"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Weld exceptions: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the whole weld follow-up on the three sheets it is given and return how many weld rows are exceptions.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     log As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet, byWelder As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($log, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $log fills
MODIFIES $exc
MODIFIES $byWelder
OP       CALL(modSteps.HighlightExceptions, $log, into=flagged)
OP       CALL(modSteps.CopyExceptions, $log, $exc)
OP       CALL(modSteps.CountByWelder, $log, $byWelder)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Fill red every weld log row whose Visual is not Accepted, remove the fill of every other row, and return how many rows are exceptions.
PROC     HighlightExceptions
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $log fills
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($log, "Visual"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($log, 1))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cSeam)) OR SAME(CELL($log, r, cVisual), "Accepted")
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($log, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP         ELSE
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($log, r, 1, lastCol), fill=red)
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Weld Exceptions sheet with the log's headings and a copy of every weld row whose Visual is not Accepted.
PROC     CopyExceptions
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $exc
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($log, "Visual"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($log, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($exc), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($log, 1, $exc, 1, cols=lastCol)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cSeam))
OP         SKIP_IF SAME(CELL($log, r, cVisual), "Accepted")
OP         COPY_ROW($log, r, $exc, outRow, cols=lastCol)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Welder Exceptions sheet with how many weld exceptions each welder has, the welder with the most first.
PROC     CountByWelder
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($log, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($log, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($log, "Visual"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Exceptions")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cSeam))
OP         SKIP_IF SAME(CELL($log, r, cVisual), "Accepted")
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cWelder))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, TRIM(CELL($log, r, cWelder)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)

GOAL     Highlight each welder qualification row red when it expired before today or yellow when it expires within 60 days, and return how many rows were highlighted.
PROC     HighlightWelderQuals
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelderQuals
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      lastC As Long
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Expiry Date") > 0

MODULE   modBomCheck

GOAL     Count the welds per joint type from the weld log and write them on the Joint Summary sheet with the biggest count first.
PROC     CountWeldsByJointType
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldSummary
ARGS     log As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJoint As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long

GOAL     Count the dispatches per customer and how many of them were late, and write that on the Customer Summary sheet from A to Z.
PROC     SummariseDispatchesByCustomer
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatchSummary
ARGS     dispatch As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cCust As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      cAct As Long
VAR      total As Dictionary
VAR      late As Dictionary
VAR      nTotal As Long
VAR      nLate As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($dispatch, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($dispatch, "Customer") > 0; COL($dispatch, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($dispatch, "Actual Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cCust, COL($dispatch, "Customer"))
OP       LET(cPlan, COL($dispatch, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cAct, COL($dispatch, "Actual Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Customer", "Dispatches", "Late")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($dispatch, cCust) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($dispatch, r, cCust))
OP         DICT_ADD(total, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($dispatch, r, cCust)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(late, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($dispatch, r, cCust)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($dispatch, r, cPlan))

OP               DICT_ADD(late, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($dispatch, r, cCust)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(total)
OP         DICT_GET(total, k, into=nTotal)
OP         DICT_GET(late, k, into=nLate)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nTotal, nLate)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(total))
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers in row 1 include "Part No" and "Required Qty"; GRN headers include "Part No" and "Received Qty"
# ASSUME: the BOM sheet is named BOM and the GRN sheet GRN; the new BOM headings are "Received" and "Balance"
# ASSUME: a missing Received or Balance heading is added after the last used column of row 1; an existing one is reused
# ASSUME: Part No is trimmed and matched ignoring case; GRN lines with a blank Part No or a Received Qty that is not a number are ignored
# ASSUME: Received is 0 for a part with no GRN line; Balance is Received minus Required Qty, and is left blank when Required Qty is not a number
# ASSUME: a BOM row with a blank Part No gets blank Received and Balance cells; both columns are recalculated from the GRN on every run
# ASSUME: the last row of the BOM and of the GRN has a Part No
GOAL     Add Received and Balance columns to the BOM with the total received per part from the GRN lines and received minus required.
PROC     AddReceivedAndBalanceToBom
KIND     Function
MODULE   modGrnCheck
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, grn As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      cRec As Long
VAR      cBal As Long
VAR      cGPart As Long
VAR      cGQty As Long
VAR      recd As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      done As Long
PRE      COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0
MODIFIES $bom
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(cGPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cGQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cRec, COL($bom, "Received"))
OP       IF cRec = 0
OP         LET(cRec, LASTCOL($bom, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, 1, cRec), "Received")
OP       LET(cBal, COL($bom, "Balance"))
OP       IF cBal = 0
OP         LET(cBal, LASTCOL($bom, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, 1, cBal), "Balance")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGPart) var=g
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, g, cGPart))
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, g, cGQty))
OP           DICT_ADD(recd, TRIM(CELL($grn, g, cGPart)), CELL($grn, g, cGQty), mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cPart))
OP           CLEAR(CELL($bom, r, cRec), what=contents)
OP           CLEAR(CELL($bom, r, cBal), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(got, 0)
OP           IF EXISTS(recd, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cPart)))
OP             DICT_GET(recd, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cPart)), into=got)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cRec), got)
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, r, cReq))
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cBal), got - CELL($bom, r, cReq))
OP           ELSE
OP             CLEAR(CELL($bom, r, cBal), what=contents)
OP           LET(done, done + 1)
OP       RETURN(done)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

TASK

GOAL     List on the Not Inspected sheet every weld log seam that has Visual Accepted but no row in the NDE Report.
PROC     ListSeamsWithoutNde
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNdeCheck
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cWSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      cNSeam As Long
VAR      seen As Dictionary
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Visual") > 0; COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cWSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($weld, "Visual"))
OP       LET(cNSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cNSeam) var=n
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, n, cNSeam))
OP         DICT_ADD(seen, TRIM(CELL($nde, n, cNSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Weld Seam No")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cWSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cWSeam))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($weld, r, cVisual), "Accepted") AND NOT EXISTS(seen, TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWSeam)))
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWSeam)))
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Issues headers in row 1 include "Issue No", "Batch No", "Qty Issued", "Job ID" and "Remark"; Jobs headers include "Job ID" and "Status"
# ASSUME: the Remark column already exists in the issue log; only that column changes
