GOAL     Write Closed job in the Remark column of every issue whose job is Closed in the Job Tracker, clear the remark on all other issues, and return how many issues are for closed jobs.
PROC     MarkClosedJobIssues
KIND     Function
MODULE   modConsumables
ARGS     issues As Worksheet, jobs As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cIssueNo As Long
VAR      cIssueJob As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cJobId As Long
VAR      cJobStatus As Long
VAR      jobState As Dictionary
VAR      state As String
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($issues, "Issue No") > 0; COL($issues, "Job ID") > 0; COL($issues, "Remark") > 0; COL($jobs, "Job ID") > 0; COL($jobs, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $issues["Remark"]
OP       LET(cIssueNo, COL($issues, "Issue No"))
OP       LET(cIssueJob, COL($issues, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($issues, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cJobId, COL($jobs, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cJobStatus, COL($jobs, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($jobs, cJobId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($jobs, r, cJobId))
OP         DICT_ADD(jobState, TRIM(CELL($jobs, r, cJobId)), TRIM(CELL($jobs, r, cJobStatus)), mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($issues, cIssueNo) var=i
OP         IF EXISTS(jobState, TRIM(CELL($issues, i, cIssueJob)))
OP           DICT_GET(jobState, TRIM(CELL($issues, i, cIssueJob)), into=state)
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(state, "")
OP         IF SAME(state, "Closed")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($issues, i, cRemark), "Closed job")
OP           LET(marked, marked + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($issues, i, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(marked)
ERR      standard

# ASSUME: trimming removes only the spaces at both ends of a cell; spaces inside the text stay
# ASSUME: Part No is trimmed and made upper case; GRN No is only trimmed and keeps its case
# ASSUME: a cell counts as changed only when its text differs from what it held; a cell holding a number is not changed
GOAL     Trim the spaces from the Part No and GRN No cells of the GRN sheet, make Part No upper case, and return how many cells changed.
PROC     TidyGrnCells
KIND     Function
MODULE   modGrnCleanup
ARGS     grn As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cGrn As Long
VAR      newPart As String
VAR      newGrn As String
VAR      changed As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0
MODIFIES $grn["Part No", "GRN No"]
OP       LET(cPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cGrn, COL($grn, "GRN No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cPart) var=r
OP         LET(newPart, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cPart))))
OP         IF newPart <> CELL($grn, r, cPart)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($grn, r, cPart), newPart)
OP           LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGrn) var=g
OP         LET(newGrn, TRIM(CELL($grn, g, cGrn)))
OP         IF newGrn <> CELL($grn, g, cGrn)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($grn, g, cGrn), newGrn)
OP           LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       RETURN(changed)
ERR      standard

TASK
# ASSUME: Weld log headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No" and "Welder ID"; every column of the log has a header

# ASSUME: leftover empty rows are rows where Weld Seam No and Welder ID are blank and every other cell is blank too

GOAL     Delete the leftover empty rows of the weld log, those with both Weld Seam No and Welder ID blank, keep any row holding data, and return how many rows were deleted.
PROC     RemoveEmptyWeldRows
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldCleanup
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      last As Long
VAR      hasOther As Boolean
VAR      removed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ws, "Welder ID") > 0
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($ws, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($ws, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       LOOP_COLS dir=right from=1 to=lastCol var=k
OP         IF LASTROW($ws, k) > last THEN LET(last, LASTROW($ws, k))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=up from=last to=2 var=r
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cSeam))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cWelder))
OP         LET(hasOther, FALSE)
OP         LOOP_COLS dir=right from=1 to=lastCol var=c
OP           IF c <> cSeam AND c <> cWelder AND NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, c)) THEN LET(hasOther, TRUE)
OP         IF NOT hasOther
OP           DELETE_ROW($ws, r)
OP           LET(removed, removed + 1)
OP       RETURN(removed)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the weld quality review on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many welds are exceptions.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Weld Log"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Quals"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Exceptions"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Summary"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Month Summary"), into=n)
OP       IF n < 0
OP         MSG("The weld review did not run: check the sheet headings, see ForgeLog.")
OP       ELSE
OP         MSG("Weld exceptions: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the four steps of the weld quality review on the five sheets it is given and return how many welds are exceptions.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet, wsum As Worksheet, msum As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nExc As Long
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($weld, "Weld Date") > 0; COL($weld, "Process") > 0; COL($weld, "Visual") > 0; COL($weld, "Remark") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $weld["Remark"]
MODIFIES $exc
MODIFIES $wsum
MODIFIES $msum
OP       CALL(modQual.MarkQualification, $weld, $quals)
OP       CALL(modReport.CopyExceptions, $weld, $exc, into=nExc)
OP       CALL(modReport.WriteWelderSummary, $weld, $exc, $wsum)
OP       CALL(modReport.WriteMonthSummary, $weld, $msum, nExc)
OP       RETURN(nExc)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Not qualified in Remark for each weld whose welder has no qualification for its process valid on the weld date, and clear Remark on the others.
PROC     MarkQualification
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modQual
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      qWelder As Long
VAR      qProc As Long
VAR      qExpiry As Long
VAR      latest As Dictionary
VAR      lookup As String
VAR      known As Variant
VAR      qualified As Boolean
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($weld, "Weld Date") > 0; COL($weld, "Process") > 0; COL($weld, "Remark") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $weld["Remark"]
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($weld, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($weld, "Weld Date"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($weld, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($weld, "Remark"))
OP       LET(qWelder, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(qProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(qExpiry, COL($quals, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, qWelder) var=q
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, qWelder)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, qProc))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($quals, q, qExpiry))
OP         LET(lookup, TRIM(CELL($quals, q, qWelder)) & "|" & TRIM(CELL($quals, q, qProc)))
OP         IF EXISTS(latest, lookup)
OP           DICT_GET(latest, lookup, into=known)
OP           IF IS_DATE(known)
OP             IF CELL($quals, q, qExpiry) > known
OP               DICT_ADD(latest, lookup, CELL($quals, q, qExpiry), mode=overwrite)
OP         ELSE
OP           DICT_ADD(latest, lookup, CELL($quals, q, qExpiry), mode=overwrite)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cSeam))
OP         LET(qualified, FALSE)
OP         LET(lookup, TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWelder)) & "|" & TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cProc)))
OP         IF EXISTS(latest, lookup)
OP           DICT_GET(latest, lookup, into=known)
OP           IF IS_DATE(known)
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($weld, r, cDate))
OP               IF known >= CELL($weld, r, cDate)
OP                 LET(qualified, TRUE)
OP         IF qualified
OP           CLEAR(CELL($weld, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($weld, r, cRemark), "Not qualified")
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Exceptions sheet with the Weld Log headings and a copy of every weld whose Visual is not Accepted or whose Remark is Not qualified.
PROC     CopyExceptions
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReport
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      nCols As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Visual") > 0; COL($weld, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $exc
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($weld, "Visual"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($weld, "Remark"))
OP       LET(nCols, LASTCOL($weld, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($exc), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($weld, 1, $exc, 1, cols=nCols)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cSeam))
OP         IF NOT SAME(CELL($weld, r, cVisual), "Accepted") OR SAME(CELL($weld, r, cRemark), "Not qualified")
OP           COPY_ROW($weld, r, $exc, outRow, cols=nCols)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the Exceptions sheet is a copy of the Weld Log rows, so its Welder ID and Weld Seam No sit in the same columns as in the Weld Log
GOAL     Rebuild the Welder Summary sheet with one row for each welder: the welds, the exceptions and the exception rate.
PROC     WriteWelderSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modReport
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, exc As Worksheet, wsum As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      welds As Dictionary
VAR      excs As Dictionary
VAR      who As String
VAR      nW As Variant
VAR      nE As Variant
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Welder ID") > 0
MODIFIES $wsum
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($weld, "Welder ID"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cSeam))
OP         LET(who, IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cWelder)), "(no ID)", TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWelder))))
OP         DICT_ADD(welds, who, 1, mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($exc, cSeam) var=e
OP         LET(who, IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($exc, e, cWelder)), "(no ID)", TRIM(CELL($exc, e, cWelder))))
OP         DICT_ADD(excs, who, 1, mode=sum)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($wsum), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($wsum, 1, "Welder ID", "Welds", "Exceptions", "Exception Rate")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(welds)
OP         DICT_GET(welds, k, into=nW)
OP         LET(nE, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(excs, k)
OP           DICT_GET(excs, k, into=nE)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(nW)
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(nE)
OP             WRITE_ROW($wsum, outRow, k, nW, nE, nE / nW)
OP             FORMAT(CELL($wsum, outRow, 4), numfmt="0.0%")
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Month Summary sheet with the month's total welds, total exceptions and exception rate.
PROC     WriteMonthSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modReport
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, msum As Worksheet, excCount As Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      welds As Long
VAR      rate As Double
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0
MODIFIES $msum
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cSeam))
OP         LET(welds, welds + 1)
OP       IF welds > 0 THEN LET(rate, $excCount / welds)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($msum), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($msum, 1, "Welds", "Exceptions", "Rate")
OP       WRITE_ROW($msum, 2, welds, $excCount, rate)
OP       FORMAT(CELL($msum, 2, 3), numfmt="0.0%")
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the receiving check on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many GRN lines were flagged Check.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "GRN"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Material Certs"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "BOM"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Missing Certs"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Shortages"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Receiving Summary"), into=n)
OP       MSG("GRN lines flagged Check: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all four receiving steps on the sheets it is given and return how many GRN lines were flagged Check.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet, bom As Worksheet, missing As Worksheet, shortages As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nCheck As Long
VAR      nMissing As Long
VAR      nShort As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0; COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Remark") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0
MODIFIES $grn["Remark"]
MODIFIES $missing
MODIFIES $shortages
MODIFIES $summary
OP       CALL(modReceiving.FlagGrnLines, $grn, into=nCheck)
OP       CALL(modReceiving.ListMissingCerts, $grn, $certs, $missing, into=nMissing)
OP       CALL(modReceiving.ListShortages, $grn, $bom, $shortages, into=nShort)
OP       CALL(modReceiving.WriteSummary, $summary, nCheck, nMissing, nShort)
OP       RETURN(nCheck)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Check in the Remark column of every GRN line with no positive received quantity or no heat number, clear it on the others and return how many were flagged.
PROC     FlagGrnLines
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReceiving
ARGS     grn As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cGrn As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      isBad As Boolean
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $grn["Remark"]
OP       LET(cGrn, COL($grn, "GRN No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($grn, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGrn) var=r
OP         LET(isBad, FALSE)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, cQty))
OP           IF CELL($grn, r, cQty) <= 0 THEN LET(isBad, TRUE)
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(isBad, TRUE)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cHeat)) THEN LET(isBad, TRUE)
OP         IF isBad
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($grn, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($grn, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Missing Certs sheet with the GRN lines whose heat number is not in Material Certs and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListMissingCerts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReceiving
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet, missing As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cGrn As Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cCert As Long
VAR      known As Dictionary
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0; COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0
MODIFIES $missing
OP       LET(cGrn, COL($grn, "GRN No"))
OP       LET(cPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cCert, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($missing), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($missing, 1, "GRN No", "Part No", "Heat No")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cCert) var=r
OP         DICT_ADD(known, TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cCert)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGrn) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cHeat))
OP         SKIP_IF EXISTS(known, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cHeat)))
OP         WRITE_ROW($missing, outRow, CELL($grn, r, cGrn), CELL($grn, r, cPart), TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cHeat)))
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Shortages sheet with each BOM part whose good received quantity is below the required quantity, with the shortfall, and return how many parts were listed.
PROC     ListShortages
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReceiving
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, bom As Worksheet, shortages As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cGrnPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cBomPart As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      got As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0
MODIFIES $shortages
OP       LET(cGrnPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cBomPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($shortages), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($shortages, 1, "Part No", "Required Qty", "Valid Qty", "Shortfall")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGrnPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cHeat))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, cQty))
OP         IF CELL($grn, r, cQty) > 0 THEN DICT_ADD(totals, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cGrnPart)), CELL($grn, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cBomPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cBomPart))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, r, cReq))
OP         LET(got, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(totals, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cBomPart)))
OP           DICT_GET(totals, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cBomPart)), into=got)
OP         IF CELL($bom, r, cReq) > got
OP           WRITE_ROW($shortages, outRow, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cBomPart)), CELL($bom, r, cReq), got, CELL($bom, r, cReq) - got)

KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, itp As Worksheet, cal As Worksheet, overdue As Worksheet, caldue As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nOverdue As Long
VAR      nHeld As Long

PRE      COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "ITP No") > 0; COL($itp, "ITP No") > 0; COL($itp, "Hold Flag") > 0; COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0

MODIFIES $overdue

OP       CALL(modNcr.FlagHeldPoints, $ncr, $itp, into=nHeld)
OP       CALL(modCalibration.ListCalibrationDue, $cal, $caldue, into=nDue)

TASK
# ASSUME: the output sheet is rebuilt from scratch on every run and gets the same four headers as the register
GOAL     Rebuild the Overdue NCRs sheet with every Open NCR issued more than 30 days ago and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListOverdueNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcr
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cItp As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "ITP No") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ncr, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ncr, "Issue Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LET(cItp, COL($ncr, "ITP No"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "NCR No", "Issue Date", "Status", "ITP No")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cNo) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ncr, r, cDate))
OP             IF CELL($ncr, r, cDate) < TODAY - 30
OP               WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($ncr, r, cNo), CELL($ncr, r, cDate), CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), CELL($ncr, r, cItp))
OP               LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write NCR Hold in the Hold Flag of every ITP point that has an Open NCR, clear that flag on the other points and return how many points are held.
PROC     FlagHeldPoints
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcr
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, itp As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cNcrItp As Long
VAR      cItp As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long
VAR      openItps As Dictionary
VAR      held As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "ITP No") > 0; COL($itp, "ITP No") > 0; COL($itp, "Hold Flag") > 0
MODIFIES $itp["Hold Flag"]
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LET(cNcrItp, COL($ncr, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(cItp, COL($itp, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(cFlag, COL($itp, "Hold Flag"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cStatus) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Open") AND NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, r, cNcrItp))
OP           DICT_ADD(openItps, TRIM(CELL($ncr, r, cNcrItp)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($itp, cItp) var=p
OP         IF EXISTS(openItps, TRIM(CELL($itp, p, cItp)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, p, cFlag), "NCR Hold")
OP           LET(held, held + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF SAME(CELL($itp, p, cFlag), "NCR Hold")
OP             CLEAR(CELL($itp, p, cFlag), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(held)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Calibration Due sheet with every instrument that is overdue or due within 15 days and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListCalibrationDue
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Instrument ID", "Next Calibration Due")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 15
OP             WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($cal, r, cId), CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: WPS Register headers in row 1 include "WPS No", "PQR Ref" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: a row with a blank WPS No is not a WPS: it is skipped and its Remark is left alone
# ASSUME: "starts with PQR-" ignores case and stray spaces at the start, so " pqr-12" is fine; a blank PQR Ref is marked
# ASSUME: the count is every WPS marked Check by this run, whether or not it already said Check, so a re-run gives the same count
GOAL     Write Check in Remark for every WPS whose PQR Ref does not start with PQR-, clear Remark on the others, and tell how many were marked.
PROC     FlagWpsWithoutPqr
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWps
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cWps As Long
VAR      cPqr As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "WPS No") > 0; COL($ws, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cWps, COL($ws, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cPqr, COL($ws, "PQR Ref"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cWps) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cWps))
OP         IF SAME(LEFT(TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cPqr)), 4), "PQR-")
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP           LET(marked, marked + 1)
OP       MSG("WPS marked Check: " & marked)
OP       RETURN(marked)
ERR      standard

KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      cActual As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long

GOAL     Write Overdue in the Flag column of every ITP point that is not Closed and planned before today, clear the Flag on all other points, and return how many are overdue.
PROC     FlagOverduePoints
KIND     Function
MODULE   modItp
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long

PRE      COL($ws, "ITP No") > 0; COL($ws, "Inspection Status") > 0; COL($ws, "Planned Date") > 0

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Welder Quals headers in row 1 include "Process" and "Expiry Date"; the real sheets are "Welder Quals" and "Qual Summary", the TESTs use Quals and QualSummary
# ASSUME: the Qual Summary sheet already exists and is rebuilt on every run with the headers Process, Valid Over 60 Days, Expiring Within 60 Days and Expired
# ASSUME: valid for more than 60 days means expiry after today plus 60; expiring within the next 60 days means today up to and including today plus 60; expired means before today
# ASSUME: processes are matched ignoring case and stray spaces and shown as first typed; a row with no process or an Expiry Date that is not a real date is ignored
GOAL     Rebuild the Qual Summary sheet with one row per welding process, in alphabetical order, counting qualifications valid for over 60 days, expiring within 60 days and already expired.
PROC     BuildQualSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modQuals
ARGS     quals As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cExp As Long
VAR      p As String
VAR      valid As Dictionary
VAR      soon As Dictionary
VAR      gone As Dictionary
VAR      nValid As Long
VAR      nSoon As Long
VAR      nGone As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(cExp, COL($quals, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, cProc) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, r, cProc))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($quals, r, cExp))
OP         LET(p, TRIM(CELL($quals, r, cProc)))
OP         DICT_ADD(valid, p, 0, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(soon, p, 0, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(gone, p, 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF CELL($quals, r, cExp) < TODAY
OP           DICT_ADD(gone, p, 1, mode=sum)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF CELL($quals, r, cExp) <= TODAY + 60
OP             DICT_ADD(soon, p, 1, mode=sum)
OP           ELSE
OP             DICT_ADD(valid, p, 1, mode=sum)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "Valid Over 60 Days", "Expiring Within 60 Days", "Expired")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(valid)
OP         DICT_GET(valid, k, into=nValid)
OP         DICT_GET(soon, k, into=nSoon)
OP         DICT_GET(gone, k, into=nGone)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nValid, nSoon, nGone)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard

GOAL     Rebuild the Process Summary sheet with each welding process, how many WPS it has and how many of those have no PQR Ref, sorted A to Z.
PROC     BuildProcessSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWps
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cPqr As Long
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      noPqr As Dictionary
VAR      nTotal As Long
VAR      nNoPqr As Long

OP       RETURN(COUNT(totals))

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Certs headers in row 1 include "Heat No", "MTC No" and "Supplier"; the real sheets are "Material Certs" and "Supplier Summary", the TESTs use MaterialCerts and SupplierSummary
# ASSUME: the Supplier Summary sheet already exists and is passed in as out; it is rebuilt from scratch on every run

GOAL     Rebuild the Supplier Summary sheet with the number of certificates per supplier and how many of them have no MTC No, the supplier with the most certificates first.
PROC     SummariseCertsBySupplier
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      cSupplier As Long
VAR      sup As String
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      noMtc As Dictionary
VAR      total As Long
VAR      noMtcCount As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0; COL($certs, "Supplier") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($certs, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(cSupplier, COL($certs, "Supplier"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Supplier", "Certificates", "No MTC No")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cSupplier) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier))
OP         LET(sup, TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier)))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, sup, 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(noMtc, sup, IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cMtc)), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=total)
OP         DICT_GET(noMtc, k, into=noMtcCount)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, total, noMtcCount)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF COUNT(counts) > 1
OP         SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(counts))
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Dispatch headers in row 1 include "Job ID" and "Actual Date"; the Job Tracker headers include "Job ID"; "Dispatch Remark" is added after the last heading when it is missing
# ASSUME: Job IDs are compared after trimming spaces at both ends, ignoring case, so J-101 and " j-101 " are the same job

GOAL     Write Dispatched in the Job Tracker's Dispatch Remark column for each job with at least one dispatch that has an Actual Date, clear it on the other jobs, and return how many jobs are dispatched.
PROC     MarkDispatchedJobs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     dispatch As Worksheet, tracker As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJobD As Long
VAR      cActual As Long
VAR      cJobT As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      sent As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($dispatch, "Job ID") > 0; COL($dispatch, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($tracker, "Job ID") > 0
MODIFIES $tracker
OP       LET(cJobD, COL($dispatch, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cActual, COL($dispatch, "Actual Date"))
OP       LET(cJobT, COL($tracker, "Job ID"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($dispatch, cJobD) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($dispatch, r, cJobD))
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($dispatch, r, cActual))
OP           DICT_ADD(sent, TRIM(CELL($dispatch, r, cJobD)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       IF COL($tracker, "Dispatch Remark") = 0
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, 1, LASTCOL($tracker, 1) + 1), "Dispatch Remark")
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($tracker, "Dispatch Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cJobT) var=t
OP         CLEAR(CELL($tracker, t, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         IF EXISTS(sent, TRIM(CELL($tracker, t, cJobT)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, t, cRemark), "Dispatched")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

GOAL     List on the No WPS sheet every welder qualification whose process has no WPS in the register, and return how many were listed.

MODULE   modWelderQuals

VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      cWpsProc As Long

PRE      COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0

OP       LET(cWelder, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($quals, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LET(cWpsProc, COL($wps, "Process"))

OP       RETURN(listed)

PROC     NormaliseInspectionStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modItp
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      changed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Inspection Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Inspection Status"]
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Inspection Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cStatus) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           IF CELL($ws, r, cStatus) <> "Open"
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP             LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cStatus) <> "Closed"
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP               LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       MSG("Cells changed: " & changed)
OP       RETURN(changed)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Method", "Result" and "Report Date"
# ASSUME: the "Rejected Welds" sheet already exists; it is rebuilt on every run with the four NDE Report headings in that order

GOAL     Rebuild the Rejected Welds sheet with every NDE Report row whose Result is Reject, newest Report Date first, and return how many rows were listed.
PROC     ListRejectedWelds
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cMethod As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      listed As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0; COL($nde, "Report Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cMethod, COL($nde, "Method"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($nde, "Report Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, CELL($nde, 1, cSeam), CELL($nde, 1, cMethod), CELL($nde, 1, cResult), CELL($nde, 1, cDate))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cResult) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Reject")
OP           LET(listed, listed + 1)
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, listed + 1, CELL($nde, r, cSeam), CELL($nde, r, cMethod), CELL($nde, r, cResult), CELL($nde, r, cDate))
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=4, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(listed)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Report File" and "Status"
# ASSUME: the real sheet is "NDE Report"; the TESTs use NdeReport
# ASSUME: both folders exist; each report is copied directly into the Archive folder, never moved, and nothing is overwritten or deleted
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Weld Seam No is skipped; a blank or unsafe Report File gets Status "Bad name"
# ASSUME: Status holds the copy's result: Copied, Already there, Missing or Bad name, and also Conflict (a different file of that name is already in Archive), Locked or Too long (in Excel also Check copy or Failed)
GOAL     Copy each NDE report file named in the NDE Report sheet from the Reports folder into the Archive folder and write what happened in the Status column.
PROC     ArchiveNdeReports
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, reports As String, archive As String
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cFile As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      status As String
VAR      copied As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Report File") > 0; COL($nde, "Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($reports); FOLDER_EXISTS($archive)
MODIFIES $nde["Status"]
MODIFIES $archive files
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cFile, COL($nde, "Report File"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($nde, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cSeam))
OP         COPY_FILE(PATH_JOIN($reports, SAFE_NAME(CELL($nde, r, cFile))), PATH_JOIN($archive, SAFE_NAME(CELL($nde, r, cFile))), into=status)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($nde, r, cStatus), status)
OP         IF status = "Copied" THEN LET(copied, copied + 1)
OP       RETURN(copied)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Dispatch headers in row 1 include "Dispatch No" and "Actual Date"
# ASSUME: the real sheet is "Dispatch" and the real folder is "Dispatch Docs"; the TESTs use Dispatch and Docs

GOAL     Count the dispatches that have no actual date, write that number as text into open_dispatches.txt in the Dispatch Docs folder unless it already holds it, and show what happened in G1.
PROC     WriteOpenDispatchCount
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     ws As Worksheet, docs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cActual As Long
VAR      openCount As Long
VAR      status As String
PRE      COL($ws, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Actual Date") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($docs)
MODIFIES $ws
MODIFIES $docs files
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ws, "Dispatch No"))
OP       LET(cActual, COL($ws, "Actual Date"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cNo))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cActual))
OP           LET(openCount, openCount + 1)
OP       WRITE_TEXT(PATH_JOIN($docs, "open_dispatches.txt"), "" & openCount, into=status)
OP       SET_VALUE(RANGE($ws, "G1"), status)
OP       RETURN(openCount)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Certs headers in row 1 include "Supplier"; the Suppliers sheet already exists and is passed as out; it is cleared and rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: suppliers are matched after CLEAN_TEXT (extra spaces removed), ignoring case, so 'Acme Steel' and 'ACME STEEL' are one supplier; the first spelling found is the one listed
# ASSUME: rows with no supplier are ignored; the list has the single heading Supplier in A1 and is sorted A to Z
# ASSUME: the out sheet never has a Heat No heading, so a certificates sheet passed as out by mistake is left alone instead of being cleared
GOAL     Rebuild the Suppliers sheet with each supplier from the Material Certs sheet listed once, in alphabetical order, and return how many suppliers there are.
PROC     ListSuppliers
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSupplier As Long
VAR      supplier As String
VAR      seen As Dictionary
VAR      shown As String
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Supplier") > 0; COL($out, "Heat No") = 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSupplier, COL($certs, "Supplier"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cSupplier) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier))
OP         LET(supplier, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier)))
OP         DICT_ADD(seen, supplier, supplier, mode=keep)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Supplier")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(seen)
OP         DICT_GET(seen, k, into=shown)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, shown)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(seen))
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the WPS check on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many WPS were marked Check.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "WPS Register"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Quals"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "No WPS"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Process Summary"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "WPS Summary"), into=n)
OP       MSG("WPS marked Check: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run every step of the WPS check on the five sheets it is given and return how many WPS were marked Check.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet, noWps As Worksheet, procSum As Worksheet, wpsSum As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      flagged As Long
VAR      unmatched As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($wps, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($wps, "Review Date") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $wps["Remark"]
MODIFIES $noWps
MODIFIES $procSum
MODIFIES $wpsSum
OP       CALL(modChecks.MarkCheck, $wps, into=flagged)
OP       CALL(modLists.ListNoWps, $wps, $quals, $noWps, into=unmatched)
OP       CALL(modSummary.WriteProcessSummary, $wps, $quals, $procSum)
OP       CALL(modSummary.WriteTotals, $wps, $wpsSum, flagged, unmatched)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Check in Remark for every WPS with no PQR reference or a review date over 365 days old, and clear Remark on the others.
PROC     MarkCheck
KIND     Function
MODULE   modChecks
ARGS     wps As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cPqr As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      old As Boolean
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($wps, "Review Date") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $wps["Remark"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cPqr, COL($wps, "PQR Ref"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($wps, "Review Date"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo))
OP         LET(old, FALSE)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($wps, r, cDate))
OP           IF CELL($wps, r, cDate) < TODAY - 365
OP             LET(old, TRUE)
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cPqr)) OR old
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     List every welder qualification whose process has no WPS in the register on the output sheet and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListNoWps
KIND     Function
MODULE   modLists
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cQProc As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      known As Dictionary
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      listed As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($wps, "Process"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cQProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($quals, "Expiry Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Process", "Expiry Date")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(known, TRIM(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, cWelder) var=q
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, cWelder))
OP         IF NOT EXISTS(known, TRIM(CELL($quals, q, cQProc)))
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($quals, q, cWelder), CELL($quals, q, cQProc), CELL($quals, q, cExpiry))
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP           LET(listed, listed + 1)
OP       RETURN(listed)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the process summary with each register process, its WPS count, its Check count and its qualification count, A to Z.
PROC     WriteProcessSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSummary
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cQProc As Long
VAR      wpsCounts As Dictionary
VAR      checkCounts As Dictionary
VAR      qualCounts As Dictionary
VAR      nWps As Long
VAR      nCheck As Long
VAR      nQual As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($wps, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cQProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "WPS", "Check WPS", "Qualifications")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(wpsCounts, TRIM(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP           DICT_ADD(checkCounts, TRIM(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, cWelder) var=q
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, cWelder)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, cQProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(qualCounts, TRIM(CELL($quals, q, cQProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(wpsCounts)
OP         DICT_GET(wpsCounts, k, into=nWps)
OP         LET(nCheck, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(checkCounts, k) THEN DICT_GET(checkCounts, k, into=nCheck)
OP         LET(nQual, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(qualCounts, k) THEN DICT_GET(qualCounts, k, into=nQual)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nWps, nCheck, nQual)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the WPS summary sheet with labelled totals for all WPS, Check WPS and qualifications that have no WPS.
PROC     WriteTotals
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSummary
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, flagged As Long, unmatched As Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      total As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo)) THEN LET(total, total + 1)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Measure", "Value")
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 2, "Total WPS", total)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 3, "Check WPS", $flagged)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 4, "Qualifications with no WPS", $unmatched)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the inspection follow-up on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many rejects were listed.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "NDE Report"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "ITP Tracker"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Rejects"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Method Summary"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Inspection Summary"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Rejects listed: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run every step of the inspection follow-up on the five sheets it is given and return how many rejects were listed.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, itp As Worksheet, rejects As Worksheet, methodSum As Worksheet, inspSum As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nRejects As Long
VAR      nOverdue As Long
VAR      nMethods As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0; COL($nde, "Report Date") > 0; COL($itp, "Point") > 0; COL($itp, "Inspection Status") > 0; COL($itp, "Planned Date") > 0
MODIFIES $itp
MODIFIES $rejects
MODIFIES $methodSum
MODIFIES $inspSum
OP       CALL(modRejects.ListRejects, $nde, $rejects, into=nRejects)
OP       CALL(modTracker.FlagOverdue, $itp, into=nOverdue)
OP       CALL(modSummary.WriteMethodSummary, $nde, $methodSum, into=nMethods)
OP       CALL(modSummary.WriteInspectionSummary, $inspSum, nRejects, nOverdue, nMethods)
OP       RETURN(nRejects)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Rejects sheet with every NDE row whose result is Reject, newest report first, and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListRejects
KIND     Function
MODULE   modRejects
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cMethod As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      listed As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0; COL($nde, "Report Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cMethod, COL($nde, "Method"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($nde, "Report Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Weld Seam No", "Method", "Result", "Report Date")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cResult) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Reject")
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($nde, r, cSeam), CELL($nde, r, cMethod), CELL($nde, r, cResult), CELL($nde, r, cDate))
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP           LET(listed, listed + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=4, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(listed)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Overdue in the Flag column for every point that is not Closed and is planned before today, and clear Flag on the others.
PROC     FlagOverdue
KIND     Function
MODULE   modTracker
ARGS     itp As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPoint As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cPlanned As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long
VAR      late As Boolean
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($itp, "Point") > 0; COL($itp, "Inspection Status") > 0; COL($itp, "Planned Date") > 0
MODIFIES $itp
OP       LET(cPoint, COL($itp, "Point"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($itp, "Inspection Status"))
OP       LET(cPlanned, COL($itp, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cFlag, COL($itp, "Flag"))
OP       IF cFlag = 0
OP         LET(cFlag, LASTCOL($itp, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, 1, cFlag), "Flag")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($itp, cPoint) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($itp, r, cPoint))
OP         LET(late, FALSE)
OP         IF NOT SAME(CELL($itp, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($itp, r, cPlanned))
OP             IF CELL($itp, r, cPlanned) < TODAY
OP               LET(late, TRUE)
OP         IF late
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, r, cFlag), "Overdue")
OP           LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($itp, r, cFlag), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the method summary with each NDE method and how many of its results are Accept, Repair and Reject, A to Z.
PROC     WriteMethodSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSummary
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cMethod As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      accCounts As Dictionary
VAR      repCounts As Dictionary
VAR      rejCounts As Dictionary
VAR      nAccept As Long
VAR      nRepair As Long
VAR      nReject As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cMethod, COL($nde, "Method"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Method", "Accept", "Repair", "Reject")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cMethod) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))
OP         DICT_ADD(accCounts, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Accept"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(repCounts, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Repair"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(rejCounts, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod)), IIF(SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Reject"), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(accCounts)
OP         DICT_GET(accCounts, k, into=nAccept)
OP         DICT_GET(repCounts, k, into=nRepair)
OP         DICT_GET(rejCounts, k, into=nReject)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nAccept, nRepair, nReject)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(accCounts))
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the inspection summary sheet with labelled counts of rejects, overdue points and methods.
PROC     WriteInspectionSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSummary
ARGS     out As Worksheet, rejected As Long, overdue As Long, methodCount As Long
MODIFIES $out
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Measure", "Value")
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 2, "Rejects", $rejected)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 3, "Overdue points", $overdue)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 4, "Methods", $methodCount)
ERR      standard

an Expiry Date that is blank or is not a real Excel date (typed text) counts as no date: its Remark is cleared

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the sheet's headers in row 1 include "Batch No", "Expiry Date" and "Remark"; every batch has a Batch No, so rows are read down to the last Batch No
# ASSUME: a batch that expires today is not yet expired: it gets "Expiring soon", as does every date from today to today + 30 days
# ASSUME: an Expiry Date that is blank or is not a real Excel date (typed text) counts as no date: its Remark is cleared
# ASSUME: the count of expired batches is returned and shown in a message
GOAL     Write Expired or Expiring soon in the Remark column of the Consumable Stock sheet from each batch's Expiry Date, clear the other remarks and count the expired batches.
PROC     FlagExpiringBatches
KIND     Function
MODULE   modConsumables
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      expired As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Batch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($ws, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($ws, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LET(expired, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cBatch) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cExpiry))
OP           IF CELL($ws, r, cExpiry) < TODAY
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Expired")
OP             LET(expired, expired + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cExpiry) <= TODAY + 30
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Expiring soon")
OP             ELSE
OP               CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       MSG("Expired batches: " & expired)
OP       RETURN(expired)
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  stock_01.xlsx sheet=Stock cols=A:Batch No,B:Description,C:Expiry Date,D:Qty On Hand,E:Remark rows=10 data=A:seq(1001,1);B:text(10);C:reldates(-60,90)+boundary(-1,0,30,31,-20,10,60,1,-5,"");D:int(1,50);E:values("Expired"x3,"Expiring soon"x2,"old"x4,""x1)+boundary("old","Expired","old","Expiring soon","Expiring soon","Expired","Expired","","old","old")
FIXTURE  stock_01.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=2 data=A:text(8)
TEST     fixture=stock_01.xlsx call=FlagExpiringBatches(Stock) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 3 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTIF(Stock![Remark], "Expired") = 3 AND COUNTIF(Stock![Remark], "Expiring soon") = 4 AND COUNTIF(Stock![Remark], "old") = 0 AND COUNTA(Stock![Remark]) = 8 AND VALUE(Stock![Remark]2) = "Expired" AND VALUE(Stock![Remark]3) = "Expiring soon" AND VALUE(Stock![Remark]4) = "Expiring soon" AND VALUE(Stock![Remark]6) = "Expired" AND VALUE(Stock![Remark]10) = "Expired"
TEST     fixture=stock_01.xlsx call=FlagExpiringBatches(Stock) assert=RESULT = 3 AND COUNTA(Stock![Batch No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Stock![Batch No]) AND COUNTA(Stock![Expiry Date]) = PRE_COUNTA(Stock![Expiry Date]) AND SUM(Stock![Qty On Hand]) = PRE_SUM(Stock![Qty On Hand])
TEST     fixture=stock_01.xlsx call=FlagExpiringBatches(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the real sheet is "Calibration Tracker"; its row-1 headers include "Instrument ID", "Last Calibrated" and "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: only the Instrument ID cells from row 2 to the last Instrument ID are cleared and coloured; fills elsewhere stay
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Instrument ID is not an instrument: its old highlight is cleared and it is not coloured
# ASSUME: yellow needs real dates in both cells; a due date typed as text, or a missing Last Calibrated, is left uncoloured
# ASSUME: a due date equal to Last Calibrated is not earlier, so it is not coloured
# ASSUME: the number of cells coloured is the macro's return value
GOAL     Highlight the Instrument ID red where the next calibration due date is blank and yellow where it is earlier than the last calibration, and count the cells coloured.
PROC     HighlightCalibrationDateProblems
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cLast As Long
VAR      cNext As Long
VAR      coloured As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Last Calibrated") > 0; COL($ws, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cId, COL($ws, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cLast, COL($ws, "Last Calibrated"))
OP       LET(cNext, COL($ws, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cId) var=r
OP         FORMAT(CELL($ws, r, cId), fill=none)
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cId))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cNext))
OP           FORMAT(CELL($ws, r, cId), fill=red)
OP           LET(coloured, coloured + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cNext))
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cLast))
OP               IF CELL($ws, r, cNext) < CELL($ws, r, cLast)
OP                 FORMAT(CELL($ws, r, cId), fill=yellow)
OP                 LET(coloured, coloured + 1)
OP       RETURN(coloured)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TASK
# ASSUME: the Job Tracker headers in row 1 include "Job ID", "Start Date", "Due Date" and "Status"; the TESTs call the sheet Jobs
# ASSUME: a missing "Flag" heading is added in the first free column of row 1
# ASSUME: Bad dates is written only when both dates are real Excel dates and Due Date is earlier than Start Date, whatever the Status
# ASSUME: No due date is written only when the Due Date cell is blank and Status is not Closed (ignoring case and extra spaces); a blank Status counts as not Closed
# ASSUME: a Due Date or Start Date that is text and not a real date gets no flag
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Job ID is not a job: its Flag is left as it is
# ASSUME: the number of flagged jobs is returned and shown in a message
GOAL     Flag jobs in the Job Tracker whose Due Date is before the Start Date or that are not Closed and have no Due Date, clear every other Flag and count the flagged jobs.
PROC     FlagJobDates
KIND     Function
MODULE   modJobTracker
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cStart As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long
VAR      mark As String
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Job ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Start Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Due Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(cJob, COL($ws, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cStart, COL($ws, "Start Date"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($ws, "Due Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LET(cFlag, COL($ws, "Flag"))
OP       IF cFlag = 0
OP         LET(cFlag, LASTCOL($ws, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, 1, cFlag), "Flag")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cJob))
OP         LET(mark, "")
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cDue))
OP           IF NOT SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Closed") THEN LET(mark, "No due date")
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDue))
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cStart))
OP               IF CELL($ws, r, cDue) < CELL($ws, r, cStart) THEN LET(mark, "Bad dates")
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cFlag), mark)
OP         IF mark <> "" THEN LET(n, n + 1)
OP       MSG("Jobs flagged: " & n)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers in row 1 include "Part No", "Unit" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: the rows run down to the last Part No; a row with no Part No is not a BOM line, so it is skipped and its Remark is left as it is
# ASSUME: a Unit is good when it is NOS, KG, MTR or SET, ignoring case and spaces at the ends; anything else, an error value included, gets Unit?
# ASSUME: the number of rows that need a unit fixed is the macro's return value
GOAL     Write Unit? in the Remark of every BOM row whose Unit is blank or not NOS, KG, MTR or SET, clear the Remark of the other rows and return how many rows need a unit fixed.
PROC     FlagBadUnits
KIND     Function
MODULE   modBom
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cUnit As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Part No") > 0; COL($ws, "Unit") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cPart, COL($ws, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cUnit, COL($ws, "Unit"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cPart))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cUnit), "NOS") OR SAME(CELL($ws, r, cUnit), "KG") OR SAME(CELL($ws, r, cUnit), "MTR") OR SAME(CELL($ws, r, cUnit), "SET")
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Unit?")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the log's headers in row 1 include "Job ID" and "Qty Issued"; the real sheets are "Consumable Issue" and "Job Issue Summary", and the TESTs use IssueLog and Summary
# ASSUME: the Job Issue Summary sheet already exists and holds nothing else: it is cleared and rebuilt on every run with the headings Job ID, Issues, Total Qty Issued
# ASSUME: Job IDs are matched ignoring case and spaces at the ends, and shown as first typed
# ASSUME: a row with a Job ID whose Qty Issued is blank or not a number still counts as one issue and adds nothing to the total
# ASSUME: jobs with the same total may come in either order; the Function returns the number of jobs listed
GOAL     Rebuild the Job Issue Summary sheet from the Consumable Issue log with one row per Job ID showing its number of issues and total Qty Issued, the biggest total first.
PROC     BuildJobIssueSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modConsumables
ARGS     log As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      job As String
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      issues As Long
VAR      total As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Job ID") > 0; COL($log, "Qty Issued") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cJob, COL($log, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($log, "Qty Issued"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Job ID", "Issues", "Total Qty Issued")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cJob))
OP         LET(job, TRIM(CELL($log, r, cJob)))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, job, 1, mode=sum)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($log, r, cQty)) THEN DICT_ADD(totals, job, CELL($log, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=issues)
OP         LET(total, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(totals, k) THEN DICT_GET(totals, k, into=total)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, issues, total)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=3, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(counts))
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: PQR List headers in row 1 include "Process" and "Result"; the PQR Summary sheet exists and holds nothing else
# ASSUME: every row with a Process counts as one PQR, even when its PQR No is blank or repeated
# ASSUME: processes are grouped ignoring case and spaces at the ends, and shown as first typed
# ASSUME: "Fail" is matched ignoring case and extra spaces; any other Result, a blank one too, is not a fail
GOAL     Rebuild the PQR Summary sheet with one row per welding process, its number of PQRs and how many of them failed, sorted A to Z, and a Total row at the end.
PROC     WritePqrSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modPqr
ARGS     src As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      fails As Dictionary
VAR      isFail As Long
VAR      total As Long
VAR      totalFail As Long
VAR      got As Long
VAR      gotFail As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($src, "Process") > 0; COL($src, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cProc, COL($src, "Process"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($src, "Result"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($src, cProc) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($src, r, cProc))
OP         LET(isFail, IIF(SAME(CELL($src, r, cResult), "Fail"), 1, 0))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, TRIM(CELL($src, r, cProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(fails, TRIM(CELL($src, r, cProc)), isFail, mode=sum)
OP         LET(total, total + 1)
OP         LET(totalFail, totalFail + isFail)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "PQRs", "Failed")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         DICT_GET(fails, k, into=gotFail)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got, gotFail)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, "Total", total, totalFail)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(counts))
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers in row 1 include "Part No", "Required Qty" and "Unit"
# ASSUME: the Unit Totals sheet exists; it is cleared and rebuilt on every run with the headers Unit and Total Required Qty
# ASSUME: the rows run down to the last Part No; each of them is either totalled or counted as left out, a wholly blank row too

# ASSUME: a Required Qty typed as text that is a plain number ("25") counts as a number
# ASSUME: the number of rows left out is the macro's return value
GOAL     Rebuild the Unit Totals sheet with the total Required Qty of each Unit in the BOM, units A to Z, and return how many rows were left out for a blank unit or a quantity that is not a number.
PROC     BuildUnitTotals
KIND     Function
MODULE   modBom
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cUnit As Long
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      got As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      leftOut As Long
PRE      COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Unit") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(cUnit, COL($bom, "Unit"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cUnit))
OP           LET(leftOut, leftOut + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, r, cQty))
OP             DICT_ADD(totals, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cUnit))), CELL($bom, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP           ELSE
OP             LET(leftOut, leftOut + 1)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Unit", "Total Required Qty")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(totals)
OP         DICT_GET(totals, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(leftOut)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6

# ASSUME: customer names are matched ignoring case and spaces at the ends, and shown as first typed; a row with a blank Customer is left out
# ASSUME: customers with the same number of open jobs come in no particular order
GOAL     Rebuild the Customer Load sheet with each customer's number of open jobs and how many of those are past their Due Date, most open jobs first.
PROC     BuildCustomerLoad
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCustomerLoad
ARGS     jobs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cCust As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      k As String
VAR      openJobs As Dictionary
VAR      lateJobs As Dictionary
VAR      nOpen As Long
VAR      nLate As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($jobs, "Customer") > 0; COL($jobs, "Due Date") > 0; COL($jobs, "Status") > 0; COL($out, "Job ID") = 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cCust, COL($jobs, "Customer"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($jobs, "Due Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($jobs, "Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Customer", "Open Jobs", "Past Due")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($jobs, cCust) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($jobs, r, cCust))
OP         SKIP_IF SAME(CELL($jobs, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP         LET(k, TRIM(CELL($jobs, r, cCust)))
OP         DICT_ADD(openJobs, k, 1, mode=sum)

TASK
# ASSUME: WPS Register headers in row 1 include "WPS No" and "Filler Class"; Consumable Stock headers include "Filler Class" and "Qty On Hand"
# ASSUME: filler classes match after trimming the spaces at both ends, ignoring case; spaces inside a class are kept
# ASSUME: a batch counts as stock only when its Qty On Hand is a number above zero; a blank or text quantity is no stock
# ASSUME: a stock row with a blank Filler Class is ignored, so a WPS with a blank Filler Class gets "No stock"
# ASSUME: a row with a blank WPS No is not a WPS: it is not counted and its Stock Remark is left as it is

GOAL     Write No stock in the Stock Remark column of every WPS whose filler class has no stock batch with a quantity above zero, clear it on the others and return how many have no stock.
PROC     FlagWpsWithoutStock
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWps
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, stock As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cWps As Long
VAR      cFiller As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      sFiller As Long
VAR      sQty As Long
VAR      inStock As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0
MODIFIES $wps
OP       LET(cWps, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cFiller, COL($wps, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(sFiller, COL($stock, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(sQty, COL($stock, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Stock Remark"))
OP       IF cRemark = 0
OP         LET(cRemark, LASTCOL($wps, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, 1, cRemark), "Stock Remark")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, sFiller) var=s
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($stock, s, sFiller))
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($stock, s, sQty))
OP           IF CELL($stock, s, sQty) > 0
OP             DICT_ADD(inStock, TRIM(CELL($stock, s, sFiller)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cWps) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cWps))
OP         IF EXISTS(inStock, TRIM(CELL($wps, r, cFiller)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), "")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), "No stock")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers in row 1 include "Part No" and "Heat No"; Material Certs headers include "Heat No" and "MTC No"
# ASSUME: when the BOM has no "MTC No" heading it is added in the first free column of row 1

# ASSUME: heats are matched ignoring case and spaces at the ends; the certificate number is copied as it is typed
# ASSUME: a certificate row with no MTC No is not a certificate, so its heat is Missing; when a heat has several certificates the first one is used
# ASSUME: the number of Missing lines is the macro's return value
GOAL     Fill the MTC No column of the BOM with the certificate number of each line's heat from the Material Certs sheet, write Missing where the heat has no certificate and return how many are Missing.
PROC     FillMtcNumbers
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      kHeat As Long
VAR      kMtc As Long
VAR      byHeat As Dictionary
VAR      mtc As Variant
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0
MODIFIES $bom
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($bom, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($bom, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(kHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(kMtc, COL($certs, "MTC No"))
OP       IF cMtc = 0
OP         LET(cMtc, LASTCOL($bom, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, 1, cMtc), "MTC No")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, kHeat) var=i
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, i, kMtc))
OP         DICT_ADD(byHeat, TRIM(CELL($certs, i, kHeat)), CELL($certs, i, kMtc), mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cHeat))
OP           CLEAR(CELL($bom, r, cMtc), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF EXISTS(byHeat, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cHeat)))
OP             DICT_GET(byHeat, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cHeat)), into=mtc)
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cMtc), mtc)
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cMtc), "Missing")
OP             LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the real sheet is "Calibration Tracker"; its row-1 headers include "Status"
# ASSUME: a status is matched ignoring case, spaces at the ends and extra spaces between its words
# ASSUME: only a whole-cell match is rewritten; "in calibration" or "not ok" is another status and stays
# ASSUME: a cell that already reads exactly Calibrated or Out of Service is not rewritten and not counted
# ASSUME: the number of cells changed is the macro's return value
GOAL     Rewrite every Status that means calibrated as exactly Calibrated and every one that means out of service as exactly Out of Service, and count the cells changed.
PROC     StandardiseCalibrationStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      typed As String
VAR      want As String
VAR      changed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Status"]
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cStatus) var=r
OP         LET(typed, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($ws, r, cStatus)))
OP         LET(want, "")
OP         IF SAME(typed, "ok") OR SAME(typed, "in cal") OR SAME(typed, "calibrated") THEN LET(want, "Calibrated")
OP         IF SAME(typed, "oos") OR SAME(typed, "out of service") THEN LET(want, "Out of Service")
OP         SKIP_IF want = ""
OP         IF CELL($ws, r, cStatus) <> want
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), want)
OP           LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       RETURN(changed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Consumable Stock headers in row 1 include "Batch No", "Cert File" and "Cert Status"
# ASSUME: every row has a Batch No; rows are checked from row 2 down to the last Batch No
# ASSUME: Cert File holds the file's name with its extension, not a path; it matches ignoring case and spaces at the ends
# ASSUME: only files directly in the Batch Certs folder count; a file in a folder below it, or a hidden file, is Missing
# ASSUME: a Cert File that holds only spaces counts as no file name; Cert Status is rewritten on every row on every run
# ASSUME: the macro only lists the folder's file names: no file is opened, changed, copied or deleted
GOAL     Mark each Consumable Stock row Found or Missing by whether its Cert File is in the Batch Certs folder, or No file name when it has none, and return how many are Missing.
PROC     CheckBatchCertFiles
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     ws As Worksheet, certs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cFile As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      files As Collection
VAR      status As String
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Batch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Cert File") > 0; COL($ws, "Cert Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($certs)
MODIFIES $ws["Cert Status"]
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($ws, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cFile, COL($ws, "Cert File"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Cert Status"))
OP       LIST_FILES($certs, "*", into=files)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cBatch) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cFile))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "No file name")
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(status, "Missing")
OP           FOR_EACH var=f in=ITEMS(files)
OP             IF SAME(f, CELL($ws, r, cFile)) THEN LET(status, "Found")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), status)
OP           IF status = "Missing" THEN LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

OP       ELSE
OP         MSG("Expired batches: " & n)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the three steps of the consumables stock review on the sheets it is given and return how many batches are expired.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     stock As Worksheet, reorder As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      expired As Long
PRE      COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($stock, "Reorder Level") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($stock, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $stock["Remark"]
MODIFIES $reorder
MODIFIES $summary
OP       CALL(modSteps.MarkStockRemarks, $stock, into=expired)
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListReorderBatches, $stock, $reorder)
OP       CALL(modSteps.SummariseFillerClasses, $stock, $summary)
OP       RETURN(expired)
ERR      standard
