VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Expired in Remark for each batch past its Expiry Date, otherwise Reorder when Qty On Hand is at or below Reorder Level, clear the other remarks and return the number expired.
PROC     MarkStockRemarks
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     stock As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cLevel As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      remark As String
VAR      expired As Long
PRE      COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($stock, "Reorder Level") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($stock, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $stock["Remark"]
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($stock, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($stock, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cLevel, COL($stock, "Reorder Level"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($stock, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($stock, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, cBatch) var=r
OP         LET(remark, "")
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($stock, r, cQty))
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($stock, r, cLevel))
OP             IF CELL($stock, r, cQty) <= CELL($stock, r, cLevel) THEN LET(remark, "Reorder")
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($stock, r, cExpiry))
OP           IF CELL($stock, r, cExpiry) < TODAY
OP             LET(remark, "Expired")
OP             LET(expired, expired + 1)
OP         IF remark = ""
OP           CLEAR(CELL($stock, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($stock, r, cRemark), remark)
OP       RETURN(expired)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Reorder List sheet with every batch whose Remark is Reorder, under the stock sheet's six headings, the lowest Qty On Hand first.
PROC     ListReorderBatches
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     stock As Worksheet, reorder As Worksheet
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cClass As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cLevel As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($stock, "Reorder Level") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($stock, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $reorder
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($stock, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cClass, COL($stock, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($stock, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cLevel, COL($stock, "Reorder Level"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($stock, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($stock, "Remark"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($reorder), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($reorder, 1, "Batch No", "Filler Class", "Qty On Hand", "Reorder Level", "Expiry Date", "Remark")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, cBatch) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($stock, r, cRemark), "Reorder")
OP           WRITE_ROW($reorder, outRow, CELL($stock, r, cBatch), CELL($stock, r, cClass), CELL($stock, r, cQty), CELL($stock, r, cLevel), CELL($stock, r, cExpiry), CELL($stock, r, cRemark))
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($reorder), key=3, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Class Summary sheet with one row per Filler Class, A to Z, showing its total Qty On Hand without expired batches and its number of expired batches.
PROC     SummariseFillerClasses
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     stock As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cClass As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cls As String
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      expiredCounts As Dictionary
VAR      total As Double
VAR      nExpired As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($stock, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $summary
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($stock, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cClass, COL($stock, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($stock, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($stock, "Remark"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($summary), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, 1, "Filler Class", "Total Qty On Hand", "Expired Batches")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, cBatch) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($stock, r, cClass))
OP         LET(cls, TRIM(CELL($stock, r, cClass)))
OP         DICT_ADD(totals, cls, 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($stock, r, cRemark), "Expired")
OP           DICT_ADD(expiredCounts, cls, 1, mode=sum)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($stock, r, cQty)) THEN DICT_ADD(totals, cls, CELL($stock, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(totals)
OP         DICT_GET(totals, k, into=total)
OP         LET(nExpired, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(expiredCounts, k) THEN DICT_GET(expiredCounts, k, into=nExpired)
OP         WRITE_ROW($summary, outRow, k, total, nExpired)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($summary), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
BUILD
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "Calibration Tracker", "Due List" and "Location Summary", and all three exist; the TESTs use Tracker, DueList and Summary
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers (row 1) include "Instrument ID", "Type", "Location" and "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: overdue means a due date before today; due soon means from today to 30 days ahead, both ends included
# ASSUME: a due date that is blank or typed as text is not a date: that instrument is not coloured, not listed and counts as neither
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Instrument ID is not an instrument; rows are read down to the last Instrument ID
# ASSUME: old highlights are cleared from row 2 down, from column A to the last heading; the header row keeps its fill
# ASSUME: Due List and Location Summary are cleared and rebuilt on every run; nothing else may be kept on them
# ASSUME: Location Summary lists every location that has an instrument, also with 0 and 0; an instrument with no location counts under "(no location)"
# ASSUME: locations are matched ignoring case and spaces at the ends; the first spelling found is written
GOAL     Highlight overdue and due-soon instruments in the calibration tracker, rebuild a due list and a summary by location, and report how many are overdue.
NAME     CalibrationFollowUp
TARGET   xlsm
ENTRY    modMain.Run
MODULE   modMain
MODULE   modSteps
SIG      modMain.Run()
SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(tracker As Worksheet, dueList As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.HighlightDueRows(tracker As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.WriteDueList(tracker As Worksheet, out As Worksheet)
SIG      modSteps.WriteLocationSummary(tracker As Worksheet, out As Worksheet)
FLOW     modMain.Run -> modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.HighlightDueRows
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.WriteDueList
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.WriteLocationSummary
FIXTURE  cal_followup_01.xlsx sheet=Tracker cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Type,C:Location,D:Next Calibration Due,E:Notes rows=12 stale=3 data=A:seq(3001,1)+boundary(3001,3002,3003,3004,3005,"",3007,3008,3009,3010,3011,3012);B:values("Gauge"x6,"Caliper"x5,"Torque wrench"x1)+boundary("Gauge","Gauge","Gauge","Gauge","Gauge","Gauge","Caliper","Caliper","Torque wrench");C:values("Bay 1"x3,"Bay 2"x2,"Stores"x3,"bay 1 "x1,""x1,"Annex"x1," BAY 2"x1)+boundary("Bay 1","Bay 2","Bay 1","Stores","bay 1 ","Bay 2","","Annex","Stores"," BAY 2","Stores","Bay 1");D:reldates(-60,90)+boundary(-1,0,30,31,"",-5,-10,90,-40,12,-20,5);E:values("seen"x11,""x1)+boundary("")
FIXTURE  cal_followup_01.xlsx sheet=DueList cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Type,C:Location,D:Next Calibration Due rows=0 stale=10
FIXTURE  cal_followup_01.xlsx sheet=Summary cols=A:Location,B:Overdue,C:Due Soon rows=0 stale=7
FIXTURE  cal_followup_02.xlsx sheet=Tracker cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Type,C:Location,D:Next Calibration Due rows=5 stale=2 data=A:seq(4001,1);B:values("Gauge"x5);C:values("Bay 1"x3,"Stores"x2);D:reldates(40,200)+boundary(31,"")
FIXTURE  cal_followup_02.xlsx sheet=DueList cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Type,C:Location,D:Next Calibration Due rows=0 stale=2
FIXTURE  cal_followup_02.xlsx sheet=Summary cols=A:Location,B:Overdue,C:Due Soon rows=0 stale=4
TEST     fixture=cal_followup_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Tracker, DueList, Summary) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 4 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID], #FF0000) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID], #FFFF00) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Next Calibration Due], #FF0000) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Next Calibration Due], #FFFF00) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID]2, #FF0000) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Notes]2, #FF0000) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Notes], #FF0000) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Notes], #FFFF00) = 4 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID]3, #FFFF00) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID]4, #FFFF00) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID]13, #FFFF00) = 1 AND ROWS_USED(DueList) = 9 AND COUNTIF(DueList![Instrument ID], "stale") = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(DueList![Instrument ID], #FF0000) = 0 AND ROWS_USED(Summary) = 6 AND COUNTIF(Summary![Location], "stale") = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(Summary![Location], #FF0000) = 0
TEST     fixture=cal_followup_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Tracker, DueList, Summary) assert=RESULT = 4 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID]) AND COUNTA(Tracker![Next Calibration Due]) = PRE_COUNTA(Tracker![Next Calibration Due]) AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]2) = 3009 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]3) = 3011 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]4) = 3007 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]5) = 3001 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]6) = 3002 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]7) = 3012 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]8) = 3010 AND VALUE(DueList![Instrument ID]9) = 3003 AND VALUE(DueList![Type]2) = "Torque wrench" AND COUNTIF(DueList![Type], "Torque wrench") = 1 AND VALUE(DueList![Location]2) = "Stores" AND VALUE(DueList![Location]5) = "Bay 1" AND VALUE(DueList![Location]6) = "Bay 2" AND VALUE(DueList![Next Calibration Due]2) <= VALUE(DueList![Next Calibration Due]3) AND VALUE(DueList![Next Calibration Due]1) = "Next Calibration Due"
TEST     fixture=cal_followup_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Tracker, DueList, Summary) assert=ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTA(Tracker![Location]) = PRE_COUNTA(Tracker![Location]) AND VALUE(Summary![Location]2) = "(no location)" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]2) = 1 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]2) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]3) = "Annex" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]3) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]3) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]4) = "Bay 1" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]4) = 1 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]4) = 2 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]5) = "Bay 2" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]5) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]5) = 2 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]6) = "Stores" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]6) = 2 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]6) = 0
TEST     fixture=cal_followup_02.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Tracker, DueList, Summary) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 0 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND ROWS_USED(DueList) = 1 AND VALUE(DueList![Next Calibration Due]1) = "Next Calibration Due" AND ROWS_USED(Summary) = 3 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]2) = "Bay 1" AND VALUE(Summary![Overdue]2) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Due Soon]2) = 0 AND VALUE(Summary![Location]3) = "Stores" AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID], #FF0000) = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(Tracker![Instrument ID], #FFFF00) = 0 AND COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID])
TEST     fixture=cal_followup_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Summary, DueList, Tracker) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the calibration follow-up on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many instruments are overdue.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Calibration Tracker"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Due List"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Location Summary"), into=n)
OP       IF n < 0
OP         MSG("The calibration follow-up did not run: check the headings of the Calibration Tracker.")
OP       ELSE
OP         MSG("Instruments overdue for calibration: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the three steps of the calibration follow-up on the sheets it is given and return how many instruments are overdue.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, dueList As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      overdue As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Type") > 0; COL($tracker, "Location") > 0; COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $tracker fills
MODIFIES $dueList
MODIFIES $summary
OP       CALL(modSteps.HighlightDueRows, $tracker, into=overdue)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteDueList, $tracker, $dueList)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteLocationSummary, $tracker, $summary)
OP       RETURN(overdue)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Clear old row highlights in the tracker, colour overdue instrument rows red and rows due within 30 days yellow, and return how many are overdue.
PROC     HighlightDueRows
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      lastHead As Long
VAR      overdue As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $tracker fills
OP       LET(cId, COL($tracker, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LET(lastHead, LASTCOL($tracker, 1))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cId) var=r
OP         FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($tracker, r, 1, lastHead), fill=none)
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cId))
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP             FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($tracker, r, 1, lastHead), fill=red)
OP             LET(overdue, overdue + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 30 THEN FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($tracker, r, 1, lastHead), fill=yellow)
OP       RETURN(overdue)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the due list with every instrument that is overdue or due within 30 days, sorted with the earliest due date first.
PROC     WriteDueList
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cType As Long
VAR      cLoc As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Type") > 0; COL($tracker, "Location") > 0; COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($tracker, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cType, COL($tracker, "Type"))
OP       LET(cLoc, COL($tracker, "Location"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Instrument ID", "Type", "Location", "Next Calibration Due")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cId))
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 30
OP             WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($tracker, r, cId), CELL($tracker, r, cType), CELL($tracker, r, cLoc), CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=4, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the location summary with one row for each location and how many of its instruments are overdue and due soon, sorted A to Z.
PROC     WriteLocationSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cLoc As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      place As String
VAR      isOver As Long
VAR      isSoon As Long
VAR      overByPlace As Dictionary
VAR      soonByPlace As Dictionary
VAR      nOver As Long
VAR      nSoon As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Location") > 0; COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($tracker, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cLoc, COL($tracker, "Location"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($tracker, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Location", "Overdue", "Due Soon")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cId))
OP         LET(place, TRIM(CELL($tracker, r, cLoc)))
OP         IF place = "" THEN LET(place, "(no location)")
OP         LET(isOver, 0)
OP         LET(isSoon, 0)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($tracker, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP             LET(isOver, 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             IF CELL($tracker, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 30 THEN LET(isSoon, 1)
OP         DICT_ADD(overByPlace, place, isOver, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(soonByPlace, place, isSoon, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(overByPlace)
OP         DICT_GET(overByPlace, k, into=nOver)
OP         DICT_GET(soonByPlace, k, into=nSoon)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nOver, nSoon)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the material certificate tool on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many rows are marked Check.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Material Certs"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Grade Summary"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Chase List"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Rows marked Check: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run the four steps of the material certificate tool on the three sheets it is given and return how many rows are marked Check.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet, chase As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0; COL($certs, "Supplier") > 0; COL($certs, "Grade") > 0; COL($certs, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $certs["Heat No", "Remark"]
MODIFIES $summary
MODIFIES $chase
OP       CALL(modSteps.CleanHeatNumbers, $certs)
OP       CALL(modSteps.FlagIncompleteCerts, $certs, into=flagged)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteGradeSummary, $certs, $summary)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteChaseList, $certs, $chase)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rewrite every Heat No of the certificate sheet trimmed and in upper case.
PROC     CleanHeatNumbers
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     certs As Worksheet
VAR      cHeat As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0
MODIFIES $certs["Heat No"]
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cHeat) var=r
OP         IF CELL($certs, r, cHeat) <> UPPER(TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cHeat))) THEN SET_VALUE(CELL($certs, r, cHeat), UPPER(TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cHeat))))
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Check in the Remark of every certificate row with no MTC No or no Grade, clear the Remark of the other rows and return how many rows are Check.
PROC     FlagIncompleteCerts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     certs As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      cGrade As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0; COL($certs, "Grade") > 0; COL($certs, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $certs["Remark"]
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($certs, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(cGrade, COL($certs, "Grade"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($certs, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cHeat) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cMtc)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cGrade))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($certs, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($certs, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the grade summary sheet with one row for each Grade and its number of certificates, grades A to Z, then a No grade row.
PROC     WriteGradeSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, summary As Worksheet
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cGrade As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      noGrade As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "Grade") > 0
MODIFIES $summary
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cGrade, COL($certs, "Grade"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cHeat) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cGrade))
OP           LET(noGrade, noGrade + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           DICT_ADD(counts, TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cGrade)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($summary), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, 1, "Grade", "Certificates")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($summary, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($summary), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       WRITE_ROW($summary, outRow, "No grade", noGrade)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the chase list sheet with each Supplier that has a certificate row with no MTC No or no Grade, written once, A to Z.
PROC     WriteChaseList
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, chase As Worksheet
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      cSupplier As Long
VAR      cGrade As Long
VAR      seen As Dictionary
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0; COL($certs, "Supplier") > 0; COL($certs, "Grade") > 0
MODIFIES $chase
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($certs, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(cSupplier, COL($certs, "Supplier"))
OP       LET(cGrade, COL($certs, "Grade"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cHeat) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cMtc)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cGrade)) THEN DICT_ADD(seen, TRIM(CELL($certs, r, cSupplier)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($chase), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($chase, 1, "Supplier")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(seen)
OP         WRITE_ROW($chase, outRow, k)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($chase), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

MODULE   modMain

PRE      COL($reg, "WPS No") > 0; COL($reg, "Process") > 0; COL($reg, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($reg, "Remark") > 0; COL($pqr, "PQR No") > 0; COL($pqr, "Result") > 0

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write PQR failed or PQR missing in the Remark of each WPS whose PQR failed or is not in the PQR list, clear the other Remarks and return how many WPS got a remark.
PROC     MarkPqrRemarks
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     reg As Worksheet, pqr As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cWps As Long
VAR      cRef As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      pqrs As Dictionary
VAR      ref As String
VAR      verdict As String
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($reg, "WPS No") > 0; COL($reg, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($reg, "Remark") > 0; COL($pqr, "PQR No") > 0; COL($pqr, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $reg["Remark"]
OP       LET(cWps, COL($reg, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cRef, COL($reg, "PQR Ref"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($reg, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cNo, COL($pqr, "PQR No"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($pqr, "Result"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($pqr, cNo) var=p
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($pqr, p, cNo))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($pqr, p, cResult), "Fail")
OP           DICT_ADD(pqrs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($pqr, p, cNo)), "Fail", mode=overwrite)
OP         ELSE
OP           DICT_ADD(pqrs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($pqr, p, cNo)), "OK", mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($reg, cWps) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cWps))
OP         LET(ref, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($reg, r, cRef)))
OP         IF EXISTS(pqrs, ref)
OP           DICT_GET(pqrs, ref, into=verdict)
OP           IF verdict = "Fail"
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, r, cRemark), "PQR failed")
OP             LET(n, n + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             CLEAR(CELL($reg, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, r, cRemark), "PQR missing")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard

TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the problem sheet with every WPS that has a remark, under the register's four headings, sorted by WPS No from A to Z.
PROC     ListProblemWps
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     reg As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cWps As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRef As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($reg, "WPS No") > 0; COL($reg, "Process") > 0; COL($reg, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($reg, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cWps, COL($reg, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($reg, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRef, COL($reg, "PQR Ref"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($reg, "Remark"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "WPS No", "Process", "PQR Ref", "Remark")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($reg, cWps) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cWps))
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cRemark))
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($reg, r, cWps), CELL($reg, r, cProc), CELL($reg, r, cRef), CELL($reg, r, cRemark))
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the summary sheet with one row per process in the register, its number of WPS and how many of them have a remark, sorted A to Z.
PROC     WriteProcessSummary
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     reg As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cWps As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      remarks As Dictionary
VAR      procName As String
VAR      hasRemark As Long
VAR      got As Long
VAR      gotRemark As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($reg, "WPS No") > 0; COL($reg, "Process") > 0; COL($reg, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cWps, COL($reg, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($reg, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($reg, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($reg, cWps) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cWps))
OP         LET(procName, IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cProc)), "(blank)", TRIM(CELL($reg, r, cProc))))
OP         LET(hasRemark, IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cRemark)), 0, 1))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, procName, 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(remarks, procName, hasRemark, mode=sum)
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "WPS", "With Remark")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         DICT_GET(remarks, k, into=gotRemark)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got, gotRemark)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

GOAL     Write a formula in Days Open for every NCR row: close date minus issue date when closed, otherwise today minus issue date.
PROC     SetDaysOpenFormulas
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcr
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long

VCL 0.6
TASK

GOAL     Write Inspection pending in Remark for each GRN line received over 7 days ago with no Inspection, clear the Remark on the others and return how many are pending.
PROC     MarkPendingInspections
KIND     Function
MODULE   modGrn
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cGrn As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cInsp As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      pend As Long
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "GRN No") > 0; COL($ws, "Received Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Inspection") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cGrn, COL($ws, "GRN No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Received Date"))
OP       LET(cInsp, COL($ws, "Inspection"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cGrn) var=r
OP         LET(pend, 0)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDate))
OP           IF CELL($ws, r, cDate) < TODAY - 7
OP             IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cInsp)) THEN LET(pend, 1)
OP         IF pend = 1
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Inspection pending")
OP           LET(marked, marked + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(marked)
ERR      standard

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Dispatch headers in row 1 include "Dispatch No", "Planned Date", "Actual Date" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: Late means Actual Date is after Planned Date; Overdue means no Actual Date and Planned Date before today
# ASSUME: all other rows with a usable Planned Date get a cleared Remark; a row whose dates are not real dates keeps its Remark
GOAL     Mark each dispatch Late or Overdue in the Remark column, clear the Remark on the others and return how many are Late or Overdue together.
PROC     MarkLateDispatches
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      cAct As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($ws, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ws, "Dispatch No"))
OP       LET(cPlan, COL($ws, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cAct, COL($ws, "Actual Date"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNo) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cAct))
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cPlan))
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cAct) > CELL($ws, r, cPlan)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Late")
OP               LET(n, n + 1)
OP             ELSE
OP               CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cAct))
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cPlan))
OP               IF CELL($ws, r, cPlan) < TODAY
OP                 SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Overdue")
OP                 LET(n, n + 1)
OP               ELSE
OP                 CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Method" and "Result"
# ASSUME: each row with a method counts as one weld tested; RT and rt are one method, shown in capitals
# ASSUME: a Result of Reject is matched ignoring case and extra spaces; rows with a blank Method are ignored
# ASSUME: the Method Summary sheet exists, is passed in and is rebuilt on every run, methods sorted A to Z
GOAL     Rebuild the Method Summary sheet with each NDE method, how many welds were tested and how many were rejected, sorted A to Z.
PROC     SummariseNdeMethods
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cMethod As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      tested As Dictionary
VAR      rejected As Dictionary
VAR      nT As Long
VAR      nR As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Method") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cMethod, COL($nde, "Method"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Method", "Welds Tested", "Rejects")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cMethod) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))
OP         DICT_ADD(tested, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(rejected, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Reject")
OP           DICT_ADD(rejected, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cMethod))), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(tested)
OP         DICT_GET(tested, k, into=nT)
OP         DICT_GET(rejected, k, into=nR)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nT, nR)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(tested))
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=nde_01.xlsx call=SummariseNdeMethods(Summary, NdeReport) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

TASK
# ASSUME: GRN sheet headers in row 1 include "GRN No", "Supplier" and "Received Qty"

# ASSUME: the Supplier Receipts sheet exists, is passed in and is rebuilt on every run, biggest total first
GOAL     Rebuild the Supplier Receipts sheet with each supplier, its number of GRN lines and its total received quantity, biggest total first.
PROC     SummariseSupplierReceipts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modGrn
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSupplier As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      lines As Dictionary
VAR      totals As Dictionary
VAR      nLines As Long
VAR      total As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Supplier") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSupplier, COL($grn, "Supplier"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Supplier", "GRN Lines", "Total Received Qty")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cSupplier) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cSupplier))
OP         DICT_ADD(lines, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cSupplier)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(totals, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cSupplier)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, cQty))
OP           DICT_ADD(totals, TRIM(CELL($grn, r, cSupplier)), CELL($grn, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(lines)
OP         DICT_GET(lines, k, into=nLines)
OP         DICT_GET(totals, k, into=total)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nLines, total)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=3, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(COUNT(lines))
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: GRN headers in row 1 are GRN No, Part No, Received Qty; BOM headers are Part No, Required Qty, Received Total, Remark
# ASSUME: part numbers are matched trimmed and ignoring case; BOM rows with a blank Part No are left untouched
# ASSUME: a GRN Received Qty that is not a number (blank or text) adds nothing; GRN parts not in the BOM are ignored
# ASSUME: a part is Short only when its Required Qty is a number and the received total is less than it; any other part gets its Remark cleared
GOAL     Total the received quantity of each BOM part from the GRN sheet, mark the parts received short of the required quantity, and return how many are Short.
PROC     MarkShortParts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modReceiving
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, bom As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      gPart As Long
VAR      gQty As Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      cRec As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      rec As Dictionary
VAR      q As Double
VAR      got As Double
VAR      need As Double
VAR      shortN As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Received Total") > 0; COL($bom, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $bom["Received Total", "Remark"]
OP       LET(gPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(gQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(cRec, COL($bom, "Received Total"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($bom, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, gPart) var=g
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, g, gQty))
OP           LET(q, CELL($grn, g, gQty))
OP           DICT_ADD(rec, TRIM(CELL($grn, g, gPart)), q, mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=b
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, b, cPart))
OP         LET(got, 0)
OP         DICT_GET(rec, TRIM(CELL($bom, b, cPart)), into=got)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, b, cRec), got)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, b, cReq))
OP           LET(need, CELL($bom, b, cReq))
OP           IF got < need
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, b, cRemark), "Short")
OP             LET(shortN, shortN + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             CLEAR(CELL($bom, b, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($bom, b, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       MSG("Parts short: " & shortN)
OP       RETURN(shortN)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NCR Register headers in row 1 include NCR No, Department and Status
# ASSUME: a status counts as open when it is Open ignoring case and spaces, and as closed when it is Closed or Close ignoring case and spaces; nothing else is matched

GOAL     Rewrite every open-like status in the NCR Register as exactly Open and every closed-like status as exactly Closed, and return how many cells changed.
PROC     NormalizeNcrStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcr
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      changed As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ncr["Status"]
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cStatus) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           IF CELL($ncr, r, cStatus) <> "Open"
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP             LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Closed") OR SAME(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Close")
OP             IF CELL($ncr, r, cStatus) <> "Closed"
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ncr, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP               LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       MSG("Cells changed: " & changed)
OP       RETURN(changed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers in row 1 include "Instrument ID", "Range Max", "Reading Max" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: a value counts as a number when IS_NUMBER accepts it, so numbers typed as text are compared as numbers
# ASSUME: a reading equal to the range maximum is not over range
# ASSUME: every row up to the last Instrument ID is checked, and the Remark of a row that is neither is cleared
GOAL     Write Over range or Check in Remark for each instrument whose reading is above its range or cannot be compared, clear the other remarks and return the Over range count.
PROC     MarkOverRange
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cRange As Long
VAR      cReading As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      over As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Range Max") > 0; COL($ws, "Reading Max") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cId, COL($ws, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cRange, COL($ws, "Range Max"))
OP       LET(cReading, COL($ws, "Reading Max"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cId) var=r
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, r, cRange))
OP           IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, r, cReading))
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cReading) > CELL($ws, r, cRange)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Over range")
OP               LET(over, over + 1)
OP             ELSE
OP               CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Check")
OP       RETURN(over)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=cal_01.xlsx call=MarkOverRange(Cal) assert=COUNTA(Cal![Remark]) = 7 AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]2) = "Over range" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]3) = "" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]4) = "" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]5) = "Check" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]6) = "Check" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]7) = "Check" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]8) = "Check" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]9) = "Over range" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]10) = "" AND VALUE(Cal![Remark]11) = ""

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Certs headers in row 1 include "Heat No", "MTC No", "Grade" and "Received Date"

# ASSUME: all fills on the sheet are cleared first, since the highlight is the only fill the sheet should carry
GOAL     Clear old row highlights in Material Certs, then highlight yellow every row with no MTC No received more than 14 days ago, and return how many were highlighted.
PROC     HighlightMissingCerts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      marked As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Heat No") > 0; COL($ws, "MTC No") > 0; COL($ws, "Received Date") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($ws, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cMtc, COL($ws, "MTC No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Received Date"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       FORMAT(USED_RANGE($ws), fill=none)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cHeat) var=r
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cMtc))
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDate))
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cDate) < TODAY - 14
OP               FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=yellow)
OP               LET(marked, marked + 1)
OP       RETURN(marked)

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the sheets are "Calibration Tracker" and "Location Due"; Location Due exists and is rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: headers in row 1 of the tracker include "Instrument ID", "Location" and "Next Calibration Due"
# ASSUME: Locations are matched after trimming and ignoring case; the first spelling found is shown
# ASSUME: overdue means a real Next Calibration Due date before today; a blank or non-date due date is not overdue
# ASSUME: rows with a blank Location are ignored, and rows are counted by Instrument ID rows
GOAL     Rebuild the Location Due sheet with each location, how many instruments it has and how many are overdue for calibration, locations A to Z.
PROC     BuildLocationDue
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalibration
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cLoc As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      total As Dictionary
VAR      late As Dictionary
VAR      nInst As Long
VAR      nLate As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Location") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cLoc, COL($cal, "Location"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Location", "Instruments", "Overdue")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($cal, r, cLoc))
OP         DICT_ADD(total, TRIM(CELL($cal, r, cLoc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(late, TRIM(CELL($cal, r, cLoc)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP             DICT_ADD(late, TRIM(CELL($cal, r, cLoc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(total)
OP         DICT_GET(total, k, into=nInst)
OP         DICT_GET(late, k, into=nLate)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nInst, nLate)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 3
OP         SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  cal_01.xlsx sheet=Cal cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Location,C:Next Calibration Due rows=14 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("Lab"x3,"lab "x1,"Bay 2"x3,"Yard"x2,"Store"x2,""x2,"Aaa"x1)+boundary("Lab","Lab","lab ","Bay 2","Bay 2","Bay 2","Yard","Yard","Store","","Store","Aaa","","Lab");C:reldates(-60,60)+boundary(-1,0,5,-30,"",-1,1,10,-5,-9,"",3,"",2)

FIXTURE  cal_02.xlsx sheet=Cal cols=A:Instrument ID,B:Location,C:Next Calibration Due rows=4 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("Zed"x2,"Alpha"x1,""x1)+boundary("Zed","Alpha","Zed","");C:reldates(-5,5)+boundary(-1,3,2,-3)
FIXTURE  cal_02.xlsx sheet=Due cols=A:Location,B:Instruments,C:Overdue rows=0 stale=1

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the sheets are "Consumable Issue" and "Recent Usage"; Recent Usage exists and is rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: headers in row 1 of the log include "Issue No", "Issue Date", "Filler Class" and "Qty Issued"
# ASSUME: the last 30 days run from today minus 30 days up to and including today; later dates are left out
# ASSUME: filler classes are trimmed and shown in upper case, so "mig wire" and "MIG Wire" are one class
# ASSUME: rows with a blank class, a non-date Issue Date or a Qty Issued that is not a number are ignored; rows are counted by Issue No
GOAL     Rebuild the Recent Usage sheet with each filler class and its total quantity issued in the last 30 days, biggest total first.
PROC     BuildRecentUsage
KIND     Function
MODULE   modConsumables
ARGS     log As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cClass As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      sums As Dictionary
VAR      got As Double
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Issue No") > 0; COL($log, "Issue Date") > 0; COL($log, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($log, "Qty Issued") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($log, "Issue No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($log, "Issue Date"))
OP       LET(cClass, COL($log, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($log, "Qty Issued"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Filler Class", "Total Qty Issued")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cClass))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($log, r, cDate))
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_NUMBER(CELL($log, r, cQty))
OP         SKIP_IF CELL($log, r, cDate) < TODAY - 30 OR CELL($log, r, cDate) > TODAY
OP         DICT_ADD(sums, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($log, r, cClass))), CELL($log, r, cQty), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(sums)
OP         DICT_GET(sums, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 3
OP         SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

TASK

GOAL     Rebuild the Status Count sheet with each job status and its number of jobs, most first, then a Total row.
PROC     CountJobsByStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modJobs
ARGS     jobs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      total As Long
PRE      COL($jobs, "Job ID") > 0; COL($jobs, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cJob, COL($jobs, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($jobs, "Status"))
OP       LET(total, 0)

OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($jobs, r, cStatus))
OP           DICT_ADD(counts, "Blank", 1, mode=sum)

OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Certs headers in row 1 include "Heat No", "Supplier" and "Grade"
# ASSUME: Supplier Grades already exists with its headers (Supplier, Grade, Certificates) and is rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: supplier and grade are matched with spaces cleaned and case ignored; the first spelling found is shown
# ASSUME: rows with a blank supplier or a blank grade are ignored; the sheet is sorted by supplier A to Z
# ASSUME: every row with a supplier and a grade counts as one certificate; the macro returns the number of rows written
GOAL     Rebuild the Supplier Grades sheet with one row for each supplier and grade found together in Material Certs and the number of certificates, suppliers A to Z.
PROC     BuildSupplierGrades
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSup As Long
VAR      cGrade As Long
VAR      pairKey As String
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      sups As Dictionary
VAR      grades As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      s As String
VAR      g As String
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "Supplier") > 0; COL($certs, "Grade") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSup, COL($certs, "Supplier"))
OP       LET(cGrade, COL($certs, "Grade"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Supplier", "Grade", "Certificates")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cSup) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cSup)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cGrade))
OP         LET(s, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cSup)))
OP         LET(g, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cGrade)))
OP         LET(pairKey, s & "|" & g)
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, pairKey, 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(sups, pairKey, s, mode=keep)
OP         DICT_ADD(grades, pairKey, g, mode=keep)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         DICT_GET(sups, k, into=s)
OP         DICT_GET(grades, k, into=g)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, s, g, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Material Certs headers in row 1 include "Heat No" and "MTC No"; GRN headers include "GRN No" and "Heat No"; the real sheets are "Material Certs" and "GRN"
# ASSUME: Heat numbers are matched with CLEAN_TEXT, ignoring case; a cert row with no Heat No is left as it is
# ASSUME: each GRN line with a Heat No counts once; GRN lines with no Heat No are ignored
# ASSUME: the GRN Check heading is added after the last column of Material Certs when missing
GOAL     Write Not received or the number of GRN lines in GRN Check for each heat on Material Certs, and return how many heats were not received.
PROC     CheckHeatsAgainstGrn
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     certs As Worksheet, grn As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cCheck As Long
VAR      gHeat As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      lines As Long
VAR      missing As Long
PRE      COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($certs, "MTC No") > 0; COL($grn, "GRN No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0
MODIFIES $certs
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(gHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cCheck, COL($certs, "GRN Check"))
OP       IF cCheck = 0
OP         LET(cCheck, LASTCOL($certs, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($certs, 1, cCheck), "GRN Check")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, gHeat) var=g
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, g, gHeat))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($grn, g, gHeat)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cHeat) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cHeat))
OP         IF EXISTS(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cHeat)))
OP           DICT_GET(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cHeat)), into=lines)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($certs, r, cCheck), lines)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($certs, r, cCheck), "Not received")
OP           LET(missing, missing + 1)
OP       RETURN(missing)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Job Tracker headers in row 1 include "Job ID", "Customer" and "Status"
# ASSUME: spaces means spaces, tabs and line breaks; a Job ID that is already clean is left untouched and not counted
# ASSUME: blank Job ID cells, and cells holding only spaces, are skipped and left as they are
GOAL     Make every Job ID in the Job Tracker trimmed, upper case and with single spaces inside, and return how many cells were changed.
PROC     CleanJobIds
KIND     Function
MODULE   modJobs
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      clean As String
VAR      changed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Job ID") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Job ID"]
OP       LET(cJob, COL($ws, "Job ID"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cJob))
OP         LET(clean, UPPER(CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($ws, r, cJob))))
OP         IF CELL($ws, r, cJob) <> clean
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cJob), clean)
OP           LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       RETURN(changed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers in row 1 include "Instrument ID", "Next Calibration Due" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: a text due date is real only as day/month/year with slashes (15/03/2026 or 1/4/2026), and the day-first reading is the only one tried
# ASSUME: any other non-blank value that is not a real date, a number included, gets Bad date in Remark; a converted row keeps its Remark
# ASSUME: cells that are blank or hold only spaces are left alone
GOAL     Turn text due dates written day first into real dates in the Calibration Tracker, mark impossible ones Bad date in Remark, and return how many were converted.
PROC     ConvertDueDates
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCalDates
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      parsed As Variant
VAR      converted As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Next Calibration Due") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Next Calibration Due", "Remark"]
OP       LET(cDue, COL($ws, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cDue) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cDue))
OP         SKIP_IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDue))
OP         LET(parsed, PARSE_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDue), "dd/mm/yyyy"))
OP         IF IS_DATE(parsed)
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cDue), parsed)
OP           LET(converted, converted + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Bad date")
OP       RETURN(converted)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Calibration Tracker headers in row 1 include "Instrument ID" and "Cert Status"
# ASSUME: a certificate is a PDF directly in the Cal Certs folder named after the trimmed instrument ID, such as PG-104.pdf; case is ignored and subfolders are not searched
# ASSUME: a row with a blank Instrument ID is left as it is; an ID that cannot be a file name simply has no PDF, so it is Missing
# ASSUME: no file is created, changed or deleted; the macro only reads the folder's list of names
GOAL     Mark each Calibration Tracker row Found or Missing in Cert Status by whether its instrument has a PDF certificate in the Cal Certs folder, and return how many are Missing.
PROC     CheckCertFiles
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, certs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cInst As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      pdfs As Collection
VAR      have As Dictionary
VAR      missing As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Cert Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($certs)
MODIFIES $tracker["Cert Status"]
OP       LET(cInst, COL($tracker, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($tracker, "Cert Status"))
OP       LIST_FILES($certs, "*.pdf", into=pdfs)
OP       FOR_EACH var=f in=ITEMS(pdfs)
OP         DICT_ADD(have, f, 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cInst) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cInst))
OP         IF EXISTS(have, TRIM(CELL($tracker, r, cInst)) & ".pdf")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Found")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Missing")
OP           LET(missing, missing + 1)
OP       RETURN(missing)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=certs_01.xlsx call=CheckCertFiles(Tracker, Certs) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 2 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTIF(Tracker![Cert Status], "Found") = 4 AND COUNTIF(Tracker![Cert Status], "Missing") = 2 AND COUNTIF(Tracker![Cert Status], "old") = 1
TEST     fixture=certs_01.xlsx call=CheckCertFiles(Tracker, Certs) assert=VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]2) = "Found" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]3) = "Found" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]4) = "Missing" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]5) = "Missing" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]6) = "old" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]7) = "Found" AND VALUE(Tracker![Cert Status]8) = "Found" AND COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Tracker![Instrument ID]) AND FILE_COUNT("Certs") = PRE_FILE_COUNT("Certs") AND FILE_EXISTS("Certs\PG-104.pdf")

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Job Tracker headers in row 1 are Job ID, Status and Folder (the TEST sheet is called Tracker)
# ASSUME: the Jobs folder path is the String argument jobs and it already exists; nothing is deleted, moved or overwritten
# ASSUME: a job is Closed when its Status is Closed, ignoring case and extra spaces; its Folder cell is emptied
# ASSUME: Folder says Made when the job folder or its Drawings folder was created, Already there when both existed, Bad name when the Job ID is not a safe folder name
# ASSUME: any other outcome (for example a file with the job's name) is written as MAKE_FOLDER's own status text; a blank Job ID row is skipped and left as it is
GOAL     Make a folder named after each open job with a Drawings folder inside it, and write Made, Already there or Bad name in the Folder column.
PROC     MakeJobFolders
KIND     Function
MODULE   modJobFolders
ARGS     tracker As Worksheet, jobs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      cFolder As Long
VAR      st As String
VAR      st2 As String
VAR      made As Long
PRE      COL($tracker, "Job ID") > 0; COL($tracker, "Status") > 0; COL($tracker, "Folder") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($jobs)
MODIFIES $tracker["Folder"]
MODIFIES $jobs files
OP       LET(cJob, COL($tracker, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($tracker, "Status"))
OP       LET(cFolder, COL($tracker, "Folder"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($tracker, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($tracker, r, cJob))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($tracker, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP           CLEAR(CELL($tracker, r, cFolder), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           MAKE_FOLDER(PATH_JOIN($jobs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cJob))), into=st)
OP           IF st = "Created" OR st = "Exists"
OP             MAKE_FOLDER(PATH_JOIN($jobs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($tracker, r, cJob)), "Drawings"), into=st2)
OP             IF st2 = "Created" OR st2 = "Exists"
OP               IF st = "Created" OR st2 = "Created"
OP                 SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cFolder), "Made")
OP                 LET(made, made + 1)
OP               ELSE
OP                 SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cFolder), "Already there")
OP             ELSE
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cFolder), st2)
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($tracker, r, cFolder), st)
OP       RETURN(made)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

KIND     Function
MODULE   modStock
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long

GOAL     Find a heat number on the Material Certs sheet, write its MTC No in cell F1 or Not found, and return its row or 0.
PROC     FindHeatCert
KIND     Function
MODULE   modCerts
ARGS     ws As Worksheet, heat As String
RET      Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cMtc As Long
VAR      found As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Heat No") > 0; COL($ws, "MTC No") > 0

OP       LET(cMtc, COL($ws, "MTC No"))

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Method", "Result" and "Report Date"
# ASSUME: Result is matched ignoring case and extra spaces; Report Date holds real dates
# ASSUME: more than 3 days ago means the Report Date is before today minus 3 days
# ASSUME: a Reject row is red even if its date is old; a Pending row with no real date stays uncoloured
# ASSUME: all old fills on the sheet are cleared first, header row included, then the colours are applied across columns 1 to the last used column
# ASSUME: the macro returns the number of red rows
GOAL     Clear old row colours in the NDE Report, colour rejected rows red and pending rows older than 3 days yellow, and return the number of red rows.
PROC     ColourNdeRows
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      redRows As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ws, "Method") > 0; COL($ws, "Result") > 0; COL($ws, "Report Date") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cResult, COL($ws, "Result"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Report Date"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       FORMAT(USED_RANGE($ws), fill=none)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, COL($ws, "Weld Seam No")) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cResult), "Reject")
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=red)
OP           LET(redRows, redRows + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cResult), "Pending")
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDate))
OP               IF CELL($ws, r, cDate) < TODAY - 3
OP                 FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=yellow)
OP       RETURN(redRows)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=nde_01.xlsx call=ColourNdeRows(Nde) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 3 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(Nde![Weld Seam No], #FF0000) = 3 AND FILL_COUNT(Nde![Method], #FF0000) = 3
TEST     fixture=nde_01.xlsx call=ColourNdeRows(Nde) assert=FILL_COUNT(Nde![Weld Seam No], #FFFF00) = 3 AND FILL_COUNT(Nde![Report Date], #FFFF00) = 3 AND FILL_COUNT(Nde![Result], #FFFF00) = 3 AND COUNTA(Nde![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(Nde![Result]) AND COUNTA(Nde![Report Date]) = PRE_COUNTA(Nde![Report Date])

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Welder Quals headers in row 1 include "Welder ID", "Process", "Expiry Date" and "Status"
# ASSUME: Expiry Date holds real dates; an empty or non-date Expiry Date gives No date
# ASSUME: Expired means before today, Expires soon means today up to and including today plus 30 days, Valid is later than that
# ASSUME: Status is overwritten on every row that has a Welder ID, so a re-run gives the same result
# ASSUME: the macro returns the number of rows marked Expired or Expires soon
GOAL     Write Expired, Expires soon, Valid or No date in the Status of every welder qualification by its expiry date and return how many are Expired or Expires soon.
PROC     SetQualStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modQuals
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Process") > 0; COL($ws, "Expiry Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Status"]
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, COL($ws, "Welder ID")) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, COL($ws, "Welder ID")))
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDate))
OP           IF CELL($ws, r, cDate) < TODAY
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Expired")
OP             LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP           ELSE
OP             IF CELL($ws, r, cDate) <= TODAY + 30
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Expires soon")
OP               LET(flagged, flagged + 1)
OP             ELSE
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Valid")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "No date")
OP       RETURN(flagged)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TEST     fixture=quals_01.xlsx call=SetQualStatus(Quals) assert=RESULT = 7 AND COUNTA(Quals![Welder ID]) = PRE_COUNTA(Quals![Welder ID]) AND COUNTA(Quals![Expiry Date]) = PRE_COUNTA(Quals![Expiry Date]) AND COUNTA(Quals![Process]) = PRE_COUNTA(Quals![Process])
TEST     fixture=quals_01.xlsx call=SetQualStatus(Quals) assert=VALUE(Quals![Status]2) = "Expired" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]3) = "Expires soon" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]4) = "Expires soon" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]5) = "Expires soon" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]6) = "Expires soon" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]7) = "Valid" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]8) = "No date" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]10) = "old" AND VALUE(Quals![Status]11) = "Expired"
TEST     fixture=quals_01.xlsx call=SetQualStatus(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

TASK
# ASSUME: Weld Log headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Visual", "NDE Required", "NDE Result" and "Remark"

GOAL     Write NDE pending in Remark for every accepted weld that needs NDE and has no NDE result yet, clear Remark on the other welds and return how many are pending.
PROC     MarkNdePending
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldLog
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      cRes As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      pending As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ws, "Visual") > 0; COL($ws, "NDE Required") > 0; COL($ws, "NDE Result") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($ws, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($ws, "Visual"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($ws, "NDE Required"))
OP       LET(cRes, COL($ws, "NDE Result"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cSeam) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cVisual), "Accepted") AND SAME(CELL($ws, r, cReq), "Yes") AND IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cRes))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "NDE pending")

OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(pending)
PERF     screen_off

GOAL     Rebuild the Welder Visual sheet with each welder, how many welds they made and how many were not accepted, the welder with the most welds first.
PROC     BuildWelderVisual
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelderVisual
ARGS     weld As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cVisual As Long
VAR      total As Dictionary
VAR      bad As Dictionary
VAR      nWelds As Long
VAR      nBad As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($weld, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($weld, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($weld, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($weld, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($weld, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cVisual, COL($weld, "Visual"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Welds", "Not Accepted")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($weld, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($weld, r, cWelder))
OP         DICT_ADD(total, TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWelder)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(bad, TRIM(CELL($weld, r, cWelder)), IIF(SAME(CELL($weld, r, cVisual), "Accepted"), 0, 1), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(total)
OP         DICT_GET(total, k, into=nWelds)
OP         DICT_GET(bad, k, into=nBad)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nWelds, nBad)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)

ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: WPS Register headers in row 1 include "WPS No", "Process" and "PQR Ref"; the WPS by Process sheet exists and is passed in, and is rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: Processes are trimmed and matched ignoring case, and shown in capitals; rows with a blank Process are ignored

GOAL     Rebuild the WPS by Process sheet with each welding process, its number of WPS and how many have no PQR reference, A to Z, ending with a Total row.
PROC     BuildWpsByProcess
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWpsSummary
ARGS     reg As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cPqr As Long
VAR      total As Dictionary
VAR      missing As Dictionary
VAR      nWps As Long
VAR      nMissing As Long
VAR      sumWps As Long
VAR      sumMissing As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      nProc As Long
PRE      COL($reg, "WPS No") > 0; COL($reg, "Process") > 0; COL($reg, "PQR Ref") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($reg, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($reg, "Process"))
OP       LET(cPqr, COL($reg, "PQR Ref"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "WPS Count", "No PQR Ref")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($reg, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(total, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($reg, r, cProc))), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(missing, UPPER(TRIM(CELL($reg, r, cProc))), IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($reg, r, cPqr)), 1, 0), mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(total)
OP         DICT_GET(total, k, into=nWps)
OP         DICT_GET(missing, k, into=nMissing)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nWps, nMissing)
OP         LET(sumWps, sumWps + nWps)
OP         LET(sumMissing, sumMissing + nMissing)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       LET(nProc, outRow - 2)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, "Total", sumWps, sumMissing)
OP       RETURN(nProc)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: NDE Report headers in row 1 include "Inspector" and "Result"

# ASSUME: inspectors are matched ignoring case and stray spaces, and shown as first typed, trimmed
# ASSUME: a report counts as a Reject when Result is Reject, ignoring case and spaces
GOAL     Rebuild the Inspector Summary sheet with each inspector, how many NDE reports they signed and how many were Reject, A to Z.
PROC     BuildInspectorSummary
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNde
ARGS     nde As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cInsp As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      signed As Dictionary
VAR      rejects As Dictionary
VAR      nSigned As Long
VAR      nRej As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($nde, "Inspector") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cInsp, COL($nde, "Inspector"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Inspector", "Reports Signed", "Rejects")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, cInsp) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($nde, r, cInsp))
OP         DICT_ADD(signed, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cInsp)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, cResult), "Reject")
OP           DICT_ADD(rejects, TRIM(CELL($nde, r, cInsp)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(signed)
OP         DICT_GET(signed, k, into=nSigned)
OP         LET(nRej, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(rejects, k)
OP           DICT_GET(rejects, k, into=nRej)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, nSigned, nRej)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Weld Log headers in row 1 include "Weld Seam No", "Welder ID" and "Process"; Welder Quals has "Welder ID" and "Process"
# ASSUME: a welder is qualified when Welder Quals has a row with the same Welder ID and Process, ignoring case and stray spaces
# ASSUME: the Expiry Date is not checked, and a Welder Quals row with no Welder ID or no Process is ignored
# ASSUME: a weld with no Welder ID or no Process has no qual; a Weld Log row with no Weld Seam No is skipped and left as it is
# ASSUME: Qual Check is added at the end of row 1 when missing; a qualified weld gets an empty Qual Check
GOAL     Mark each weld in the Weld Log with No qual in Qual Check when its welder has no qualification for that process, clear the others, and return how many have none.
PROC     CheckWeldQuals
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldQuals
ARGS     log As Worksheet, quals As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cCheck As Long
VAR      qWelder As Long
VAR      qProc As Long
VAR      held As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($log, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0
MODIFIES $log
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($log, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($log, "Process"))
OP       LET(qWelder, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(qProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(cCheck, COL($log, "Qual Check"))
OP       IF cCheck = 0
OP         LET(cCheck, LASTCOL($log, 1) + 1)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($log, 1, cCheck), "Qual Check")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, qWelder) var=q
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, qWelder)) OR IS_EMPTY(CELL($quals, q, qProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(held, TRIM(CELL($quals, q, qWelder)) & "|" & TRIM(CELL($quals, q, qProc)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cSeam))
OP         IF EXISTS(held, TRIM(CELL($log, r, cWelder)) & "|" & TRIM(CELL($log, r, cProc)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($log, r, cCheck), "")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($log, r, cCheck), "No qual")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       MSG("Welds with no qual: " & n)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: ITP Tracker headers in row 1 include "ITP No" and "NCR Hold"; NCR Register headers include "ITP No" and "Status"
# ASSUME: a point is on hold when any NCR Register row with the same ITP No (ignoring case and stray spaces) has a Status that is not Closed
# ASSUME: Closed is matched ignoring case and spaces; an NCR with a blank Status counts as not Closed
# ASSUME: an NCR row with no ITP No is ignored; an ITP Tracker row with no ITP No is skipped and left as it is
GOAL     Write Hold in NCR Hold for every ITP Tracker point whose ITP No has an NCR that is not Closed, clear the others, and return how many points are on hold.
PROC     MarkNcrHolds
KIND     Function
MODULE   modItpHold
ARGS     itp As Worksheet, ncr As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cItp As Long
VAR      cHold As Long
VAR      nItp As Long
VAR      nStatus As Long
VAR      open As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($itp, "ITP No") > 0; COL($itp, "NCR Hold") > 0; COL($ncr, "ITP No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $itp["NCR Hold"]
OP       LET(cItp, COL($itp, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(cHold, COL($itp, "NCR Hold"))
OP       LET(nItp, COL($ncr, "ITP No"))
OP       LET(nStatus, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, nItp) var=q
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, q, nItp))
OP         IF NOT SAME(CELL($ncr, q, nStatus), "Closed")
OP           DICT_ADD(open, TRIM(CELL($ncr, q, nItp)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($itp, cItp) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($itp, r, cItp))
OP         IF EXISTS(open, TRIM(CELL($itp, r, cItp)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, r, cHold), "Hold")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($itp, r, cHold), "")
OP       MSG("Points on hold: " & n)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off calc_manual
ERR      standard

# ASSUME: a cell is changed only when its cleaned text (trimmed, upper case, inner space runs made one space) differs from what it holds

GOAL     Clean every Weld Seam No and Welder ID in the Weld Log to trimmed upper case with single inner spaces, and return how many cells changed.
PROC     CleanWeldLogIds
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldLog
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      changed As Long
VAR      clean As String
PRE      COL($ws, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($ws, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($ws, "Visual") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Weld Seam No", "Welder ID"]
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($ws, "Weld Seam No"))

OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cSeam) var=r

OP             LET(clean, UPPER(CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($ws, r, cSeam))))
OP             IF clean <> CELL($ws, r, cSeam)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cSeam), clean)
OP               LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cWelder) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cWelder))
OP           IF NOT IS_ERROR(CELL($ws, r, cWelder))
OP             LET(clean, UPPER(CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($ws, r, cWelder))))
OP             IF clean <> CELL($ws, r, cWelder)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cWelder), clean)
OP               LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       RETURN(changed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: BOM headers in row 1 include "Part No", "Description" and "Unit"
# ASSUME: units are matched ignoring case and stray spaces at the ends; kg and kgs become KG, nos, no and pcs become NOS, mtr, m and meter become MTR
# ASSUME: any other unit and every blank cell are left untouched; a cell already holding exactly the standard text is not counted
GOAL     Standardise the Unit column of the BOM to KG, NOS and MTR and return how many cells were changed.
PROC     StandardiseBomUnits
KIND     Function
MODULE   modBom
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cUnit As Long
VAR      changed As Long
VAR      std As String
PRE      COL($ws, "Part No") > 0; COL($ws, "Description") > 0; COL($ws, "Unit") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Unit"]
OP       LET(cUnit, COL($ws, "Unit"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cUnit) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_ERROR(CELL($ws, r, cUnit))
OP         LET(std, "")
OP         SELECT_CASE UPPER(TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cUnit)))
OP           CASE "KG", "KGS"
OP             LET(std, "KG")
OP           CASE "NOS", "NO", "PCS"
OP             LET(std, "NOS")
OP           CASE "MTR", "M", "METER"
OP             LET(std, "MTR")
OP         IF std <> ""
OP           IF std <> CELL($ws, r, cUnit)
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cUnit), std)
OP             LET(changed, changed + 1)
OP       RETURN(changed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
