VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Consumable Stock has headers in row 1: "Batch No", "Filler Class", "Qty On Hand", "Expiry Date"; the real sheets are "Consumable Stock" and "Expired Batches"
# ASSUME: the Expired Batches sheet already exists and is passed in; it is cleared and rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: a batch is expired when its Expiry Date is a real date before today; a batch expiring today is not expired yet
# ASSUME: a blank or non-date Expiry Date is skipped; the oldest expiry comes first
# ASSUME: Consumable Stock is only read, and the four columns are copied in the order Batch No, Filler Class, Qty On Hand, Expiry Date
GOAL     Rebuild the Expired Batches sheet with every consumable batch whose expiry date is before today, oldest first, and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListExpiredBatches
KIND     Function
MODULE   modStock
ARGS     stock As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cClass As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cExp As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Filler Class") > 0; COL($stock, "Qty On Hand") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($stock, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cClass, COL($stock, "Filler Class"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($stock, "Qty On Hand"))
OP       LET(cExp, COL($stock, "Expiry Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Batch No", "Filler Class", "Qty On Hand", "Expiry Date")
OP       LET(outRow, 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, cExp) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($stock, r, cExp))
OP           IF CELL($stock, r, cExp) < TODAY
OP             LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP             WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($stock, r, cBatch), CELL($stock, r, cClass), CELL($stock, r, cQty), CELL($stock, r, cExp))
OP       IF outRow > 2
OP         SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=4, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 1)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Welder Quals has headers in row 1 including "Welder ID" and "Folder Status"; the Welder Certs folder already exists and is passed in as a path
# ASSUME: a folder is named after the Welder ID with stray spaces trimmed and inner spaces made one; a welder on several rows gets one folder, and the later rows say Already there
# ASSUME: Folder Status says Made when the folder was created, Already there when it existed, and Bad name for a blank or unsafe Welder ID
# ASSUME: any other outcome (a file with that name in the way, a path too long) is written as the tool reports it, so no row is left unexplained
# ASSUME: nothing is deleted, overwritten or moved; only the Folder Status column of Welder Quals changes
GOAL     Make a folder named after each Welder ID inside the Welder Certs folder and write Made, Already there or Bad name in Folder Status on every row.
PROC     MakeWelderCertFolders
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelderCerts
ARGS     quals As Worksheet, certs As String
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      status As String
VAR      made As Long
PRE      COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Folder Status") > 0; FOLDER_EXISTS($certs)
MODIFIES $quals["Folder Status"]
MODIFIES $certs files
OP       LET(cId, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($quals, "Folder Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, cId) var=r
OP         MAKE_FOLDER(PATH_JOIN($certs, SAFE_NAME(CELL($quals, r, cId))), into=status)
OP         SELECT_CASE status
OP           CASE "Created"
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($quals, r, cStatus), "Made")
OP             LET(made, made + 1)
OP           CASE "Exists"
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($quals, r, cStatus), "Already there")
OP           CASE_ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($quals, r, cStatus), status)
OP       RETURN(made)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

GOAL     Put a formula in Short Qty on every BOM data row that gives Required Qty minus Issued Qty when positive, otherwise 0.
PROC     FillShortQtyFormula
KIND     Function
MODULE   modBom
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      last As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Part No") = 1; COL($ws, "Required Qty") = 2; COL($ws, "Issued Qty") = 3; COL($ws, "Short Qty") = 4

PROC     ShowWelderRows
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWeldLog
ARGS     ws As Worksheet, welder As String

VAR      shown As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Welder ID") > 0

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run one numbered step, or all four when step is 0, on the four sheets it is given and return how many welds have a remark.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     log As Worksheet, stock As Worksheet, usage As Worksheet, problems As Worksheet, step As Long
RET      Long
VAR      total As Long
PRE      $step >= 0; $step <= 4; COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Weld Date") > 0; COL($log, "Batch No") > 0; COL($log, "Remark") > 0; COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $log["Remark"]
MODIFIES $usage
MODIFIES $problems
OP       IF $step = 0 OR $step = 1
OP         CALL(modSteps.MarkRemarks, $log, $stock)
OP       IF $step = 0 OR $step = 2
OP         CALL(modSteps.WriteBatchUsage, $log, $usage)
OP       IF $step = 0 OR $step = 3
OP         CALL(modSteps.WriteProblems, $log, $problems)
OP       CALL(modSteps.CountRemarks, $log, into=total)
OP       RETURN(total)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Unknown batch or Expired batch in the Weld Log Remark column and clear the Remark of every other weld.
PROC     MarkRemarks
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet, stock As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cStockBatch As Long
VAR      cExpiry As Long
VAR      expiries As Dictionary
VAR      batch As String
VAR      remark As String
VAR      expiryDate As Variant
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Weld Date") > 0; COL($log, "Batch No") > 0; COL($log, "Remark") > 0; COL($stock, "Batch No") > 0; COL($stock, "Expiry Date") > 0
MODIFIES $log["Remark"]
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($log, "Weld Date"))
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($log, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($log, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cStockBatch, COL($stock, "Batch No"))
OP       LET(cExpiry, COL($stock, "Expiry Date"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($stock, cStockBatch) var=s
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($stock, s, cStockBatch))
OP         DICT_ADD(expiries, TRIM(CELL($stock, s, cStockBatch)), CELL($stock, s, cExpiry), mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         LET(batch, TRIM(CELL($log, r, cBatch)))
OP         LET(remark, "")
OP         IF EXISTS(expiries, batch)
OP           DICT_GET(expiries, batch, into=expiryDate)
OP           IF IS_DATE(expiryDate)
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($log, r, cDate))
OP               IF expiryDate < CELL($log, r, cDate) THEN LET(remark, "Expired batch")
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(remark, "Unknown batch")
OP         IF remark = ""
OP           CLEAR(CELL($log, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($log, r, cRemark), remark)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Batch Usage sheet with each batch number used in the Weld Log and its number of welds, the most welds first.
PROC     WriteBatchUsage
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet, usage As Worksheet
VAR      cBatch As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Batch No") > 0
MODIFIES $usage
OP       LET(cBatch, COL($log, "Batch No"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($usage), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($usage, 1, "Batch No", "Welds")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cBatch) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cBatch))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, TRIM(CELL($log, r, cBatch)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($usage, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 3 THEN SORT(USED_RANGE($usage), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Weld Problems sheet with the Weld Log headings and every weld that has a remark.
PROC     WriteProblems
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet, problems As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      nCols As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $problems
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($log, "Remark"))
OP       LET(nCols, LASTCOL($log, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($problems), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($log, 1, $problems, 1, cols=nCols)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cRemark))
OP           COPY_ROW($log, r, $problems, outRow, cols=nCols)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Count the welds in the Weld Log that have a remark and return that number.
PROC     CountRemarks
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     log As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($log, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($log, "Remark") > 0
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($log, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($log, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($log, cSeam) var=r
OP         IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL($log, r, cRemark)) THEN LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
BUILD
# ASSUME: GRN headers include "Part No", "Heat No", "Received Qty" and "Remark"; Material Certs has "Heat No"; BOM has "Part No", "Required Qty", "Received" and "Status"
# ASSUME: the real sheets are "GRN", "Material Certs", "BOM" and "Short Parts"; the TESTs use GRN, Certs, BOM and Short
# ASSUME: part and heat numbers are matched ignoring case and extra spaces; a GRN line with a blank Part No is skipped everywhere
# ASSUME: a blank Heat No has no cert row; when a line is both without cert and with a bad quantity, No cert wins
# ASSUME: only positive numeric Received Qty values are added up; a BOM line whose Required Qty is not a number gets Status Check
# ASSUME: each part is on one BOM line, so the Short count is the number of Short BOM lines; Short Parts is rebuilt on every run and exists
GOAL     Flag GRN lines without a cert or with a bad quantity, total received per BOM part, list the Short parts A to Z and count them.
NAME     GrnReceivingCheck
TARGET   xlsm
ENTRY    modMain.Run
MODULE   modMain
MODULE   modSteps
SIG      modMain.Run()
SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet, bom As Worksheet, out As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modSteps.MarkGrnRemarks(grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet)
SIG      modSteps.TotalReceived(bom As Worksheet, grn As Worksheet)
SIG      modSteps.ListShortParts(bom As Worksheet, out As Worksheet) As Long
FLOW     modMain.Run -> modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.MarkGrnRemarks
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.TotalReceived
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.ListShortParts
FIXTURE  grn_01.xlsx sheet=GRN cols=A:GRN No,B:Part No,C:Heat No,D:Received Qty,E:Remark rows=10 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("P-100"x3," p-100 "x1,"P-200"x1,"P-300"x2,""x1,"p-200"x1,"P-900"x1)+boundary("P-100"," p-100 ","P-200","P-300","","p-200","P-100","P-900","P-300","P-100");C:values("H1"x2," h1 "x1,"H2"x2,"H9"x2,""x1,"H3"x1,"h2"x1)+boundary("H1"," h1 ","H2","H9","H9","","H3","H1","H2","h2");D:values("10"x1,"5"x1,"0"x1,"8"x1,"3"x1,"abc"x1,"-2"x1,""x1,"4"x1,"1"x1)+boundary("10","5","0","8","3","abc","-2","","4","1");E:values("old"x10)
FIXTURE  grn_01.xlsx sheet=Certs cols=A:Heat No,B:MTC No rows=6 data=A:values("H1"x1,"H2"x1,""x1,"H3"x1,"h3"x1,"H2"x1)+boundary("H1","H2","","H3","h3","H2");B:text(6)
FIXTURE  grn_01.xlsx sheet=BOM cols=A:Part No,B:Required Qty,C:Received,D:Status rows=7 data=A:values("P-400"x1,"P-100"x1,""x1," P-200 "x1,"P-300"x1,"P-500"x1,"P-600"x1)+boundary("P-400","P-100",""," P-200 ","P-300","P-500","P-600");B:values("5"x1,"16"x1,"3"x1,"7"x1,"13"x1,"tbd"x1,"0"x1)+boundary("5","16","3","7","13","tbd","0");C:values("old"x7);D:values("old"x6,"Short"x1)+boundary("old","old","Short","old","old","old","old")
FIXTURE  grn_01.xlsx sheet=Short cols=A:Part No,B:Required Qty,C:Received,D:Status rows=0 stale=2
TEST     fixture=grn_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(GRN, Certs, BOM, Short) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 3 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTIF(GRN![Remark], "No cert") = 2 AND COUNTIF(GRN![Remark], "Check") = 3 AND COUNTIF(GRN![Remark], "old") = 1 AND COUNTA(GRN![Remark]) = 7 AND COUNTIF(BOM![Status], "Short") = 4 AND COUNTIF(BOM![Status], "Complete") = 2 AND COUNTIF(BOM![Status], "Check") = 1 AND COUNTA(Short![Part No]) = 4 AND COUNTIF(Short![Part No], "stale") = 0
TEST     fixture=grn_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(GRN, Certs, BOM, Short) assert=RESULT = 3 AND COUNTA(GRN![GRN No]) = PRE_COUNTA(GRN![GRN No]) AND COUNTA(BOM![Part No]) = PRE_COUNTA(BOM![Part No]) AND COUNTA(Certs![Heat No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Certs![Heat No]) AND SUM(BOM![Received]) = 28 AND VALUE(BOM![Received]3) = 16 AND VALUE(BOM![Received]6) = 12 AND COUNTIF(BOM![Received], "old") = 1 AND VALUE(Short![Part No]2) = "P-200" AND VALUE(Short![Part No]3) = "P-300" AND VALUE(Short![Part No]4) = "P-400" AND VALUE(Short![Received]3) = 12 AND VALUE(Short![Required Qty]4) = 5 AND VALUE(Short![Required Qty]2) = 7
TEST     fixture=grn_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Certs, GRN, BOM, Short) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the GRN receiving check on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many parts are Short.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "GRN"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Material Certs"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "BOM"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Short Parts"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Parts Short: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all three steps on the four sheets it is given and return how many parts are Short.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet, bom As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      short As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Remark") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0; COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Received") > 0; COL($bom, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $grn["Remark"]
MODIFIES $bom["Received", "Status"]
MODIFIES $out
OP       CALL(modSteps.MarkGrnRemarks, $grn, $certs)
OP       CALL(modSteps.TotalReceived, $bom, $grn)
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListShortParts, $bom, $out, into=short)
OP       RETURN(short)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write No cert or Check in the GRN Remark column, or clear it for every GRN line that has a Part No.
PROC     MarkGrnRemarks
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     grn As Worksheet, certs As Worksheet
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cHeat As Long
VAR      cQty As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cCert As Long
VAR      known As Dictionary
VAR      flag As String
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Heat No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($grn, "Remark") > 0; COL($certs, "Heat No") > 0
MODIFIES $grn["Remark"]
OP       LET(cPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cHeat, COL($grn, "Heat No"))
OP       LET(cQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($grn, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cCert, COL($certs, "Heat No"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($certs, cCert) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($certs, r, cCert))
OP         DICT_ADD(known, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($certs, r, cCert)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cPart))
OP         LET(flag, "")
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, cQty))
OP           IF CELL($grn, r, cQty) <= 0
OP             LET(flag, "Check")
OP         ELSE
OP           LET(flag, "Check")
OP         IF NOT EXISTS(known, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($grn, r, cHeat)))
OP           LET(flag, "No cert")
OP         IF flag = ""
OP           CLEAR(CELL($grn, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($grn, r, cRemark), flag)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write in each BOM line the total positive quantity received for its part in the GRN and set Status to Complete, Short or Check.
PROC     TotalReceived
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, grn As Worksheet
VAR      cGPart As Long
VAR      cGQty As Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      cRec As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      sums As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
PRE      COL($grn, "Part No") > 0; COL($grn, "Received Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Received") > 0; COL($bom, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $bom["Received", "Status"]
OP       LET(cGPart, COL($grn, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cGQty, COL($grn, "Received Qty"))
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(cRec, COL($bom, "Received"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($bom, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($grn, cGPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($grn, r, cGPart))
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($grn, r, cGQty))
OP           IF CELL($grn, r, cGQty) > 0
OP             DICT_ADD(sums, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($grn, r, cGPart)), CELL($grn, r, cGQty), mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cPart))
OP         LET(got, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(sums, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($bom, r, cPart)))
OP           DICT_GET(sums, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($bom, r, cPart)), into=got)
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cRec), got)
OP         IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($bom, r, cReq))
OP           IF got >= CELL($bom, r, cReq)
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cStatus), "Complete")
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cStatus), "Short")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($bom, r, cStatus), "Check")
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the output sheet with the Short BOM lines, sorted by Part No A to Z, and return how many there are.
PROC     ListShortParts
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     bom As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cPart As Long
VAR      cReq As Long
VAR      cRec As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($bom, "Part No") > 0; COL($bom, "Required Qty") > 0; COL($bom, "Received") > 0; COL($bom, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cPart, COL($bom, "Part No"))
OP       LET(cReq, COL($bom, "Required Qty"))
OP       LET(cRec, COL($bom, "Received"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($bom, "Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Part No", "Required Qty", "Received", "Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($bom, cPart) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($bom, r, cPart))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($bom, r, cStatus), "Short")
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, TRIM(CELL($bom, r, cPart)), CELL($bom, r, cReq), CELL($bom, r, cRec), "Short")
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the WPS coverage check on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many welder rows have No WPS.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "WPS Register"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "PQR List"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Quals"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Process Coverage"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Welder rows with No WPS: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all three steps on the four sheets it is given and return how many welder rows have No WPS.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, pqr As Worksheet, welders As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      noWps As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($wps, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($pqr, "PQR No") > 0; COL($pqr, "Result") > 0; COL($welders, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($welders, "Process") > 0; COL($welders, "WPS Check") > 0
MODIFIES $wps["Remark"]
MODIFIES $welders["WPS Check"]
MODIFIES $out
OP       CALL(modSteps.MarkWpsRemarks, $wps, $pqr)
OP       CALL(modSteps.MarkWelderWps, $welders, $wps, into=noWps)
OP       CALL(modSteps.WriteCoverage, $wps, $welders, $out)
OP       RETURN(noWps)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write No PQR or PQR failed in the Remark of each WPS whose PQR is missing or failed, and clear the Remark of the others.
PROC     MarkWpsRemarks
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, pqr As Worksheet
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cRef As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cPqr As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      results As Dictionary
VAR      pqrResult As String
VAR      flag As String
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "PQR Ref") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($pqr, "PQR No") > 0; COL($pqr, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $wps["Remark"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cRef, COL($wps, "PQR Ref"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cPqr, COL($pqr, "PQR No"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($pqr, "Result"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($pqr, cPqr) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($pqr, r, cPqr))
OP         DICT_ADD(results, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($pqr, r, cPqr)), CELL($pqr, r, cResult), mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo))
OP         LET(flag, "")
OP         IF NOT EXISTS(results, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wps, r, cRef)))
OP           LET(flag, "No PQR")
OP         ELSE
OP           DICT_GET(results, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wps, r, cRef)), into=pqrResult)
OP           IF SAME(pqrResult, "Fail")
OP             LET(flag, "PQR failed")
OP         IF flag = ""
OP           CLEAR(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, r, cRemark), flag)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write No WPS in WPS Check for each welder whose process has no WPS without a remark, clear it for the others, and return how many got No WPS.
PROC     MarkWelderWps
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     welders As Worksheet, wps As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cWProc As Long
VAR      cCheck As Long
VAR      clean As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($welders, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($welders, "Process") > 0; COL($welders, "WPS Check") > 0
MODIFIES $welders["WPS Check"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($wps, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cId, COL($welders, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cWProc, COL($welders, "Process"))
OP       LET(cCheck, COL($welders, "WPS Check"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo))
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cProc))
OP         IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cRemark))
OP           DICT_ADD(clean, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($welders, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($welders, r, cId))
OP         IF EXISTS(clean, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($welders, r, cWProc)))
OP           CLEAR(CELL($welders, r, cCheck), what=contents)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($welders, r, cCheck), "No WPS")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Process Coverage sheet with each process of the WPS Register, its WPS count, WPS with a remark and qualified welders, A to Z.
PROC     WriteCoverage
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, welders As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cWProc As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      remarked As Dictionary
VAR      qualified As Dictionary
VAR      a As Long
VAR      b As Long
VAR      c As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($wps, "WPS No") > 0; COL($wps, "Process") > 0; COL($wps, "Remark") > 0; COL($welders, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($welders, "Process") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cNo, COL($wps, "WPS No"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($wps, "Process"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($wps, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cId, COL($welders, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cWProc, COL($welders, "Process"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Process", "WPS Count", "WPS With Remark", "Welders Qualified")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wps, cNo) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cNo))
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cProc))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(remarked, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wps, r, cProc)), IIF(IS_EMPTY(CELL($wps, r, cRemark)), 0, 1), mode=sum)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($welders, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($welders, r, cId))
OP         DICT_ADD(qualified, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($welders, r, cWProc)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=a)
OP         DICT_GET(remarked, k, into=b)
OP         LET(c, 0)
OP         IF EXISTS(qualified, k)
OP           DICT_GET(qualified, k, into=c)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, a, b, c)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: PQR List headers in row 1 include "PQR No", "Process", "Test Date", "Result" and "Remark"
# ASSUME: Result is matched ignoring case and extra spaces; Test Date must be a real date, otherwise the row is left alone
# ASSUME: more than 90 days ago means the Test Date is before today minus 90 days, so exactly 90 days ago is not due
# ASSUME: every other row with a real Test Date has its Remark cleared, including Fail rows that are not old enough
# ASSUME: the macro returns the number of retests due
GOAL     Write Retest due in Remark for every failed PQR tested more than 90 days ago, clear Remark on other rows with a real test date and return how many retests are due.
PROC     MarkPqrRetests
KIND     Function
MODULE   modPqr
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cResult As Long
VAR      cRemark As Long
VAR      due As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "PQR No") > 0; COL($ws, "Process") > 0; COL($ws, "Test Date") > 0; COL($ws, "Result") > 0; COL($ws, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Remark"]
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Test Date"))
OP       LET(cResult, COL($ws, "Result"))
OP       LET(cRemark, COL($ws, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, COL($ws, "PQR No")) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF NOT IS_DATE(CELL($ws, r, cDate))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cResult), "Fail") AND CELL($ws, r, cDate) < TODAY - 90
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), "Retest due")
OP           LET(due, due + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           CLEAR(CELL($ws, r, cRemark), what=contents)
OP       RETURN(due)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  pqr_01.xlsx sheet=Pqr cols=A:PQR No,B:Process,C:Test Date,D:Result,E:Remark rows=10 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("GTAW"x5,"SMAW"x5);C:reldates(-200,0)+boundary(-91,-90,-89,-300,-120,"",-10,-100,-95,-5);D:values("Fail"x2,"FAIL"x1,"fail "x1,"Pass"x3,"Fail"x3)+boundary("Fail","Fail","Fail","FAIL","fail ","Fail","Fail","Pass","Pass","Pass");E:values("x"x10)
FIXTURE  pqr_01.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=2 data=A:text(8)
TEST     fixture=pqr_01.xlsx call=MarkPqrRetests(Pqr) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 3 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTIF(Pqr![Remark], "Retest due") = 3 AND COUNTIF(Pqr![Remark], "x") = 1
TEST     fixture=pqr_01.xlsx call=MarkPqrRetests(Pqr) assert=VALUE(Pqr![Remark]2) = "Retest due" AND VALUE(Pqr![Remark]3) = "" AND VALUE(Pqr![Remark]4) = "" AND VALUE(Pqr![Remark]5) = "Retest due" AND VALUE(Pqr![Remark]6) = "Retest due" AND VALUE(Pqr![Remark]7) = "x" AND COUNTA(Pqr![PQR No]) = PRE_COUNTA(Pqr![PQR No]) AND COUNTA(Pqr![Result]) = PRE_COUNTA(Pqr![Result])
TEST     fixture=pqr_01.xlsx call=MarkPqrRetests(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Welder Quals has headers in row 1: "Welder ID", "Process", "Expiry Date"; the real sheets are "Welder Quals" and "Welder List"
# ASSUME: the Welder List sheet already exists and is passed in; it is cleared and rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: the process is matched ignoring case and stray spaces at the ends; rows with a blank Process are skipped, and a blank process argument stops the run
# ASSUME: rows are copied as they are, with the same three headings, and sorted by Welder ID A to Z; Welder Quals is only read
GOAL     Rebuild the Welder List sheet with every Welder Quals row for the given process, sorted by Welder ID, and return how many rows were listed.
PROC     ListWeldersForProcess
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWelders
ARGS     quals As Worksheet, out As Worksheet, proc As String
RET      Long
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cProc As Long
VAR      cExp As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($quals, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($quals, "Process") > 0; COL($quals, "Expiry Date") > 0; NOT IS_EMPTY($proc)
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cId, COL($quals, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cProc, COL($quals, "Process"))
OP       LET(cExp, COL($quals, "Expiry Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Welder ID", "Process", "Expiry Date")
OP       LET(outRow, 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($quals, cId) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($quals, r, cProc), $proc)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP           WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, CELL($quals, r, cId), CELL($quals, r, cProc), CELL($quals, r, cExp))
OP       IF outRow > 2
OP         SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 1)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
BUILD

# ASSUME: Seam numbers are matched ignoring case and stray spaces; a Result of Reject is matched ignoring case and spaces
# ASSUME: Weld Log rows with a blank Weld Seam No are left alone; welds with a blank Welder ID are not counted per welder
# ASSUME: the Repair List and Welder Rejects sheets exist and are rebuilt on every run; the real sheets are "Weld Log", "NDE Report", "Repair List" and "Welder Rejects", the TESTs use Wlog, Nde, Repair and Rej
# ASSUME: the lists are built from the NDE Status the first step has just written; the three steps run together in one macro, because a BUILD cannot start a step on its own from a sheet argument
GOAL     Set each weld's NDE status from the NDE report, list the rejected welds, count rejected welds per welder and report how many welds are not tested.

MODULE   modSteps

SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(wlog As Worksheet, nde As Worksheet, repair As Worksheet, rej As Worksheet) As Long

SIG      modSteps.ListRepairs(wlog As Worksheet, repair As Worksheet)

FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modSteps.ListRepairs

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the weld NDE follow-up on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many welds are not tested.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Weld Log"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "NDE Report"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Repair List"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Welder Rejects"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Welds Not tested: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all three steps on the sheets it is given and return how many welds are not tested.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     wlog As Worksheet, nde As Worksheet, repair As Worksheet, rej As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($wlog, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($wlog, "NDE Status") > 0; COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $wlog["NDE Status"]
MODIFIES $repair
MODIFIES $rej
OP       CALL(modSteps.SetNdeStatus, $wlog, $nde, into=n)
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListRepairs, $wlog, $repair)
OP       CALL(modSteps.CountRejects, $wlog, $rej)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Rejected, Accepted or Not tested in NDE Status of every weld from the NDE report and return how many welds are Not tested.
PROC     SetNdeStatus
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     wlog As Worksheet, nde As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      nSeam As Long
VAR      nResult As Long
VAR      tested As Dictionary
VAR      rejected As Dictionary
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($wlog, "NDE Status") > 0; COL($nde, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($nde, "Result") > 0
MODIFIES $wlog["NDE Status"]
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($wlog, "NDE Status"))
OP       LET(nSeam, COL($nde, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(nResult, COL($nde, "Result"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($nde, nSeam) var=r
OP         DICT_ADD(tested, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($nde, r, nSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($nde, r, nResult), "Reject")
OP           DICT_ADD(rejected, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($nde, r, nSeam)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wlog, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wlog, r, cSeam))
OP         IF EXISTS(rejected, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wlog, r, cSeam)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($wlog, r, cStatus), "Rejected")
OP         ELSE
OP           IF EXISTS(tested, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wlog, r, cSeam)))
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($wlog, r, cStatus), "Accepted")
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($wlog, r, cStatus), "Not tested")
OP             LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Repair List sheet with the rejected welds and the same headings, sorted by weld seam number A to Z, and return how many were listed.
PROC     ListRepairs
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     wlog As Worksheet, repair As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($wlog, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($wlog, "NDE Status") > 0
MODIFIES $repair
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($wlog, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($wlog, "NDE Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($repair), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($repair, 1, "Weld Seam No", "Welder ID", "NDE Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wlog, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF NOT SAME(CELL($wlog, r, cStatus), "Rejected")
OP         WRITE_ROW($repair, outRow, CELL($wlog, r, cSeam), CELL($wlog, r, cWelder), CELL($wlog, r, cStatus))
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($repair), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Welder Rejects sheet with each welder ID and its number of rejected welds, the most first, and return how many welders were listed.
PROC     CountRejects
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     wlog As Worksheet, rej As Worksheet
VAR      cSeam As Long
VAR      cWelder As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No") > 0; COL($wlog, "Welder ID") > 0; COL($wlog, "NDE Status") > 0
MODIFIES $rej
OP       LET(cSeam, COL($wlog, "Weld Seam No"))
OP       LET(cWelder, COL($wlog, "Welder ID"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($wlog, "NDE Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($rej), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($rej, 1, "Welder ID", "Rejected")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($wlog, cSeam) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF NOT SAME(CELL($wlog, r, cStatus), "Rejected")
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($wlog, r, cWelder))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($wlog, r, cWelder)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($rej, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($rej), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: Dispatch headers in row 1 include "Customer", "Planned Date" and "Actual Date"; the real sheets are Dispatch and On Time, and On Time already exists
# ASSUME: customers are grouped ignoring case and stray spaces, and shown as first typed; rows with a blank Customer are ignored
# ASSUME: a dispatch counts as delivered only when its Actual Date is a real date; it is late only when its Planned Date is also a real date and the Actual Date is after it
# ASSUME: a customer with no delivered dispatch still gets a row with 0 and 0; the function returns the number of customers listed
GOAL     Rebuild the On Time sheet with each customer, its dispatches that have an actual date and how many of those were late, customers A to Z.
PROC     BuildOnTimeReport
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     disp As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cCust As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      cAct As Long
VAR      done As Dictionary
VAR      late As Dictionary
VAR      doneN As Long
VAR      lateN As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($disp, "Customer") > 0; COL($disp, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Actual Date") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cCust, COL($disp, "Customer"))
OP       LET(cPlan, COL($disp, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cAct, COL($disp, "Actual Date"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Customer", "Dispatched", "Late")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($disp, cCust) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($disp, r, cCust))
OP         DICT_ADD(done, TRIM(CELL($disp, r, cCust)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(late, TRIM(CELL($disp, r, cCust)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, cAct))
OP           DICT_ADD(done, TRIM(CELL($disp, r, cCust)), 1, mode=sum)
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, cPlan))
OP             IF CELL($disp, r, cAct) > CELL($disp, r, cPlan)
OP               DICT_ADD(late, TRIM(CELL($disp, r, cCust)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(done)
OP         DICT_GET(done, k, into=doneN)
OP         DICT_GET(late, k, into=lateN)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, doneN, lateN)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 3 THEN SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=1, order=asc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(outRow - 2)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
BUILD
# ASSUME: the real sheets are Dispatch, Job Tracker, Late Dispatches and Customer Late; the TESTs use Dispatch, JobTracker, LateDisp and CustLate
# ASSUME: Late Dispatches and Customer Late already exist and are rebuilt on every run
# ASSUME: Late needs two real dates with Actual Date after Planned Date; Overdue needs an empty Actual Date and a real Planned Date before today; every other Remark is cleared
# ASSUME: Job IDs are matched ignoring case and stray spaces; a Job Tracker row with a blank Job ID is left alone
# ASSUME: a job's Late dispatch is one whose Remark is Late after step 1; a job with no dispatch is Not shipped
# ASSUME: Customer Late lists every customer of the Job Tracker (names matched ignoring case and spaces, shown as first typed) with 0 when it has no Shipped late job; equal counts come in no fixed order
GOAL     Mark late and overdue dispatches, set each job's dispatch status, list the late and overdue dispatches by planned date and count shipped-late jobs per customer.
NAME     DispatchMonthEnd
TARGET   xlsm
ENTRY    modMain.Run
MODULE   modMain
MODULE   modDispatch
SIG      modMain.Run()
SIG      modMain.RunHeadless(disp As Worksheet, jobs As Worksheet, lateOut As Worksheet, custOut As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modDispatch.MarkRemarks(disp As Worksheet) As Long
SIG      modDispatch.SetJobStatus(jobs As Worksheet, disp As Worksheet)
SIG      modDispatch.ListLateDispatches(disp As Worksheet, out As Worksheet)
SIG      modDispatch.CountCustomerLate(jobs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet)
FLOW     modMain.Run -> modMain.RunHeadless -> modDispatch.MarkRemarks
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modDispatch.SetJobStatus
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modDispatch.ListLateDispatches
FLOW     modMain.RunHeadless -> modDispatch.CountCustomerLate
FIXTURE  dispatch_01.xlsx sheet=Dispatch cols=A:Dispatch No,B:Job ID,C:Planned Date,D:Actual Date,E:Remark rows=10 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("J-1"x1," j-1"x1,"J-2"x2,"J-3"x2,"J-4 "x1,"J-5"x1,""x1,"J-7"x1)+boundary("J-1"," j-1","J-2","J-2","J-3","J-3","J-4 ","J-5","","J-7");C:reldates(-30,10)+boundary(-10,-5,-4,-3,0,5,-1,-7,1,-20);D:reldates(-30,10)+boundary(-8,-5,-6,"","","","",-1,2,-19);E:values("old"x8,"Late"x1,"Overdue"x1)+boundary("old","old","old","Late","old","old","old","old","old","Overdue")
FIXTURE  dispatch_01.xlsx sheet=JobTracker cols=A:Job ID,B:Customer,C:Status,D:Dispatch Status rows=9 data=A:values(" j-1"x1,"J-2"x1,""x1,"J-3"x1,"J-4 "x1,"j-5"x1,"J-6"x1,"J-7"x1,"J-8"x1)+boundary(" j-1","J-2","","J-3","J-4 ","j-5","J-6","J-7","J-8");B:values("Acme"x2,"acme "x1,"Dyer"x1,"Bolt"x2,""x1,"Cask"x2)+boundary("Acme","acme ","Dyer","Bolt","","Cask","Cask","Acme","Bolt");C:values("Open"x9);D:values("old"x9)
FIXTURE  dispatch_01.xlsx sheet=LateDisp cols=A:Dispatch No,B:Job ID,C:Planned Date,D:Actual Date,E:Remark rows=0 stale=3
FIXTURE  dispatch_01.xlsx sheet=CustLate cols=A:Customer,B:Late Jobs rows=0 stale=2
TEST     fixture=dispatch_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(Dispatch, JobTracker, LateDisp, CustLate) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 2 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTIF(Dispatch![Remark], "Late") = 4 AND COUNTIF(Dispatch![Remark], "Overdue") = 2 AND COUNTIF(Dispatch![Remark], "old") = 0 AND COUNTIF(JobTracker![Dispatch Status], "Shipped late") = 3 AND COUNTIF(JobTracker![Dispatch Status], "Shipped") = 1 AND COUNTIF(JobTracker![Dispatch Status], "Not shipped") = 4 AND COUNTIF(JobTracker![Dispatch Status], "old") = 1 AND COUNTA(LateDisp![Dispatch No]) = 7 AND ROWS_USED(LateDisp) = 7 AND ROWS_USED(CustLate) = 5 AND COUNTIF(LateDisp![Dispatch No], "stale") = 0 AND COUNTA(CustLate![Customer]) = 5 AND COUNTIF(CustLate![Customer], "stale") = 0

TEST     fixture=dispatch_01.xlsx call=modMain.RunHeadless(JobTracker, Dispatch, LateDisp, CustLate) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the dispatch month-end report on the workbook's own sheets and tell the user how many dispatches are overdue.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Dispatch"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Job Tracker"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Late Dispatches"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Customer Late"), into=n)
OP       MSG("Overdue dispatches: " & n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all four report steps on the four sheets it is given and return how many dispatches are overdue.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     disp As Worksheet, jobs As Worksheet, lateOut As Worksheet, custOut As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      overdue As Long
PRE      COL($disp, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($disp, "Job ID") > 0; COL($disp, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Remark") > 0; COL($jobs, "Job ID") > 0; COL($jobs, "Customer") > 0; COL($jobs, "Dispatch Status") > 0
MODIFIES $disp["Remark"]
MODIFIES $jobs["Dispatch Status"]
MODIFIES $lateOut
MODIFIES $custOut
OP       CALL(modDispatch.MarkRemarks, $disp, into=overdue)
OP       CALL(modDispatch.SetJobStatus, $jobs, $disp)
OP       CALL(modDispatch.ListLateDispatches, $disp, $lateOut)
OP       CALL(modDispatch.CountCustomerLate, $jobs, $custOut)
OP       RETURN(overdue)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Late, Overdue or nothing in each dispatch's Remark and return how many dispatches are overdue.
PROC     MarkRemarks
KIND     Function
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     disp As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      cAct As Long
VAR      cRem As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($disp, "Dispatch No") > 0; COL($disp, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $disp["Remark"]
OP       LET(cNo, COL($disp, "Dispatch No"))
OP       LET(cPlan, COL($disp, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(cAct, COL($disp, "Actual Date"))
OP       LET(cRem, COL($disp, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($disp, cNo) var=r
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($disp, r, cRem), "")
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, cAct))
OP           IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, cPlan))
OP             IF CELL($disp, r, cAct) > CELL($disp, r, cPlan)
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($disp, r, cRem), "Late")
OP         ELSE
OP           IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($disp, r, cAct))
OP             IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, cPlan))
OP               IF CELL($disp, r, cPlan) < TODAY
OP                 SET_VALUE(CELL($disp, r, cRem), "Overdue")
OP                 LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Set each job's Dispatch Status to Shipped late, Shipped or Not shipped from the dispatches that carry its Job ID.
PROC     SetJobStatus
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     jobs As Worksheet, disp As Worksheet
VAR      cJob As Long
VAR      cStat As Long
VAR      dJob As Long
VAR      dAct As Long
VAR      dRem As Long
VAR      lateJobs As Dictionary
VAR      shipJobs As Dictionary
PRE      COL($jobs, "Job ID") > 0; COL($jobs, "Dispatch Status") > 0; COL($disp, "Job ID") > 0; COL($disp, "Actual Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $jobs["Dispatch Status"]
OP       LET(cJob, COL($jobs, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(cStat, COL($jobs, "Dispatch Status"))
OP       LET(dJob, COL($disp, "Job ID"))
OP       LET(dAct, COL($disp, "Actual Date"))
OP       LET(dRem, COL($disp, "Remark"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($disp, dJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($disp, r, dJob))
OP         IF SAME(CELL($disp, r, dRem), "Late") THEN DICT_ADD(lateJobs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($disp, r, dJob)), 1, mode=keep)
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($disp, r, dAct)) THEN DICT_ADD(shipJobs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($disp, r, dJob)), 1, mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($jobs, cJob) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($jobs, r, cJob))
OP         IF EXISTS(lateJobs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($jobs, r, cJob)))
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($jobs, r, cStat), "Shipped late")
OP         ELSE
OP           IF EXISTS(shipJobs, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($jobs, r, cJob)))
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($jobs, r, cStat), "Shipped")
OP           ELSE
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($jobs, r, cStat), "Not shipped")
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Late Dispatches sheet with the Late and Overdue dispatches under the same headings, earliest planned date first.
PROC     ListLateDispatches
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     disp As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cRem As Long
VAR      cPlan As Long
VAR      nCols As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($disp, "Planned Date") > 0; COL($disp, "Remark") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cRem, COL($disp, "Remark"))
OP       LET(cPlan, COL($disp, "Planned Date"))
OP       LET(nCols, LASTCOL($disp, 1))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       COPY_ROW($disp, 1, $out, 1, cols=nCols)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($disp, cPlan) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($disp, r, cRem), "Late") OR SAME(CELL($disp, r, cRem), "Overdue")
OP           COPY_ROW($disp, r, $out, outRow, cols=nCols)
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=cPlan, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Customer Late sheet with each customer and its number of Shipped late jobs, the most first.
PROC     CountCustomerLate
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modDispatch
ARGS     jobs As Worksheet, out As Worksheet
VAR      cCust As Long
VAR      cStat As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($jobs, "Customer") > 0; COL($jobs, "Dispatch Status") > 0
MODIFIES $out
OP       LET(cCust, COL($jobs, "Customer"))
OP       LET(cStat, COL($jobs, "Dispatch Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($out), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($out, 1, "Customer", "Late Jobs")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($jobs, cCust) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($jobs, r, cCust))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($jobs, r, cCust)), 0, mode=sum)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($jobs, r, cStat), "Shipped late") THEN DICT_ADD(counts, CLEAN_TEXT(CELL($jobs, r, cCust)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($out), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Start the calibration and NCR check on the workbook's own four sheets and tell the user how many NCRs were flagged.
PROC     Run
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modMain
VAR      n As Long
OP       CALL(modMain.RunHeadless, SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Calibration Tracker"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "NCR Register"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "Overdue Instruments"), SHEET(THIS_BOOK, "NCR Instruments"), into=n)
OP       MSG("NCRs flagged: " & n)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Run all four steps of the calibration and NCR check on the sheets it is given and return how many NCRs were flagged.
PROC     RunHeadless
KIND     Function
MODULE   modMain
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, ncr As Worksheet, over As Worksheet, inst As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      flagged As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Type") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0; COL($cal, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "Cal Flag") > 0
MODIFIES $cal["Status"]
MODIFIES $ncr["Cal Flag"]
MODIFIES $over
MODIFIES $inst
OP       CALL(modSteps.SetCalStatus, $cal)
OP       CALL(modSteps.FlagNcrs, $cal, $ncr, into=flagged)
OP       CALL(modSteps.ListOverdue, $cal, $over)
OP       CALL(modSteps.CountByInstrument, $ncr, $inst)
OP       RETURN(flagged)
ERR      standard

VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Write Overdue, Due soon, OK or No date in each instrument's Status from its next calibration due date.
PROC     SetCalStatus
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     cal As Worksheet
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cStat As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0; COL($cal, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $cal["Status"]
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LET(cStat, COL($cal, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         IF IS_DATE(CELL($cal, r, cDue))
OP           IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) < TODAY
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($cal, r, cStat), "Overdue")
OP           ELSE
OP             IF CELL($cal, r, cDue) <= TODAY + 14
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($cal, r, cStat), "Due soon")
OP             ELSE
OP               SET_VALUE(CELL($cal, r, cStat), "OK")
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($cal, r, cStat), "No date")
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Flag each open NCR on an overdue instrument and each NCR on an instrument missing from the tracker, clear the flag on the rest and return how many were flagged.
PROC     FlagNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, ncr As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cCalId As Long
VAR      cCalStat As Long
VAR      cNo As Long
VAR      cNcrId As Long
VAR      cNcrStat As Long
VAR      cFlag As Long
VAR      cals As Dictionary
VAR      kind As Long
VAR      id As String
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ncr, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($ncr, "Status") > 0; COL($ncr, "Cal Flag") > 0
MODIFIES $ncr["Cal Flag"]
OP       LET(cCalId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cCalStat, COL($cal, "Status"))
OP       LET(cNo, COL($ncr, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cNcrId, COL($ncr, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cNcrStat, COL($ncr, "Status"))
OP       LET(cFlag, COL($ncr, "Cal Flag"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cCalId) var=r
OP         DICT_ADD(cals, TRIM(CELL($cal, r, cCalId)), IIF(SAME(CELL($cal, r, cCalStat), "Overdue"), 2, 1), mode=keep)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cNo) var=q
OP         CLEAR(CELL($ncr, q, cFlag), what=contents)
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, q, cNcrId))
OP         LET(id, TRIM(CELL($ncr, q, cNcrId)))
OP         IF EXISTS(cals, id)
OP           DICT_GET(cals, id, into=kind)
OP           IF kind = 2 AND NOT SAME(CELL($ncr, q, cNcrStat), "Closed")
OP             SET_VALUE(CELL($ncr, q, cFlag), "Overdue instrument")
OP             LET(n, n + 1)
OP         ELSE
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ncr, q, cFlag), "Unknown instrument")
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the Overdue Instruments sheet with every overdue instrument and its details, the earliest due date first.
PROC     ListOverdue
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     cal As Worksheet, over As Worksheet
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      cType As Long
VAR      cDue As Long
VAR      cStat As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($cal, "Instrument ID") > 0; COL($cal, "Type") > 0; COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due") > 0; COL($cal, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $over
OP       LET(cId, COL($cal, "Instrument ID"))
OP       LET(cType, COL($cal, "Type"))
OP       LET(cDue, COL($cal, "Next Calibration Due"))
OP       LET(cStat, COL($cal, "Status"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($over), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($over, 1, "Instrument ID", "Type", "Next Calibration Due", "Status")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($cal, cId) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($cal, r, cStat), "Overdue")
OP           WRITE_ROW($over, outRow, CELL($cal, r, cId), CELL($cal, r, cType), CELL($cal, r, cDue), CELL($cal, r, cStat))
OP           LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 2 THEN SORT(USED_RANGE($over), key=3, order=asc, header=yes)
ERR      standard
---
VCL 0.6
TASK
GOAL     Rebuild the NCR Instruments sheet with each instrument named in the NCR Register and its number of NCRs, the most first.
PROC     CountByInstrument
KIND     Sub
MODULE   modSteps
ARGS     ncr As Worksheet, inst As Worksheet
VAR      cId As Long
VAR      counts As Dictionary
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
PRE      COL($ncr, "Instrument ID") > 0
MODIFIES $inst
OP       LET(cId, COL($ncr, "Instrument ID"))
OP       CLEAR(USED_RANGE($inst), what=all)
OP       WRITE_ROW($inst, 1, "Instrument ID", "NCR Count")
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ncr, cId) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ncr, r, cId))
OP         DICT_ADD(counts, TRIM(CELL($ncr, r, cId)), 1, mode=sum)
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(counts)
OP         DICT_GET(counts, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW($inst, outRow, UPPER(k), got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       IF outRow > 2 THEN SORT(USED_RANGE($inst), key=2, order=desc, header=yes)
ERR      standard

GOAL     Make a new WPS from the old one by copying company, process, mechanization and filler designation and writing the new number DM-WPS-203.
PROC     MakeNewWps
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWps
ARGS     wps As Worksheet, oldBook As Workbook
RET      Long
VAR      src As Worksheet
VAR      n As Long
PRE      CELL($wps, 4, 1) = "Company Name :"; CELL($wps, 6, 1) = "Welding Procedure Specification No. :"; CELL($wps, 39, 1) = "Filler Material Designation :"; CELL(SHEET($oldBook, "WPS"), 4, 1) = "Company Name :"; CELL(SHEET($oldBook, "WPS"), 39, 1) = "Filler Material Designation :"
MODIFIES $wps
OP       LET(src, SHEET($oldBook, "WPS"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=4 to=9 var=r
OP         SKIP_IF r = 6 OR r = 7
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL(src, r, 3))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, r, 3), CELL(src, r, 3))
OP         LET(n, n + 1)
OP       IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL(src, 39, 3))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, 39, 3), CELL(src, 39, 3))
OP         LET(n, n + 1)
OP       IF NOT IS_EMPTY(CELL(src, 39, 6))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, 39, 6), CELL(src, 39, 6))
OP         LET(n, n + 1)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($wps, 6, 3), "DM-WPS-203")
OP       RETURN(n)

GOAL     Clear the recorded PQR values of runs 1 to 3 (PQR I, U, v and HI recorded) in the heat-input check block of the WPS.

GOAL     Write R. Demo, Welding Engineer as the preparer's name and today's date as dd/mm/yyyy beside the Name and Date labels at the bottom of the WPS sheet.
PROC     SignWps
KIND     Function
MODULE   modWps
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      nameHit As Range
VAR      dateHit As Range
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(nameHit, FIND(USED_RANGE($ws), "Name >>", match=whole))
OP       LET(dateHit, FIND(USED_RANGE($ws), "Date >>", match=whole))

TASK
# ASSUME: the Inputs sheet has the headers "Ref" and "Value" in row 1; the real sheet is called Inputs, and the TESTs use the short form Inputs with the template's own headings
# ASSUME: the parameters are found by their Ref text, r_plate and margin, ignoring case and spaces; the margin is written as the fraction 0.12

GOAL     Set the plate rate r_plate to 95 and the margin to 0.12 in the Value column of the Inputs sheet and change nothing else.
PROC     SetPlateRateAndMargin
KIND     Function
MODULE   modEstimation
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cRef As Long
VAR      cVal As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "Ref") > 0; COL($ws, "Value") > 0
MODIFIES $ws["Value"]
OP       LET(cRef, COL($ws, "Ref"))
OP       LET(cVal, COL($ws, "Value"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cRef) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cRef), "r_plate")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cVal), 95)
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cRef), "margin")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cVal), 0.12)
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

TASK

GOAL     Add the PWHT of floating head activity after the last row of the Conversion sheet with the same Total Qty and Amount formulas as the row above.
PROC     AddPwhtActivity
KIND     Function
MODULE   modEstimation
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      last As Long
VAR      newRow As Long
PRE      CELL($ws, 4, 1) = "Sl"; CELL($ws, 4, 5) = "Qty / set"; CELL($ws, 4, 7) = "Total Qty"; CELL($ws, 4, 9) = "Rate (INR)"; IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, LASTROW($ws, 1), 1))
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(last, LASTROW($ws, 1))
OP       EXIT_IF SAME(CELL($ws, last, 3), "PWHT of floating head")
OP       LET(newRow, last + 1)
OP       IF IS_NUMBER(CELL($ws, last, 1))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 1), CELL($ws, last, 1) + 1)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 2), "FH")
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 3), "PWHT of floating head")
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 4), "furnace, 1 lot")
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 5), 1)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 6), 2)
OP       SET_FORMULA(CELL($ws, newRow, 7), "=RC5*RC6", style=r1c1)
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 8), "Lot")
OP       SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, newRow, 9), 40000)
OP       SET_FORMULA(CELL($ws, newRow, 10), "=RC7*RC9", style=r1c1)
OP       RETURN(newRow)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard

KIND     Function
MODULE   modRegister
ARGS     ws As Worksheet

VAR      cSr As Long
VAR      cEnq As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cUser As Long

KIND     Function
MODULE   modRegister
ARGS     reg As Worksheet, est As Workbook
RET      Long
VAR      src As Worksheet
VAR      cRegItem As Long
VAR      cRegTag As Long
VAR      cSrcItem As Long
VAR      cSrcTag As Long
VAR      outRow As Long

PRE      SHEET_EXISTS($est, "Enq Summary"); COL($reg, "Item") > 0; COL($reg, "Revised Tag No") > 0; COL($reg, "Enquiry") > 0; COL($reg, "Date") > 0; COL($reg, "Type") > 0; COL($reg, "U Stamp") > 0; COL($reg, "Old Tag No") > 0; COL($reg, "Qty") > 0; COL($reg, "MOC") > 0; COL($reg, "Shell ID mm") > 0; COL($reg, "Shell THK mm") > 0; COL($reg, "TL To TL mm") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Item") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Revised Tag No") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Enquiry") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Date") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Type") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "U Stamp") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Old Tag No") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Qty") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "MOC") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Shell ID mm") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "Shell THK mm") > 0; COL(SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"), "TL To TL mm") > 0
MODIFIES $reg["Enquiry", "Date", "Item", "Type", "U Stamp", "Old Tag No", "Revised Tag No", "Qty", "MOC", "Shell ID mm", "Shell THK mm", "TL To TL mm"]
OP       LET(src, SHEET($est, "Enq Summary"))
OP       LET(cRegItem, COL($reg, "Item"))
OP       LET(cRegTag, COL($reg, "Revised Tag No"))
OP       LET(cSrcItem, COL(src, "Item"))
OP       LET(cSrcTag, COL(src, "Revised Tag No"))
OP       EXIT_IF SAME(CELL($reg, LASTROW($reg, cRegItem), COL($reg, "Enquiry")), CELL(src, 2, COL(src, "Enquiry")))
OP       LET(outRow, LASTROW($reg, cRegItem) + 1)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW(src, cSrcItem) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL(src, r, cSrcItem))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "Enquiry")), CELL(src, 2, COL(src, "Enquiry")))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "Date")), CELL(src, 2, COL(src, "Date")))

OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "MOC")), CELL(src, r, COL(src, "MOC")))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "Shell ID mm")), CELL(src, r, COL(src, "Shell ID mm")))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "Shell THK mm")), CELL(src, r, COL(src, "Shell THK mm")))
OP         SET_VALUE(CELL($reg, outRow, COL($reg, "TL To TL mm")), CELL(src, r, COL(src, "TL To TL mm")))
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP         LET(added, added + 1)
OP       RETURN(added)

VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the NCR Register headers are in row 1 and include "NCR No", "Severity" and "Status"; data starts in row 2
# ASSUME: "Major" and "Open" are matched ignoring case and extra spaces, so " open" and "OPEN " count as Open
# ASSUME: the macro owns the fills of the data rows: each row is reset to no fill, then every Open Major row gets light red #FFC7CE across the header's columns
# ASSUME: the header row and the other sheets are not touched
GOAL     Colour every NCR that is Major and still Open light red, and return how many there are.
PROC     HighlightOpenMajorNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcrReview
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNcr As Long
VAR      cSeverity As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      lastCol As Long
VAR      n As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ws, "Severity") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws fills
OP       LET(cNcr, COL($ws, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cSeverity, COL($ws, "Severity"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LET(lastCol, LASTCOL($ws, 1))
OP       LET(n, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNcr) var=r
OP         FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=none)
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cSeverity), "Major") AND SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           FORMAT(ROW_RANGE($ws, r, 1, lastCol), fill=#FFC7CE)
OP           LET(n, n + 1)
OP       RETURN(n)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  ncr_01.xlsx sheet=NCR cols=A:NCR No,B:Severity,C:Status rows=8 stale=2 data=A:seq(1,1);B:values("Major"x3," major "x1,"Minor"x4)+boundary("Major"," major ","Major","Minor","Major","Minor","Minor","Minor");C:values("Open"x2," open"x1,"Closed"x3,"On Hold"x2)+boundary("Open"," open","Closed","Open","On Hold","Closed","Closed","On Hold")
FIXTURE  ncr_01.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=2 data=A:text(8)
TEST     fixture=ncr_01.xlsx call=HighlightOpenMajorNcrs(NCR) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 2 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No], #FFC7CE) = 2 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![Status], #FFC7CE) = 2 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No], #FF0000) = 0
TEST     fixture=ncr_01.xlsx call=HighlightOpenMajorNcrs(NCR) assert=RESULT = 2 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No]2, #FFC7CE) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No]3, #FFC7CE) = 1 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No]4, #FFC7CE) = 0 AND FILL_COUNT(NCR![NCR No]5, #FFC7CE) = 0 AND COUNTA(NCR![Status]) = PRE_COUNTA(NCR![Status])
TEST     fixture=ncr_01.xlsx call=HighlightOpenMajorNcrs(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

a Status that is Open, Closed or On Hold apart from case and extra spaces is rewritten exactly as Open, Closed or On Hold; any other Status is left as it is

entries.spec:
VCL 0.6
TASK
# ASSUME: the NCR Register headers are in row 1 and include "NCR No", "Date Raised" and "Status"; data starts in row 2
# ASSUME: a Status that is Open, Closed or On Hold apart from case and extra spaces is rewritten exactly as Open, Closed or On Hold; any other Status is left as it is
# ASSUME: a repeated NCR No is a copy typed twice: the first row stays and each later row with the same NCR No is deleted; DEDUPE ignores case but does not trim, and a blank NCR No is never removed
# ASSUME: Date Raised holds real dates; rows with a blank date sort to the bottom
GOAL     Write every NCR status in one clean form, remove repeated NCR numbers keeping the first, and sort the register by Date Raised, newest first.
PROC     TidyNcrRegister
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcrReview
ARGS     ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNcr As Long
VAR      cDate As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      removed As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ws, "Date Raised") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $ws
OP       LET(cNcr, COL($ws, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cDate, COL($ws, "Date Raised"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNcr) var=r
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Open")
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "Closed")
OP         IF SAME(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "On Hold")
OP           SET_VALUE(CELL($ws, r, cStatus), "On Hold")
OP       DEDUPE(USED_RANGE($ws), cols=cNcr, header=yes, into=removed)
OP       SORT(USED_RANGE($ws), key=cDate, order=desc, header=yes)
OP       RETURN(removed)
PERF     screen_off
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  ncr_02.xlsx sheet=NCR cols=A:NCR No,B:Date Raised,C:Status rows=8 data=A:values("NCR-1"x2,"NCR-2"x1,"NCR-3"x1,"NCR-4"x2,"NCR-5"x1,"NCR-6"x1)+boundary("NCR-1","NCR-2","NCR-1","NCR-3","NCR-4","NCR-5","NCR-4","NCR-6");B:dates(2026-03-01,2026-03-31)+boundary(2026-03-01,2026-03-05,2026-03-02,2026-03-08,2026-03-03,2026-03-07,2026-03-04,2026-03-06);C:values(" open"x1,"CLOSED "x1,"Open"x1,"on hold"x1,"Closed"x2,"OPEN"x1,"On Hold"x1)+boundary(" open","CLOSED ","Open","on hold","Closed","OPEN","Closed","On Hold")
FIXTURE  ncr_02.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=2 data=A:text(8)
TEST     fixture=ncr_02.xlsx call=TidyNcrRegister(NCR) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 0 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTA(NCR![NCR No]) = 7 AND COUNTIF(NCR![Status], "Open") = 2 AND COUNTIF(NCR![Status], "Closed") = 2 AND COUNTIF(NCR![Status], "On Hold") = 2
TEST     fixture=ncr_02.xlsx call=TidyNcrRegister(NCR) assert=RESULT = 2 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND COUNTA(NCR![NCR No]) = PRE_COUNTA(NCR![NCR No]) - RESULT AND VALUE(NCR![NCR No]2) = "NCR-3" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]2) = "On Hold" AND VALUE(NCR![NCR No]3) = "NCR-5" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]3) = "Open" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]4) = "On Hold" AND VALUE(NCR![NCR No]5) = "NCR-2" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]5) = "Closed" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]6) = "Closed" AND VALUE(NCR![NCR No]7) = "NCR-1" AND VALUE(NCR![Status]7) = "Open"
TEST     fixture=ncr_02.xlsx call=TidyNcrRegister(Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1

# ASSUME: the NCR Register headers are in row 1 and include "NCR No", "Department" and "Status"; data starts in row 2
# ASSUME: the summary goes on a new sheet named NCR Summary after the last sheet; when NCR Summary is already there the run changes nothing and returns 0
# ASSUME: a Status that is Open, Closed or On Hold apart from case and extra spaces is counted as Open, Closed or On Hold; any other Status is counted under its own trimmed text
# ASSUME: a row with a blank NCR No is not an NCR and is not counted
GOAL     Add an NCR Summary sheet that counts the NCRs by status and by department, and return how many NCRs were counted.
PROC     SummariseNcrs
KIND     Function
MODULE   modNcrReview
ARGS     book As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
RET      Long
VAR      cNcr As Long
VAR      cDept As Long
VAR      cStatus As Long
VAR      out As Worksheet
VAR      byStatus As Dictionary
VAR      byDept As Dictionary
VAR      label As String
VAR      got As Long
VAR      outRow As Long
VAR      total As Long
PRE      COL($ws, "NCR No") > 0; COL($ws, "Department") > 0; COL($ws, "Status") > 0
MODIFIES $book sheets
OP       LET(cNcr, COL($ws, "NCR No"))
OP       LET(cDept, COL($ws, "Department"))
OP       LET(cStatus, COL($ws, "Status"))
OP       EXIT_IF SHEET_EXISTS($book, "NCR Summary")
OP       LET(total, 0)
OP       LOOP_ROWS dir=down from=2 to=LASTROW($ws, cNcr) var=r
OP         SKIP_IF IS_EMPTY(CELL($ws, r, cNcr))
OP         LET(label, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cStatus)))
OP         IF SAME(label, "Open") THEN LET(label, "Open")
OP         IF SAME(label, "Closed") THEN LET(label, "Closed")
OP         IF SAME(label, "On Hold") THEN LET(label, "On Hold")
OP         DICT_ADD(byStatus, label, 1, mode=sum)
OP         DICT_ADD(byDept, TRIM(CELL($ws, r, cDept)), 1, mode=sum)
OP         LET(total, total + 1)
OP       ADD_SHEET($book, name="NCR Summary", into=out)
OP       WRITE_ROW(out, 1, "Status", "NCRs")
OP       LET(outRow, 2)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(byStatus)
OP         DICT_GET(byStatus, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW(out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       WRITE_ROW(out, outRow, "Department", "NCRs")
OP       LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       FOR_EACH var=k in=KEYS(byDept)
OP         DICT_GET(byDept, k, into=got)
OP         WRITE_ROW(out, outRow, k, got)
OP         LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       LET(outRow, outRow + 1)
OP       WRITE_ROW(out, outRow, "Total", total)
OP       RETURN(total)
ERR      standard
FIXTURE  ncr_03.xlsx sheet=NCR cols=A:NCR No,B:Department,C:Status rows=9 data=A:values("NCR-1"x1,"NCR-2"x1,"NCR-3"x1,""x1,"NCR-5"x1,"NCR-6"x1,"NCR-7"x1,"NCR-8"x1,"NCR-9"x1)+boundary("NCR-1","NCR-2","NCR-3","","NCR-5","NCR-6","NCR-7","NCR-8","NCR-9");B:values("QA"x3,"Welding"x3,"Machining"x2,"Stores"x1)+boundary("QA","Welding","QA","Stores","Machining","Welding","QA","Machining","Welding");C:values(" open"x1,"Open"x3,"CLOSED "x1,"on hold"x1,"Closed"x2,"On Hold"x1)+boundary(" open","Open","CLOSED ","Open","on hold","Closed","Open","Closed","On Hold")
FIXTURE  ncr_03.xlsx sheet=Notes cols=A:Note rows=2 data=A:text(8)
TEST     fixture=ncr_03.xlsx call=SummariseNcrs(ncr_03.xlsx, NCR) runs=2 assert=RESULT = 0 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND SHEET_EXISTS("NCR Summary") AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A1) = "Status" AND SUMIFS('NCR Summary'![NCRs], 'NCR Summary'![Status], "Open") = 3 AND SUMIFS('NCR Summary'![NCRs], 'NCR Summary'![Status], "Closed") = 3 AND SUMIFS('NCR Summary'![NCRs], 'NCR Summary'![Status], "On Hold") = 2
TEST     fixture=ncr_03.xlsx call=SummariseNcrs(ncr_03.xlsx, NCR) assert=RESULT = 8 AND ERROR_COUNT = 0 AND ROWS_USED('NCR Summary') = 11 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A1) = "Status" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B1) = "NCRs" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A2) = "Open" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B2) = 3 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A3) = "Closed" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B3) = 3 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A4) = "On Hold" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B4) = 2 AND COUNTA('NCR Summary'!A5) = 0 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A6) = "Department" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B6) = "NCRs" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A7) = "QA" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B7) = 3 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A8) = "Welding" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B8) = 3 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A9) = "Machining" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B9) = 2 AND COUNTA('NCR Summary'!A10) = 0 AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!A11) = "Total" AND VALUE('NCR Summary'!B11) = 8 AND SUMIFS('NCR Summary'![NCRs], 'NCR Summary'![Status], "Stores") = 0 AND COUNTA(NCR![Status]) = PRE_COUNTA(NCR![Status])
TEST     fixture=ncr_03.xlsx call=SummariseNcrs(ncr_03.xlsx, Notes) assert=RESULT = -1 AND ERROR_COUNT = 1 AND SHEET_EXISTS("NCR Summary") = 0
